Social Media & Community Manager

Social Media & Community Manager

Full-time (flexible, results-based hours), Remote

About Us

At The Global Talent Co., we provide opportunities to work with leading innovative technology companies worldwide, offering stable employment, competitive compensation, career growth, and access to a community of 25,000+ like-minded marketing professionals.

About the Company

You will be joining a lean, AI-first digital publisher that runs research-led review and comparison websites in the trading space. The teamâs edge is verified, evidence-based research that helps traders make better decisions, built on a strict editorial standard where ratings canât be bought and every claim is checked. The next step is turning that research into an audience, and this hire is the person who builds it.

The Role

As Social Media & Community Manager, you will build the audience for a fast-growing publishing project in prop trading. Traders ask their hardest questions on X, Reddit and YouTube: which firm pays out, what a challenge really costs and which rule will end an account. Youâll own the channels end to end, turning verified research into posts, threads, graphics and video that traders actually want to watch and share, and growing a community around it. X is the priority for brand exposure and Reddit is where the community is built, with YouTube, Instagram and Facebook alongside.

Youâll work closely with the Senior Project Manager, who agrees priorities with you and oversees the editorial standard across the project. Within those goals, how you get there is your call: you pick the formats, the hooks and the tools, and youâre judged on results. This role is ideal for a self-driven, AI-first creator who has grown channels before, has better taste than the model and wants to own the outcome without being managed day to day. Itâs a long-term role for someone who wants to grow with the project.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own content ideas, production, publishing, community engagement and performance across X, Reddit, YouTube, Instagram and Facebook, working to an agreed channel plan with X and Reddit as the priority channels

  • Create finished content yourself: posts, threads and scripts, graphics, carousels and thumbnails, screen demos, and edited videos with clear pacing, captions and audio

  • Build and keep improving AI workflows that take verified research to scripts, drafts and platform-specific versions, with your own quality check before anything goes live

  • Engage with traders and creators on X, contribute transparently to relevant Reddit communities within their rules, and feed recurring questions back into the content plan

  • Produce YouTube Shorts and explainers, Instagram Reels, carousels and Stories, and Facebook posts and short videos, and manage comments and messages on every channel

  • Run the content calendar: a sustainable publishing schedule, recurring formats and smart repurposing of strong material across platforms

  • Protect quality and accuracy by verifying claims, acting on editorial feedback, including appropriate commercial disclosures and escalating sensitive issues

  • Track reach, engagement, retention, watch time and website traffic, report progress against agreed KPIs and use the data to improve topics, hooks, titles, thumbnails and editing

Ideal Candidate

  • Proven record of growing organic social channels or communities you ran yourself, with before-and-after numbers to show for it, including hands-on experience with X and Reddit, so you can make an impact from day one

  • Deeply AI-native: you use Claude, ChatGPT or similar tools daily for ideas, scripts, drafts and analysis, build your own AI workflows rather than only prompting, know where their output fails and take ownership of the final work

  • Based in a time zone with at least 4 hoursâ overlap with Central European Time; candidates in the Americas should be no further west than US Mountain Time

  • Strong writing and editing skills in English, able to turn technical material into clear posts, compelling scripts and helpful community replies without losing accuracy

  • Can produce finished graphics, carousels, Reels, Shorts and explainers on your own using Canva, CapCut, Premiere Pro or equivalents, with good judgment on hooks, pacing and captions, and a portfolio of content you personally created to show for it

  • Working knowledge of publishing and analytics on Facebook, Instagram and YouTube, and of prop trading concepts such as evaluations, drawdown and payout conditions, or proven credibility in another technical or financial niche

  • Independent, results-driven thinker who forms their own view, pushes back when the evidence says otherwise, measures themselves on outcomes and starts on the next problem without waiting to be asked

  • A stable track record: youâve stayed with companies or projects long enough to see them through full growth cycles, and you bring loyalty, honesty, integrity and discretion with confidential information

Nice to Have

  • TikTok experience

  • Motion graphics skills

  • Comfortable presenting on camera

  • Experience running creator collaborations

  • Background in affiliate publishing

Tools & Stack

Claude, ChatGPT, Canva, CapCut, Premiere Pro, YouTube Studio, X, Reddit, YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, platform analytics, Slack

Join Our Team Be part of a collaborative, innovative environment where your technical skills and product instincts can make a real impact. We offer competitive compensation, professional development opportunities, and a supportive remote work culture. Apply now and take the next step in your career.

At The Global Talent Co., our mission is to bridge the gap between leading global tech companies and amazing global talent. We believe everyone deserves equal access to opportunities, regardless of the country they happen to be born in.

jobs.description:
Staff Product Manager | Referral Program and Client Management

Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.

GET TO KNOW US

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Staff Product Manager to join our BASE Focus Area in the Marketplace Management Systems team, to work in Brazil.

This is a Remote – Brazil position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country. Please note that this role is only open to candidates in Brazil.

The BASE (Business Architecture Services) Focus Area is responsible for core platform capabilities that enable and evolve Wellhub’s business model, supporting both our current business and future growth opportunities.

In this role, you will lead key product initiatives across two strategic areas: Referral Program and Client Management. You will help evolve our referral program as a scalable growth channel, creating experiences that drive acquisition and engagement, while also building and improving the capabilities that enable a sustainable marketplace.

You will work closely with cross-functional teams, design, engineering, operations, business stakeholders, and other product teams to deliver high-quality products that meet both Wellhub's goals and clients' needs.

If you are passionate about building products that make a difference in people’s lives and are excited about the opportunity to join a team that is directly connected to Wellhub's most important goals, to grow in a dynamic, fast-paced environment, we want to hear from you!

YOUR IMPACT

  • Drive the development of tools aimed at simplifying and optimizing the way Wellhub offers its services to the market, sustainably increasing value to thousands of clients, millions of users, and partners around the world;
  • Lead the product requirements definition, actively collaborating with various cross-functional teams and stakeholders within Wellhub to propose new product solutions;
  • Foster a culture of continuous improvement by constantly evaluating and refining current products, processes, tools, and methodologies;
  • Lead the creation and execution of the product roadmap, aligning with business objectives and customer needs. Prioritize initiatives and maintain focus on high-impact features;
  • Utilize analytics and research to measure product success, identify growth opportunities, and iterate on product features. Develop KPIs to track and measure product performance.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life balance.

WHO YOU ARE

  • A true team player used to build great products in close collaboration with engineering, design, and business team;
  • Enthusiastic about developing global products with global teams;
  • Clear product vision and strategy that aligns with business goals;
  • Be able to balance long-term strategic goals with the ability to execute on short-term priorities. This includes understanding how each product feature or iteration fits into the broader Wellhub's vision;
  • Entrepreneurial and self-driven spirit with a great desire to make things happen;
  • Data-driven mindset with analytical skills and experience with product analytics tools (e.g., Looker, Metabase);
  • Familiarity with Agile (Scrum, Kanban) and the ability to run sprints, manage backlogs, and work iteratively is critical;
  • Experience with the entire product lifecycle— from ideation, MVP (minimum viable product) development, testing, and iteration, to launch and post-launch optimization;
  • AI-enabled mindset: You actively leverage AI in your day-to-day work to enhance;
  • Has strong written and spoken advanced English skills for day-to-day business communication.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience in Product Management and Product Lifecycle are mandatory requirements.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life.

Our flexible benefits program allows you to customize some of the benefits, according to your needs!

Our benefits include:

WELLHUB: Free Gold+ membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

WELLZ: A complete emotional wellbeing program with a unique approach. It offers personalized journeys that combine individual therapy sessions (52 per year) and on-demand content.

HEALTHCARE: Health, dental, and life insurance.

FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. When you join, use our home office reimbursement to set up your home office.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Flexibility for us isn’t just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.

PAID TIME OFF: It’s important to take time away from work to recharge.Employees receive vacations after 6 months and additional 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + an extra holiday for your birthday!

PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.

CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions, build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success.

CULTURE: You’ll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. Learn more about our shared culture and values here.

Want to see what it’s really like to work here? Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and watch our team video on YouTube!

We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong.

Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.

What you will work on:

  • Observability as a Service. A self-service platform that balances performance and cost. Hard problems: high-cardinality metrics, log retention, distributed tracing, profiling.
  • Golden Paths. Defaults that let a developer instrument code in minutes and get good signals without operating anything.
  • The platform itself. Collection, storage, query and alerting that stay reliable when the company grows. We also watch the watchers: the platform must tell us when it is broken.

Our stack includes Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Thanos, Loki, Tempo, Pyroscope, Kafka, Kubernetes, AWS, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, Crossplane and HashiCorp Vault. You will write code in Go, Ruby or Python to build our tools.

  • Review our current platform with fresh eyes. Say what is wrong, propose better solutions, and help the team evolve them.
  • Own our observability stack end to end. Keep it resilient, scalable and ready for growth.
  • Evolve the Kubernetes-based infrastructure it runs on.
  • Close the gap between complex infrastructure and developer experience. Build the abstractions that let teams manage their own observability.
  • Set standards and guidelines, and write them down through RFCs.
  • Work with the whole team day to day: pair on designs, review proposals, mentor engineers and help make decisions as a technical reference.
  • Live the mission: care for your own wellbeing and your colleagues'.

You like to remove friction. You want your work to help many engineers.

This role may fit if you have:

  • Built and run observability at scale (metrics, logs, traces), not only designed or used it. You can tell us what broke and what you changed.
  • Deep knowledge of Kubernetes and AWS (or GCP or Azure), including networking and the real cost of moving data.
  • You possess excellent communication skills in both English and Portuguese.
  • Deep, hands-on expertise with open source observability tools such as Prometheus, Thanos, Grafana, Loki or Tempo, and with OpenTelemetry collection and instrumentation.
  • A specialist's depth in the hard parts: high-cardinality data, retention and storage, query performance, and keeping the observability platform itself reliable.
  • A habit of reasoning from the constraint (cost, reliability, performance) and not from the tool. You can explain trade-offs and say what you do not know.
  • Experience building products for other engineers, with attention to adoption, ownership and developer experience.
  • Strong software engineering skills. You write code to build tools and automation.
  • Fluent English and Portuguese, spoken and written.

Bonus points if you have:

  • Cost optimization for high-volume telemetry (FinOps).
  • Internal tools, CLIs or Kubernetes operators; Crossplane.

Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.

GET TO KNOW US

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Staff Corporate Network Engineer in our CorpIT area in Brazil! This is a Remote – Brazil position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country. Please note that this role is only open to candidates in Brazil.

You will own the technical direction, architecture, and reliability of Wellhub's corporate network, from office LAN and WAN to SASE, SSE, ZTNA, and cloud connectivity.

CorpIT builds scalable, data-driven solutions that raise Wellhubber productivity. This role is a senior technical leadership position within CorpIT's IT Infrastructure: you will design and evolve the networks every Wellhubber relies on daily, act as the final escalation point when things break, and raise the technical bar of the engineers around you through automation, design reviews, and mentorship.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Define the long-term strategy and reference architectures for our corporate network — LAN, WAN/SD-WAN, SASE, SSE, ZTNA, and cloud connectivity (AWS, GCP, Azure) — translating a long-term vision into time-bound, executable milestones.
  • Partner closely with Infosec to move from perimeter-based networking to a Zero Trust model, keeping policies, tunnels, and access rules aligned with the company's risk posture.
  • Act as the primary escalation point for critical incidents, complex outages, and major infrastructure upgrades — leading incident response and blameless post-incident reviews.
  • Build network automation workflows using scripting and Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) principles, reducing manual toil and configuration drift so most changes never need to reach you.
  • Lead design reviews and document decisions (architecture decision records, platform overviews, runbooks), evaluating vendors and technologies with clear trade-offs on security, cost, performance, and operability.
  • Mentor junior and mid-level engineers on troubleshooting best practices, operational safety, and network design.
  • Partner with Security, Systems, Cloud, and Application teams to roll out new technologies securely and with minimal user impact.
  • Define and track the metrics that matter — availability, latency, incident volume, mean time to resolve, and change success rate — and report progress transparently to stakeholders.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues'. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

WHO YOU ARE

You are a hands-on network engineer who thinks like an architect - equally comfortable troubleshooting a routing issue at 2 a.m. and designing a multi-year network roadmap. You have owned enterprise networks end-to-end before: not just keeping them running, but shaping where they go next, how they are secured, and how they are automated.

What You Bring to the Table:

  • Enterprise Networking Expertise: Hands-on enterprise networking experience, typically progressing from senior or core network engineering roles; deep knowledge of TCP/IP, routing (BGP, OSPF), switching, DNS, and VPN.
  • SASE / SSE / ZTNA: hands-on experience designing and operating SD-WAN and cloud secure access platforms (e.g., Zscaler ZIA/ZPA, Netskope, Palo Alto Prisma, or equivalent), partnering with security teams on policy design.

  • Education & Certifications: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent professional experience). Industry credentials such as CCIE or equivalent multi-vendor proficiencies (Arista, AWS, Azure) are heavily preferred.
  • Communication: a clear, structured communicator who can translate technical trade-offs into business terms for leadership and influence stakeholders in a highly matrixed environment; fluent in written and spoken English.

We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior hands-on enterprise networking experience, experience with SASE/SSE/ZTNA platforms, network automation (scripting and IaC), and advanced/fluent English are mandatory requirements.

  • Support the introduction and commercialisation of new products, helping establish market presence and identify new growth opportunities. 


  • Excellent proficiency in French verbal and written skills. 

  • Proven ability to sell complex, high-value SaaS solutions into large enterprise organisations, managing long sales cycles and significant deal values. 

  • Ability to develop territory strategies, build account plans and identify opportunities for new business acquisition and account expansion. 

  • Strong hunting mentality with the ability to independently identify, engage and convert new enterprise prospects. 

  • Skilled in navigating multi-stakeholder sales processes, coordinating internal and external teams and managing sophisticated commercial negotiations. 

  • Ability to understand complex customer challenges, conduct effective discovery and position solutions around business outcomes rather than product features. 

  • Strong commercial acumen and ability to build business cases, demonstrate ROI and communicate the financial and operational value of technology investments. 

  • Experience working alongside technology, consulting and implementation partners to develop opportunities and close enterprise deals. 

  • Ability to understand and communicate complex data-driven technology, analytics, software and technical solutions to both technical and business stakeholders. 

  • Practical experience applying structured sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC, Force Management or similar enterprise sales frameworks. 

  • Ability to prioritise named accounts, identify whitespace opportunities and develop strategic approaches to maximise territory revenue. 

  • Strong negotiation skills with the ability to manage commercial objections, procurement processes and executive-level discussions. 

  • Comfortable operating in a changing environment, launching new products and navigating ambiguity. 

  • Proficiency with modern sales tools, including HubSpot, Microsoft Office 365 and pipeline forecasting platforms. 

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to engage and influence senior executives and technical decision-makers. 

  • Nice to have: experience selling services. 

  • Residing in and legally permitted to work in the EU. 

 

What We Offer: 

 

  • Competitive Salary – We reward your skills and experience with a compensation package that reflects your value. 

  • 30 Days Paid Time Off – Take the time you need to recharge and maintain a healthy work-life balance. 

  • Remote-First Flexibility – Work from anywhere in the EU, with the option to collaborate in person at our offices in Stuttgart, Berlin (role dependent). 

  • Generous Learning & Development Budget – We invest in your growth, providing ample resources for personal and professional development. 

  • Choose Your Ideal Work Equipment – Whether you prefer Apple or Microsoft, we’ll equip you with the tools you need to excel. 

  

The Experience: 

 

  • Purpose-Driven Work – Build something meaningful. Here, you’re not just creating another app; you’re contributing to a transformative vision that you can be proud of. 

  • Great Colleagues – Join a team that’s open, transparent, and international. We value inclusivity and foster a culture of collaboration and mutual respect. 

  • Work-Life Balance – As a remote-first company, we trust you to do your best work, your way. You have the flexibility to work when it suits you, ensuring a healthy balance between personal and professional life. 

  • Pride in Impact – We're already making a significant difference with global, well-known customers who share our vision. Be part of something that matters. 

  • Stability with Ambition – With realistic growth plans, we’re committed to changing the way things are made—without sacrificing our ambitious goals for innovation and impact. 

 

If you want to find out more about what it’s like to work at Makersite, check out our Careers Page here 

  

Diversity and Inclusion 

If you have a medical condition or an individual need for an adjustment to our process, and you believe this may affect your ability to be at your best – please let us know so we can talk about how we can best support you and make any adjustments that may be needed.  

 

At Makersite, we are dedicated to fostering an environment that champions diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging. We believe that diverse teams drive innovation and success, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and will consider all applications regardless of age, disability, gender identity, marital status, pregnancy or maternity, race, nationality, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or any other status protected by applicable law. Rest assured, all applications will be handled with the utmost confidentiality.

jobs.title: Senior Revenue Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Senior Revenue Operations Manager

About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

The Role

We're looking for a Senior Revenue Operations Manager to join our Revenue Operations team and act as a broad, senior partner to our revenue organisation. You'll run the complex analysis and modelling behind target setting and annual planning for the entire commercial organisation. You will also help the Director set and execute the revenue analytics strategy, and run the insights that shape how revenue leadership sees the business. As you ramp up, you will take on growing ownership of the forecasting cadence alongside the Director of Revenue Operations.

We are looking for someone with very strong analytical and modelling skills, which are the foundation of the role, especially in your first two quarters. Just as important, we want someone who is commercially minded and keen to grow into a generalist role, broadening from there into revenue insights and forecasting.


What You’ll Do

  • First 90 days: Scope the revenue analytics strategy and build the core dashboards.

  • First 180 days: Lead the analysis for the annual planning and target-setting cycle, and automate the core of revenue reporting and insights with AI tooling.

  • First 12 months: Take on co-ownership of the forecasting cadence with the Director of Revenue Operations.

 

What Will You Be Doing?

Run Complex Modelling & Analysis

  • Run complex analysis and modelling to support target setting and the annual planning process for the entire commercial organisation, made up of around 600 commercial roles across SDRs, AEs and Account Managers.

  • Build and maintain the models behind target setting: capacity, quota and productivity assumptions, and territory and segment allocation.

  • Frame the key planning questions, choose the method, pressure-test scenarios and sensitivities, and deliver clear recommendations to revenue leadership, explaining the trade-offs in plain language.

  • Work as the senior analytical partner to the other analyst on the team: stay hands-on in the models while setting the quality bar and documentation standards, so each planning cycle is repeatable and auditable.

Build the Revenue Analytics Strategy

  • Partner with the Director of Revenue Operations to define the revenue analytics strategy: what we need to build across Salesforce and Looker, and in what order.

  • Map the current reporting landscape — what exists, what's trusted, what's duplicated or out of date — and use that map to shape the build plan.

  • Own execution of that plan: build and maintain the core dashboards and reports that revenue leadership and the wider commercial organisation rely on.

  • Launch and run a recurring insights digest for revenue leaders, turning dashboards and data into a clear narrative — what changed, why it matters, what to do about it.

  • Bring a point of view on what's worth building versus what's noise, and be willing to push back on requests that don't earn their keep.

Grow Into Forecasting

  • Co-run the forecasting cadence with sales leaders and the Director of Revenue Operations — forecast calls, pipeline reviews, and accuracy tracking.

  • Build and refine forecasting models based on pipeline, productivity, and historical conversion.

  • Conduct strategic analyses to determine forecasting trends and identify opportunities for process improvement.


What You’ll Bring

  • Strong experience in Revenue or Sales Operations, preferably in a SaaS or technology company operating at a global or European level.

  • Advanced modelling and scenario analysis skills (spreadsheets and SQL), ideally with experience in target setting, capacity planning or annual planning for a large commercial organisation.

  • Solid Salesforce reporting skills and working fluency in a BI tool (Looker or equivalent), with a practical, business-first approach to data.

  • Commercial judgement and exposure to quota-carrying teams such as Account Executives, plus a generalist mindset: as comfortable building a dashboard as a planning model or running a forecasting call.

  • The ability to influence sales leadership and revenue executives, and to own ambiguous problems end to end, from framing the question to landing the recommendation.

  • Excellent written communication, since the insights digest is a core, ongoing deliverable of this role.

  • Hands-on experience using AI tools to automate analysis and reporting, or a clear appetite to build that skill quickly.


What We Offer

  • 25 days of annual leave to rest and recharge, plus all public holidays.

  • An optional pension scheme to support your long-term financial wellbeing.

  • A tax-efficient bike leasing scheme through Lease a Bike, for your commute or personal use.

  • Reimbursed commuting costs if you live more than 10km away from the office.

  • Competitive compensation paired with equity in Perk.

  • Unforgettable team experiences, including our annual summer party.

  • Comprehensive wellbeing support through Spring Health, offering fast access to 12 therapy and 12 coaching sessions for you and your loved ones.

  • Focus on your family with 12-16 weeks’ paid parental leave

  • 16 paid volunteer hours each year to give back to causes you care about.

  • Up to 20 “Work From Anywhere” days annually to explore the world while staying connected.

  • A fully paid four-week sabbatical after five years with Perk.

  • Relocation support to help you move seamlessly into one of our hubs.

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

The Role

We're looking for a Commissions & Targets Manager to own how our sales organisation is paid and how its targets are set. You'll run the commission process end to end, manage CaptivateIQ, handle complex cases, and run the quarterly target distribution for our sales reps. You'll shape our commission strategy with the Director of Revenue Operations.

You'll also be the go-to person for two experienced commission analysts. It's not a line management role, but you'll guide the team on difficult cases. Payouts depend on accurate numbers delivered on fixed deadlines, so we need someone with strong attention to detail who prioritises well in a fast-moving team.

This is an Individual Contributor role.


What You'll Do

  • First 90 days: Master our commission plans, workflows, and CaptivateIQ setup, and execute your first end-of-quarter close with support from the Director.

  • First 6 months: Take full ownership of the end-of-quarter close and case escalations, and lead your first quarterly target distribution.

  • First 12 months: Partner with the Director to shape our commission strategy while optimising the processes and system configurations you inherited.


What Will You Be Doing?

Commission Processes

  • Manage the end-of-quarter commission process, from data validation and plan calculations to review, approvals and payout handover. Start with the Director's oversight and take full ownership of the process within your first two quarters.

  • Define the end-of-quarter schedule: map all the activities, decide which to prioritise, identify what can be front-loaded ahead of quarter end, and build a plan that hits the deadlines and delivers quality results.

  • During the close, make quick calls and reprioritise when things go wrong, flag risks before they affect payouts, and keep the process documented and auditable.

  • Spot recurring errors and bottlenecks, and fix them at the source.

Commission Cases & Team Support

  • Act as the escalation point for complex or disputed commission cases, supporting the two commission analysts.

  • Coach the analysts on case handling, resolve difficult cases and make clear, consistent and well-documented decisions.

  • Identify patterns in the cases raised, and use them to improve plan rules, documentation and communication.

Commission System Ownership

  • Manage our commissions system, CaptivateIQ: plan configuration, data integrations, quarterly updates and access.

  • Partner with the Sales Operations, Finance and Data team on data quality and any system changes.

  • Test and validate changes before each close, so that calculations are accurate and reproducible.

Commission Strategy

  • Work with the Director of Revenue Operations to define the commission strategy, including plan design, rules and how they support company goals.

  • Analyse plan performance and its effect on sales behaviour, and bring a point of view on what to change.

  • Prepare the commission plan updates for each planning period and communicate them clearly to sales and finance stakeholders.

Quarterly Target Distribution

  • Run the target setting cycle each quarter, with clear methodology and timelines, and explain the outcomes to sales leaders.

  • Make sure any outlier or special case target adjustments are handled before the targets are published.

  • Handle target questions and adjustments in a fair and consistent way.


What Will You Need to Succeed?

  • Strong experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Sales Compensation or a similar role, preferably in a SaaS or technology company operating at a global or European level.

  • Hands-on experience running commission processes for a quota-carrying sales organisation, including end-of-quarter closes.

  • Experience administering a commissions system (CaptivateIQ or a similar tool such as Qobra) is preferred but not required.

  • Exceptional attention to detail and the discipline to deliver accurate results on fixed deadlines.

  • A strong ability to improve processes: you spot what is manual, error-prone or slow, and fix it at the source.

  • Ability to prioritise well and make fast, accurate calls in a fast-moving, deadline-driven environment.

  • Strong analytical skills. Experience setting or contributing to sales targets and quotas is a plus.

  • Good judgment and strong stakeholder management, including handling sensitive conversations about pay with sales leaders, finance and ICs.

  • Experience guiding or coaching other analysts.

  • Clear written and verbal communication in English.

  • Experience working with global or multi-region teams is a plus.

What We Offer?

  • 25 days of annual leave to rest and recharge, plus all public holidays.

  • An optional pension scheme to support your long-term financial wellbeing.

  • A tax-efficient bike leasing scheme through Lease a Bike, for your commute or personal use.

  • Reimbursed commuting costs if you live more than 10km away from the office.

  • Competitive compensation paired with equity in Perk.

  • Unforgettable team experiences, including our annual summer party.

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. We are hiring a in our Senior Director of Growth, Web Strategy & Operations area in Brazil (Remote accepted)!

Reporting to the VP of Marketing Operations, this role owns the evolution of Wellhub's website — from a traditionally-managed site to an Agentic Website Experience and Operations model, where AI agents increasingly handle content assembly, personalization, identity resolution, and optimization, freeing the team to focus on strategy, judgment calls, and the exceptions that matter. This is a hands-on strategic role: owning the roadmap, design, testing, data, and execution, and leading product managers, UX designers, web analytics, and developers to deliver on that vision. You're expected to have a real point of view on where agentic AI creates leverage on a website versus where it introduces risk, and to be able to defend that point of view to technical and non-technical stakeholders alike.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Lead the vision, roadmap, and strategy for Wellhub's website experience, driving its evolution toward an Agentic Website Experience and Operations model — where AI agents increasingly handle content assembly, personalization, and optimization.
  • Own conversion rate optimization end-to-end: define experimentation strategy, size and prioritize A/B tests, lead qualitative research and behavioral surveys, and translate results into optimization decisions.
  • Own website performance measurement and automated reporting (traffic, MQLs, sign-ups, conversions), analyzing visitor behavior through data synthesis, heat mapping, and tools like Amplitude + Looker.
  • Partner with stakeholders across the organization to shape the website experience for product launches, content, campaigns, and the broader roadmap.
  • Lead the website design and UX function, including the Mantra design system and the end-to-end design-to-code operating model (Figma to Mantra to Strapi), owning the quality bar for both human- and agent-generated work.
  • Evaluate, pilot, and scale agentic AI and AI orchestration tools for the website — defining human-in-the-loop boundaries, guardrails, and escalation paths — and identify, procure, and roll out best-in-class website technology and platforms.
  • Own the site's readiness for AI-driven discovery and personalization: architect content and information architecture for SEO, GEO/AEO, and Web MCP, lead the rollout of AI-powered personalization and predictive experimentation, and ensure conversational/AI-assisted website interactions align with the broader company AI architecture.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

WHO YOU ARE

  • A seasoned digital/website leader with proven experience and ownership of a website and hands-on experience running experimentation programs.
  • Deep expertise across web tech stacks — analytics platforms, headless CMS, and web design systems — with a track record of managing them end-to-end.
  • Concrete, hands-on experience applying AI/agentic technology to marketing or web workflows (agent frameworks, AI personalization/CRO, conversational content tooling, or GEO/AEO strategy), including AI-assisted design-to-code workflows in production.
  • A clear, defensible point of view on where agentic AI creates leverage versus risk in B2B contexts, with the ability to bridge marketing, martech/engineering, and data teams on AI implementation.
  • Experience leading design and/or research functions, or credibly managing senior design ICs and design system owners, including owning a design system as shared infrastructure rather than a component library.
  • A strong cross-functional leader who thrives in matrixed, fast-paced, hyper-growth environments, balancing internal business needs with a customer-centric mindset.
  • Analytically rigorous, with strong critical thinking to translate complex AI topics into actionable insights and a sharp focus on KPIs and conversion metrics.
  • Quick to adapt to new domain contexts, AI trends, and vendor tools, with experience working across global companies and website localization.

For this specific role, please note that prior experience in B2B website management and hands-on application of agentic AI/experimentation are mandatory requirements.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life.

Our flexible benefits program allows you to customize some of the benefits, according to your needs!

Our benefits include:

WELLHUB: Free Gold+ membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

WELLZ: A complete emotional wellbeing program with a unique approach. It offers personalized journeys that combine individual therapy sessions (52 per year) and on-demand content.

HEALTHCARE: Health, dental, and life insurance.

FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. When you join, use our home office reimbursement to set up your home office.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Flexibility for us isn’t just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.

PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.

CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions, build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success.

jobs.title: Working Student Office Coordination (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Working Student Office Coordination (m/f/d)

About the Role at RobCo

RobCo is building the category of Autonomous Industrial Robotics and we're doing it fast. We believe that automating the ordinary frees humans to do the extraordinary, and we're building the end-to-end robotics infrastructure to make that possible - hardware, software, and AI in one stack that just works.

 

The Role

As a Working Student or Intern in Office Coordination, you support our Workplace Operations Lead in keeping daily operations in our Munich office running smoothly. You help at our front desk and front office, and assist with workplace, fleet, vendor and administrative topics as we continue to scale rapidly. Your proactive, hands-on approach helps make sure our team and our visitors get the support they need, while you get a close look at how a fast-growing scale-up builds the future of industrial robotics.

 

Your Responsibilities

  • Support the Front Desk & Office Organization: Act as a point of contact at our front desk. Welcome visitors and candidates, help with phone and mail communications, and help keep the office organized and representative.

  • Support day-to-day back-office operations: Help keep meeting rooms and presentation tech setup-ready, handle daily mail and parcel logistics, and support kitchen inventory and regular orders to keep fridges, drinks, and coffee stations stocked.

  • Assist with Facility & Vendor Coordination: Support the coordination of cleaning teams, tradespeople, and external suppliers on site, and help report maintenance issues to the property manager and document them in our ticketing tool.

  • Assist with Fleet Management: Help with day-to-day fleet tasks such as key handovers, vehicle bookings, maintenance appointments, and communication with leasing companies.

  • Help with Travel & Company Events: Support booking business trips, hotels and appointments, and help organize internal team gatherings, in-office events and company-wide celebrations.

  • Office & Documentation Support: Help collect invoices and documents on site, check cost centers, upload physical invoices to our expense management system, and support in person with signatures and NDAs.

  • Support Workplace Safety: Assist the Workplace Operations Lead with health and safety topics in the office, for example first aid supplies, safety briefings and documentation.

  • Help Keep Front Office Processes Up to Date: Help maintain checklists, documentation and recurring workflows in tools like Notion, Claude and Google Workspace, and share ideas where manual work can be simplified.

 

We're looking for someone who has:

  • Current enrollment as a student in Business Administration, Operations Management, Facility Management, Hospitality or a comparable field (for an internship, a mandatory or voluntary internship as part of your studies or a gap year between degrees).

  • First experience in a front desk, reception, office assistant or similar role (e.g., through a part-time job or internship) is a plus.

  • A service-oriented, friendly and representative presence with visitors and colleagues.

  • A structured and reliable way of working, including when many requests come in at once.

  • An interest in learning new tools. Experience with tools like Google Workspace and Notion is a plus.

  • Availability of around 16–20 hours per week during the semester as a Working Student, or full-time for at least 3–6 months as an Intern, working onsite at our Munich office.

  • Culture-aligned mindset (e.g., "Hands-on mindset", "Team player", "Pragmatic working style").

  • Very good English skills and fluent German language skills (written and spoken) are required.

 

Why join RobCo?

  • Develop modular, software-defined robotics solutions with us that set new standards in automation.

  • Help us build robots equipped with state-of-the-art AI that perceive their environment, analyze data, and make intelligent decisions in real time.

  • As part of a very dynamic and fast-growing scale-up, you will take on responsibility from day one, drive your own projects, and see the direct impact of your work.

  • Flat hierarchies, open communication, and regular 360° feedback enable fast decisions and support your professional and personal development.

  • Wellpass membership (7,200+ studios across Germany), regular team events, and a team that takes both the work and the culture seriously

  • Flexible working hours, a modern office, and - depending on the role - the option to work from home.

  • Regular team events - from relaxed beer & pizza nights on the rooftop terrace to shared experiences on ski trips or at Oktoberfest.

About RobCo

Founded in Munich in 2020, RobCo leads the transition toward fully Autonomous Industrial Robotics. Our mission is to deploy RobCo in every factory - solving the industrial labor shortage through end-to-end robotics that just works. Powered by Physical AI, our solutions combine a scalable modular hardware architecture with intelligent software that continuously learns and improves, requiring zero upfront investment through our Robotics-as-a-Service (RaaS) model.

We solve our customers' most pressing pain points - labor shortage, cost pressure, workplace safety, and national reshoring - across the full spectrum of Autonomous Industrial Robotics. In October 2026, RobCo reached unicorn status with a valuation exceeding one billion US dollars, with its valuation doubling in less than nine months. With $200M raised from investors including Sequoia, Lightspeed, Lingotto, Kindred, Cherry Ventures, and the European Tech Collective, 225+ people globally, and 3.5M+ operating hours in the field, we are deploying robots in factories across Europe and the United States - with our US operations headquartered in Austin, TX, and our Bay Area Lab in San Francisco.

Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

At RobCo, applicants are selected regardless of ethnic origin, religion, gender, age, disability, or sexual orientation. All decisions throughout the recruitment process are based solely on applicants’ qualifications, skills, knowledge, and experience, as well as relevant business requirements.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager, Israel
jobs.description:
Customer Success Manager, Israel

Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

At TRM Labs, our Deployment Strategy team is on the front lines of customer experience – bridging product expertise with exceptional customer support. The team ensures our customers receive timely, accurate, and high-quality assistance at every step. You will work daily with leading financial institutions and crypto exchanges, — providing value through expert guidance, responsive support, and trusted partnership.

As a Customer Success Manager on our Deployment Strategist Team, you will play a critical role in helping TRM customers realise the full value of our platform. You will partner with crypto businesses to trace illicit funds, operationalise scalable compliance programs, and disrupt financial crime across the crypto ecosystem. You will manage a portfolio of strategic accounts, driving adoption of TRM’s tools, and ensuring customers achieve measurable, long-term impact.

The Impact You Will Have

  • Act as a trusted advisor, enabling and crypto businesses to maximise the effectiveness of our platform within their investigative, supervisory, risk, and compliance functions.

  • Confidently explain complex technical and investigative concepts, supporting customer teams in interpreting blockchain data, building cases, and conducting financial crime investigations.

  • Build and deliver product demonstrations tailored to investigators, analysts, compliance officers, supervisors, and risk teams across the private sectors, showing how TRM can be used in real scenarios to uncover networks, follow the money, and disrupt financial crime.

  • Conduct structured training sessions to ensure TRM is embedded into customers’ day-to-day investigative and compliance programs.

  • Serve as the “Voice of the Customer” by channeling customer feedback to product and engineering teams to influence product direction.

  • Monitor customer engagement and usage trends, identifying risks and opportunities to drive measurable outcomes.

  • Proactively identify early signals of churn risk and implement effective mitigation strategies.

  • Establish a consistent engagement cadence with customer stakeholders to understand institutional priorities, regulatory obligations, and emerging risks, proactively addressing challenges before they escalate.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of professional experience, ideally within crypto businesses, or financial institutions — preferably in compliance, investigative, or customer-facing functions.

  • High proficiency in English is required. Polish language skills are desirable.

  • Hands-on experience with virtual currencies and blockchain analytics, ideally within a compliance or investigative context; strong appetite to deepen expertise in these areas is essential.

  • Proven ability to structure complex problems, prioritize critical issues, and deliver actionable solutions.

  • Exceptional attention to detail and rigor, particularly in regulatory and investigative contexts.

  • Ability to distill and communicate complex technical and investigative concepts to diverse stakeholders, from compliance officers to senior executives.

  • Comfort operating in fast-paced, dynamic environments where regulatory expectations and priorities evolve quickly.

  • Strong collaboration skills and ability to influence outcomes in cross-functional settings

  • Willingness and ability to travel occasionally for in-person meetings, trainings, or events.

About the Team

  • Our globally distributed Customer Success team collaborates across time zones. This team operates primarily on EMEA time, with occasional later calls to cover US East/West Coast stakeholders on complex opportunities.

  • We work asynchronously by default, with strong documentation and transparent Slack communication.

  • We support customers from onboarding through deep investigations, and our Deployment Strategists are the frontline champions of TRM’s value.

  • This role is an opportunity to scale impactful customer interactions and help shape how we deliver rapid, high-quality support at TRM Labs.

Learn About TRM Speed in This Role

  • Real-Time Client Response: You’ll triage and resolve customer questions during time-sensitive events such as sanctions updates or critical investigations.

  • Expedited Trace Validation: You’ll coordinate with internal teams to validate traces and gather intelligence within hours, ensuring accuracy and speed.

  • Continuous Global Coverage: You’ll contribute to TRM’s 24-hour global support model, ensuring customers always have timely, high-quality assistance no matter their region.

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

Interviewing with TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

  • Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

  • Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

  • First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

  • Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

  • References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

  • Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

  • Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

  • Accelerate repeatable workflows

  • Structure and solve problems

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly

  • Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

  • Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

  • Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore.

Privacy Policy and Additional Information

By submitting your application, you agree to allow TRM Labs to process your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

We collect the information you provide (such as your resume, work history, and contact details) solely for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for current and future roles at TRM.

Because our hiring cycles for certain positions may span 24 to 36 months, we retain your personal information for up to 36 months from the date of your application. After that period, your data is deleted unless a different retention period is required or permitted by law.

If you are located in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or another jurisdiction with applicable data protection laws, you have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data at any time before that period ends. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at privacy@trmlabs.com.

To notify TRM Labs that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.

The use of AI tools of any kind (including but not limited to notetakers, interview assistants, and real-time coaching tools such as Otter.ai, Fireflies, Fathom, Cluey, or similar) during TRM interviews is not permitted without prior approval from TRM. TRM uses its own internal tools for note-taking to ensure a consistent and confidential experience for all candidates.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this form.

Recruitment agencies

TRM Labs does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to TRM employees. TRM Labs is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company without a signed agreement.

Client Success Senior Manager (m/f/d)

Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.

GET TO KNOW US

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we're on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you'll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally. 

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

 

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Client Success Senior Manager to our Client Success team in Munich!

You'll manage a set of high-profile corporate accounts in Germany, ensuring that our clients remain focused on our mission of making wellbeing universal. You'll also drive the commercial agenda within your portfolio of clients, and collaborate with other teams to ensure that take-up of Wellhub is high within all of the accounts that you manage. This is a great opportunity to join a growing team and work with talented people and some of Germany's most innovative companies. We're looking for a superstar candidate who can help the team to achieve new levels of success.


YOUR IMPACT

  • Own client relationships for a portfolio of large corporate accounts throughout the entire post-sale client lifecycle in Germany, leading all in-person and virtual client communications and meetings.
  • Ensure trusting, high-value partnerships with HR contacts, Procurement counterparts, and C-level executives by articulating Wellhub's mission to enhance employee health, engagement, and happiness.
  • Drive the commercial agenda across your account portfolio, leading annual contract renewals, expansions, and renegotiations to deliver continuous value.
  • Lead client launches, ongoing strategic relaunch initiatives, and awareness events in close partnership with the Wellhub Wellbeing Engagement Team for end-to-end execution.
  • Present and implement best-practice workflows, evaluate member growth metrics, suggest targeted adoption strategies, and provide continuous platform updates.
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional partners—including Customer Experience, Operations, User Growth Marketing, Fitness Partnerships, Business Development, and Wellbeing Engagement teams—to build adoption strategies and hit shared goals.
  • Analyze client data and metrics to deliver actionable findings, shaping tailored communication and awareness campaigns that boost user engagement and defeat inactivity.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.


WHO YOU ARE

  • An accomplished relationship leader with 5+ years of experience managing complex client relationships in a client-facing capacity.
  • A commercial driver with proven expertise leading end-to-end contract negotiations for renewals, upsells, and cross-sells, aligning client growth goals with company revenue targets.
  • A dynamic and collaborative partner who thrives in team environments, brings creative problem-solving skills, and works seamlessly with cross-functional groups.
  • An exceptional communicator who provides superior customer service to both internal stakeholders and executive-level external clients.
  • A detail-oriented project manager with deep experience orchestrating multiple complex client deliverables and priorities concurrently.
  • An analytical thinker fluent in tracking data, interpreting performance reports, and leveraging insights into concrete operational strategies.
  • A process innovator capable of refining job protocols, optimizing workflows, and proactively navigating change in a fast-paced global business environment.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience in enterprise client relationship management and commercial contract negotiations are mandatory requirements.


WHAT WE OFFER YOU

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life. Our benefits include:

WELLHUB:  Free Gold membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. We offer all employees a one-time reimbursement to set up their home office equipment and a monthly work allowance to help cover the costs of working from home. Our offices are in Germany, Italy, Netherlands, Portugal, Romania, Spain, and the UK. You can work from any office or remotely based in any of these countries.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE:  Flexibility for us isn't just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.

PAID TIME OFF: We know how important it is to take time away from work to recharge. Employees receive 30 days paid holiday per year in addition to annual holidays (including an extra holiday on your birthday!).

PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.  

CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions,  build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success. 

CULTURE: You'll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. Learn more about our shared culture and values here. 

Want to see what it's really like to work here? Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and watch our team video on YouTube!

 

Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub

We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong. At Wellhub, we welcome and celebrate your authentic self.

Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.

Our commitment to inclusion also extends to how we recognize and reward our people. We're proud to be Syndio Fair Pay Certified, reflecting our ongoing dedication to equitable and fair pay practices across our global team. Read more about it here.

Questions on how we treat your personal data? See our Job Applicant Privacy Notice.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

Are you passionate about using data, technology, and payments expertise to drive tangible customer value?

We’re looking for an experienced and commercially minded Head of Product to lead the evolution of our optimisation and orchestration products, scaling them to the next level.

You’ll operate at the intersection of Product, Data Science, and Commercial teams, translating analytical insights into measurable business outcomes for our customers and for APEXX. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys connecting complex technical capabilities with commercial value, inspiring cross-functional alignment, and ensuring optimisation becomes a core growth driver for the company.

If you thrive on solving complex payment challenges, shaping intelligent optimisation products, and communicating value with clarity and conviction, we’d love to hear from you.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING:

Product Strategy & Commercial Ownership

  • Define and drive the long-term strategy and roadmap for APEXX’s Optimisation and Orchestration suite, ensuring clear differentiation and customer value.

  • Establish the commercial framework for optimisation, working with Finance, Sales, and Marketing to design value-based pricing models.

  • Lead the evolution of optimisation from a capability into a scalable product line, influencing its positioning, packaging, and monetisation.

  • Provide thought leadership across the organisation on the role of AI and data-driven optimisation in payments.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Delivery

  • Partner with Engineering and Data Science to develop AI/ML-powered optimisation features that improve authorisation, reduce cost, and drive measurable performance gains.

Customer Value, Growth & Commercial Enablement

  • Translate model performance and analytical insights into ROI-focused, commercially compelling narratives for customers and internal stakeholders.

  • Be the Subject matter expert on Interchange and Scheme fee pricing and optimisation opportunities.

  • Partner with customers to identify where data, AI, and automation can unlock incremental efficiency, acceptance rates, or cost reduction.

  • You're an influencer: Natural influencer who can inspire cross-functional teams and align stakeholders around a common product vision.

WHY JOIN US:

You’ll help shape the future of payments optimisation at APEXX building products that directly impact merchant performance and profitability. You’ll work with talented teams across product, data, and engineering, driving measurable improvements in one of the most dynamic spaces in FinTech.

You’ll have the opportunity to shape the strategic direction of optimisation products and influence product management practices across the team.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS:
Great people deserve great rewards. We believe in recognising the impact you make with competitive compensation and benefits that support you both at work and beyond.

Whether it's taking time to recharge, looking after your health, working from somewhere new, or investing in your growth, we've built a benefits package designed to help you thrive, because when our people do well, so does APEXX.

🏖️ Generous Time Off:Take the time you need to rest and recharge with annual leave, public holidays, and wellbeing-focused time away from work.25 days holiday plus bank holidays. We love birthdays! - additional paid holiday for your birthday (26 days). Holiday increases a day each year after 3 years and have the option to carry 5 days holiday over to the following year.

APEXX is a global payment orchestration platform with teams across the UK & India, helping enterprise businesses simplify the complexity of payments. Our platform gives businesses access to 200+ acquirers, 150+ alternative payment methods, and 10+ Buy Now, Pay Later providers, helping them optimise payment performance, improve acceptance rates, and expand into new markets with confidence.

Trusted by leading global brands including Ryanair, TUI, Hotelbeds, CarTrawler, Avon, and Jet2, we're redefining enterprise payments by making them smarter, faster, and more reliable.

As we continue to grow, so do the opportunities to make an impact. Whether you're building products, solving complex engineering challenges, or supporting the teams behind them, you'll play a meaningful role in shaping the future of global payments at APEXX.
