AI Engineer

Do you thrive on complex problems and want to work at the forefront of AI? Join Cefetra Group’s new AI Innovation Hub as an AI Engineer and shape how AI creates value across our international trading business, from agents and workflows integrated with our core systems to the skills and ways of working that make them stick.

Who we are

Cefetra Group comprises several trading companies in the agricultural sector and the food ingredients industry, with leading brands in the ingredients market. Together, we employ approximately 800 people across 39 offices in 17 countries worldwide. We work closely together to provide our customers with the best possible service. Together with our suppliers, we develop strong supply chains and create value by sourcing raw materials and supplying them to the international food, animal feed and energy industries. Behind that sits real complexity: global commodity flows, volatile markets, intricate contracts and logistics, and data spread across many entities and systems. That is exactly where AI can make a decisive difference, and we are building the capability to make it happen.

The role

As an AI Engineer in the AI Innovation Hub, part of the Group Digital & Technology team, your goal is to build Cefetra Group’s AI capability and set the standard for how AI is designed and used across our entities. You’ll deliver AI solutions, from agents and workflows to knowledge bases, that teams across Cefetra Group can apply to augment their work, while helping colleagues build the skills to use them. You’ll work directly with process owners and business leaders to find where AI creates the most value. The AI Innovation Hub is just getting started, so together with the Group Digital & Technology team you’ll shape its direction from the ground up: which opportunities it pursues and how it delivers them. You’ll also work with Builders and Changemakers, colleagues in our entities who build AI solutions and drive adoption, to share what works and show business leaders what AI makes possible.

Your responsibilities include

  • Run discovery workshops to identify bottlenecks, value and exceptions. Assess use cases against readiness, team commitment, expected value and reuse potential.

  • Build AI workflows and agents using company data. Take prototypes all the way to robust, production-grade solutions that teams rely on in their daily work.

  • Integrate AI solutions with ERP, finance and operations systems, designing integrations that move safely from read-only access to controlled write-back.

  • Test solutions against real business scenarios. Set the deployment patterns, tool choices and safeguards that others across Cefetra Group build on.

  • Deliver hands-on workshops, from practical AI topics such as Claude Skills for non-technical colleagues to technical topics such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) for Builders and create materials Changemakers can use to train their peers.

  • Prepare demos of working use cases for leadership briefings.

Who you are

To succeed at Cefetra Group, you love complexity and combine deep technical curiosity with a pragmatic, collaborative approach. You work well both independently and with people at all levels of Cefetra Group. You take ownership end to end and move easily between governance, technical details and business priorities. You also meet the following requirements:

  • You’ve built and evaluated large language model (LLM) workflows, agents or applications in production.

  • You have hands-on experience with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings, vector search, indexing, knowledge bases, context engineering and orchestration.

  • You follow AI developments closely, from new models to agentic patterns and protocols, and know how to turn new capabilities into practical value.

  • You have full-stack development experience with Python or TypeScript, including APIs, authentication, data transformation and enterprise integrations.

  • You’re fluent in English and have led workshops for non-technical audiences.

What we offer

A unique opportunity to help Cefetra Group grow and become part of a dynamic and entrepreneurial team within an established multinational. We’re always open to discussing your individual needs. Here’s what we offer.

  • Access to frontier AI models and the room to experiment with new tools, techniques and ways of working.

  • Flexible working hours and hybrid working, as well as opportunities to learn and develop.

  • An office in one of the finest locations in central Rotterdam, overlooking the Maas and the Erasmus Bridge, with plenty of social activities and excellent coffee.

jobs.title: Senior Project & Process Manager – HR Operations (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Senior Project & Process Manager – HR Operations (m/f/d)

At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable.  

We are looking for a highly structured, hands-on Senior People Operations Project & Process Manager (m/f/d) to join our European HR Operations team. This is a senior role for someone who takes on our tougher operational problems and drives them forward together with the teams involved. You will be a driving force behind scaling, harmonizing, and digitizing our People Operations processes. Your scope is Europe, with selected global projects and touchpoints on top.

At Flix, People Operations is a team with genuine ownership, business impact, and a seat at the table. As one of the senior drivers of our process landscape, you work alongside the wider team rather than alone, and you are a trusted senior voice on how our processes and projects fit together across markets. Your work directly shapes how HR operations functions at Flix, today in Europe and tomorrow on a global scale.

Our People Operations team is going through a significant digital transformation, with AI as a central part of how we are rethinking the way we work. Multiple projects are running in parallel across European and global scope, and this role contributes directly to that agenda. You do not need to arrive with deep AI expertise, but you need to be someone who is genuinely interested in exploring what AI-driven approaches can do for People Operations and who wants to grow with us in that direction. We have the people and the knowledge to develop these capabilities together.

This role is based in Berlin (hybrid model).

About the Role

  • Process Landscape Management & Optimization: Analyze, document, and continuously advance our People Operations process landscape across Europe. Map existing workflows, identify bottlenecks, and design lean, standardized, and scalable processes with global applicability in mind, keeping documentation and standards up to date as the organization evolves. Working with the Digital Transformation and Tech teams, you translate operational pain points into clear requirements, and drive automation where it creates real value on the ground
  • End-to-End Project Leadership & Change Management: Own complex, cross-functional HR initiatives end to end, including policy rollouts, compliance frameworks, operational restructuring, and transformation projects. You (co)-lead these independently from scoping through execution to handover, set the pace and the milestones, manage stakeholders and dependencies across markets, create operational playbooks, and ensure teams transition smoothly to new ways of working
  • Central Ops Counterpart: You are the central point of contact and the representative for People Operations in cross-functional projects, most importantly with our People Partners and the Digital Transformation team, and additionally with our Centers of Excellence and other stakeholders such as Finance. You make sure People Operations has a clear, informed voice in these initiatives across Europe and at global level, and you bring the operational perspective consistently into every cross-functional conversation
  • Day-to-Day Enablement: You actively support local European People Ops Managers by delivering tangible process improvements that make their daily work faster, safer, and easier

About You

  • Experience: 5+ years in HR Operations, HR Project Management, within a fast-paced, international organization or matrix environment
  • Process Expertise: Deep, hands-on track record of designing, mapping, and implementing complex HR processes, and of being the go-to person others rely on when a process spans multiple teams, departments, and markets
  • Project Management: You (co)-lead cross-functional projects end to end and independently, manage diverse stakeholders and dependencies, and keep scope, timelines, and budgets in check without close supervision
  • Tech-Savvy & AI Mindset: You have a solid understanding of modern HRIS and HR Service Delivery tools. You make decisions based on data and are genuinely curious about what AI and automation can do for People Operations. You do not need to be an expert today, but the interest and openness need to be there. We invest in building these capabilities together
  • Communicator: You can align different departments, push back constructively when needed, and simplify complex operational topics for any audience. Fluent in English; additional European languages, especially German, are a strong plus
  • Mindset: You push boundaries to challenge the status quo, and you build for generations by creating robust, audit-proof frameworks rather than quick fixes

We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!  

What We Offer

  • Travel perks: 12 free Flix vouchers + 12 discount vouchers for friends & family. 
  • Work from (M)Anywhere: Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year. 
  • Hybrid work model: We are an office-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life. 
  • Wellbeing support: Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members. 
  • Learning & Development: Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert-led sessions to grow your skills. 
  • Mentoring Program: Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career. 

To view more local benefits specific to each office location, please check out this link: Locations - Flix Career

Why Join Flix?

At Flix, you'll find teams that rally together to overcome challenges and spark creativity. We believe in ownership culture - giving you the freedom to take initiative, make an impact, and shape your own career path.
As we continue to expand across the globe, you can make a real difference in how we work.

If you're ready to grow and lead your journey, Flix is the place for you!

jobs.title: Digital Account Executive, Technology -  Axicom
Founding Product Builder, Operations
jobs.description:
Founding Product Builder, Operations

Odin is building the investment infrastructure for the future of private markets.
We believe capital is one of the most powerful tools for shaping the world - and more people should know how to put it to work. Our mission is to make it radically easier to raise and deploy capital, so that anyone, anywhere, can back the companies and ideas they believe in.

Our first product is a full-stack platform for launching and running private investment firms, allowing you to run everything from your phone - think Shopify for VC and PE. We handle all the infrastructure: from legal structuring and investor onboarding to KYC/AML, payments, tax, reporting, and exits.

We're already trusted by over 10,000 angels, VCs, and founders. We administer over $750m in assets, covering investments from pre-seed to series E. This includes household names like ElevenLabs, OpenAI, SpaceX, xAI, Anduril, etc. but also new companies creating everything from synthetic brains to small nuclear reactors.

Why we're hiring

  • We are automating a decades old part of the financial services industry. AI pilled builders like you are the beating heart of this plan, because LLMs & agents allow us to turn this services business entirely into software.

  • This is a product role, and your product is how Odin operates. Think of it as our ghostbuster: every operational problem lands with you, you decide what gets fixed, and you ship most of the fixes yourself rather than writing tickets for someone else.

  • We're post-PMF, fast-growing, and rolling out new products (fund admin) & geographies (USA). Customer & deal volume is climbing fast.

  • Today we're on track for roughly 700 deals a year, with a team of ~20, and we'll process $500m-$750m of investment in 2026 alone.

  • The next goal is 7,000 deals a year and billions in annual investment flows.

  • We believe this can be achieved with a team of around 50 people. But it will only be possible if we turn human-driven services workflows into software.

  • Odin's operations run on around 50 processes, some code and some people, and plenty still held together by spreadsheets. Your job is to take each one apart, question why it exists, then rebuild it or kill it.

  • The simplest way to think about it: the numerator is how many deals we close, the denominator is what each deal costs us to run. You'll focus on the denominator, and the right person won't be able to stop themselves thinking about the numerator too.

  • We expect the right hire to be spending more time in Claude Code than in Excel, email or anything else.

What you'll own

  • Triage: Every operational problem comes to you before it reaches product and engineering. For each one you decide: scope it so precisely that engineering knows exactly what to build, or build it yourself.

  • Cost per deal: There will be big early wins where a whole process can be ripped out and replaced. After that, doubling ops efficiency comes from 150 small changes, and you'll be the one making them.

  • Automation: You'll sit with the deal operations team, learn each workflow end to end, then build what replaces it. Most of what you ship you'll build without engineering. What does go to them arrives simple, scoped and usually with a working prototype attached.

  • Deleting things and saying no: You decide what belongs in our processes and what doesn't. If a request from sales doesn't scale and isn't highly profitable we don't do it. If a way of working exists for no good reason, you kill it.

  • The ops team: You'll lead the core deal operations team, deciding where their time goes while you rebuild the work around them.

What we're looking for

  • You build, not buy: Clear evidence, at work or in your own time, that you've built real solutions with AI with no budget and no engineers. Buying a tool or setting up workflows in Sheets doesn't count. We want to see what you've shipped in Claude Code or similar.

  • Founder or product DNA: You've founded something, been early on a founding team, or worked as a product manager. That usually means four or more years of experience and a track record of finishing what you start.

  • Systems thinker: You look at any process the way a good product manager looks at a product: What's the job? Why are we doing this at all? What's the smallest, simplest system that achieves the goal? You think about the whole business, not just your corner of it.
    A lot of what happens in fund admin is inherited convention, an industry "given", or a constraint of some third party. You should find it physically difficult to accept any of that.

  • In the details and extremely on top of things: You understand every single aspect of our systems end to end. You close loops, you chase, you push hard to get things done.

  • Numerate: Comfortable with financial mechanics, strong mental arithmetic. You'll be automating a lot of numerical work - carry, allocations, fee calculations, distributions, and the edge cases that make all of them interesting.

  • Big plus: regulated financial services background: Fund administration, custody, payments, brokerage, audit, tax or another back office function. Useful, but not required. We care much more about the traits you have and the things you can build than specific skills or experience on your CV.

How we work

There are five things we care about deeply:

  1. Reason from the ground up
    Seek to understand what is true by always asking why. Do not trust convention or experts.

  2. Speed begets speed
    We work fast. Speed compounds, it's the best form of defensibility, and it's energising to be around. If you work slowly, or tolerate slow work around you, you do not belong at Odin.

  3. Take ownership
    Do not wait for permission to do things. Find the answer, force the thing into existence and hold others to an extremely high standard - the same standard you hold yourself to.

  4. Brutal honesty
    If work doesn't meet the bar, people need to hear it, and the right people want to.

  5. Truly excellent customer service
    Be a stickler for detail in every single interaction a customer has with us, and always strive to make this experience better, smoother, faster.

This role is probably not for you if

  • You'd rather write specs and hand tickets to engineers than build the thing yourself;

  • You prefer close management of your responsibilities;

  • You are risk-averse;

  • You want a 9-5;

  • You take yourself too seriously;

  • You care about working for a company that's raised lots of money rather than one that's extremely capital efficient and focused on building a profitable giant that has a positive economic impact

Salary

£90k - £120k base, plus a meaningful equity grant. We're flexible on the mix of cash and equity.

Hiring process

Three stages, usually inside two weeks, with detailed feedback within 24 hours of each one. A call with our Head of People, an in-person session with the founders where you solve a real Odin problem end to end with AI, then a final with the founders. The last two can run on the same day.

Location & ways of working

jobs.title: (Senior) Logistics Lead - 3PL Management
jobs.description:
(Senior) Logistics Lead - 3PL Management

Position Overview

Axelera AI builds the hardware that brings AI to the edge, and our chips, boards and systems are shipping to customers around the world. Every evaluation kit, sample and production order needs to arrive on time, intact and fully compliant.

As our (Senior) Logistics Lead, you will own these logistics at Axelera end to end. You will lead the relationship with our global 3PL partner, from business reviews and KPI management to speaking up when something goes wrong. At the same time, you will stay hands-on: receiving, kitting and dispatching goods for our R&D, test and lab teams. You will have the mandate to shape how logistics works at Axelera and to build processes and systems that scale with our growth.

Location: Eindhoven, Netherlands. On-site at least 3 days a week (with some flexibility around office presence, e.g. mornings only).

Responsibilities

3PL Partner Management

· Be the single point of contact with our 3PL partner for warehousing and express shipping

· Run regular business reviews, manage KPIs and SLAs, and drive corrective actions

· Escalate and resolve operational issues (delays, damages, losses, stock gaps) with the 3PL and carriers

· Translate Axelera's needs into clear instructions and work procedures for the 3PL

· Check 3PL invoices against agreed rates and keep logistics costs under control

· Evaluate and onboard new logistics partners and services when needed

Shipment Orchestration

· Plan and release outbound orders for customer deliveries, samples and evaluation kits

· Coordinate inbound flows from suppliers and contract manufacturers

· Manage express shipments with the major carriers: booking, labels, documents and tracking

· Keep customers and internal teams informed on status, lead times and exceptions

· Own the logistics mailbox and make sure every request is handled on time

Trade Compliance & Customs

· Prepare the right shipping and customs documents for every destination

· Apply correct Incoterms and work with customs brokers and customs on clearance, duties and VAT

· Run export checks, including denied-party and sanctions screening, together with our compliance owner

· Help maintain HS codes and export classifications for our products

Internal Logistics

· Receive, inspect, store and issue goods at our Eindhoven site

· Kit, pack and dispatch shipments for R&D, test and lab teams, including ESD-sensitive goods

· Move material between Axelera sites, the 3PL and external partners

· Keep storage areas organized, labelled and safe

Inventory Control & Process Improvement

· Make sure stock at the 3PL and at our sites matches NetSuite, and investigate differences

· Organize cycle counts and the year-end stock count with the 3PL and Finance

· Act as key user for logistics in NetSuite and work with Novutech to automate transactions and integrate 3PL data

· Write clear procedures and find ways to cut cost, lead time and manual work

Key Interfaces

External: 3PL partner, express carriers, freight forwarders, customs brokers and customs, suppliers and contract manufacturers, customers' logistics teams

Internal: Supply Chain and Planning, Sales and Customer Operations, Finance, R&D and test labs, Legal and Compliance

Qualifications

Required

· Bachelor's degree in logistics, supply chain or a related field, or equivalent experience

· 5+ years in logistics operations, ideally in electronics, semiconductors or high-tech, at a senior or lead level

· Proven experience managing a 3PL or logistics provider as a supplier, including business reviews, KPIs and escalations

· Familiarity with export/import documents, Incoterms, HS codes and customs procedures

· Experience with an ERP system (NetSuite preferred) and strong Excel skills

· Structured and proactive, and comfortable switching between managing partners and doing the physical work yourself

· Fluent in English; Dutch at B1 level or higher, enough to deal professionally with customs and local partners in writing/speaking without issues

· Living within commuting distance of Eindhoven

Preferred

· Knowledge of export control regulations (EU dual-use, US EAR) and sanctions screening

· Experience with ESD-safe handling and shipping dangerous goods such as lithium batteries

· Experience with ERP automation or system integration projects

What we offer 

This is your chance to shape and be part of a dynamic, fast-growing, international organization. We offer an attractive compensation package, including a pension plan, extensive employee insurances and the option to get company shares.   

An open culture that supports creativity and continual innovation is awaiting you. Collaborative ownership and freedom with responsibility is characteristic for the way we act and work as a team. 

At Axelera AI, we wholeheartedly embrace equal opportunity and hold diversity in the highest regard. Our steadfast commitment is to cultivate a warm and inclusive environment that empowers and celebrates every member of our team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds to join us in shaping the future of AI.

Axelera AI may at times work with external parties (such as recruiters, headhunters, or executive search firms) to support both publicly posted and confidential searches. Our hiring process never involves any payment from candidates, and we will never require you to use a particular paid service to be considered for a role. jobs.title: Staff Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Staff Data Engineer

Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.
.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Staff Data Engineer.

About the job

This position is needed to design, build, and optimize Twilio's next-generation unified data platforms and services to power strategic, data-driven business decisions.

As a senior technical leader on our Enterprise Data Engineering team, you will drive a massive, highly visible transformation to unify disparate data lakes into a single, high-performance platform. By combining classic dimensional modeling with cutting-edge AI, you will accelerate data delivery at an immense scale. This is your chance to solve complex architectural challenges, mentor rising talent, and directly influence Twilio’s strategic direction.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Architect and scale high-performance data platforms to unify acquired data lakes, improving delivery speed by leveraging AI-driven workflows.
  • Design robust ETL pipelines and data integration frameworks using Spark, dbt, and AWS to support rapidly growing enterprise data needs.
  • Establish rigorous data modeling standards (Dimensional, Medallion) and implement full-stack observability to ensure data trust.
  • Mentor peer engineers, promoting technical excellence and living our We > Me value through active collaboration with architects and product teams.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

Required:

  • 8+ years of professional data engineering experience with progressive technical leadership.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Advanced proficiency in languages, including scripting (e.g. Python, Scala, Java) and expert-level SQL.
  • Deep hands-on experience designing AWS cloud data infrastructure and scalable ETL pipelines (using Spark, dbt, or AWS Glue).
  • Expert knowledge of data modeling (Dimensional Modeling, Lakehouse/Medallion architectures).
  • Strong experience with distributed databases and query engines (such as Snowflake, Redshift, Athena, or Presto).
  • Proven track record of peer mentoring and collaborating with cross-functional teams.

Desired:

  • Master's degree in Computer Science.
  • Experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and CI/CD pipelines (Buildkite, ArgoCD).
  • Hands-on experience with ingestion systems (Kafka, Debezium, Meltano) and modern data formats (Parquet, Iceberg, Hudi).
  • Familiarity with relational/OLTP databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and OLAP databases (Clickhouse, Druid).
  • Experience leveraging Generative AI (LLMs, Langchain, Bedrock) to accelerate data delivery.

Location

This role will be remote, and based in Ireland.

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.
.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @twilio.com email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.
.

Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

Full-Time Ireland

jobs.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager | Spain | Remote
jobs.description:
Senior Product Marketing Manager | Spain | Remote

Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

The Opportunity:

We’re looking for an enthusiastic, tech-forward product marketer to grow our Observability products by boldly positioning them and running campaigns to attract, convert and retain customers. As a Senior Product Marketing Manager, you will be in charge of the messaging and positioning for a broad product area. Then you’ll work closely with product managers and the marketing team to deliver campaigns, content, events, and training that help buyers buy (and sellers sell) our value.

Product Marketing lives within the Product org rather than the Marketing org at Grafana Labs, and we think differently about the job. Rather than purely executing launches or campaigns, we want PMMs to teach product managers and engineers in our org how to think about growth and demand, and to codify product marketing knowledge into AI-forward tools and processes that anyone in the organization can use. For example, we all contribute product information to a shared knowledge base, which we use to generate enablement materials and decks.

Grafana Labs is a fast-paced and growing organization. As such, this role requires strategic skills, an interest in teaching, and hands-on tactical execution (blogs, webinar outlines, video scripts, etc). Our team is full of people who crave impact and independence - if you are seeking a role with narrow scope where you run a defined playbook, this is not the job for you.

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Actively partner with and teach product managers to define product value, messaging, and go-to-market strategy, from competitive positioning to sales enablement collateral.
  • Partner with product management, engineering and various go-to-market functions to create materials that help customers evaluate and adopt our products: reference architectures, implementation guides, detailed product information and more.
  • Own customer lifecycle campaigns (competitive positioning, retention, upsell/cross-sell) to strategically shape marketing programs and drive growth across the entire customer journey.
  • Conduct market and customer research to understand pain points, competition and opportunities.
  • Teach go-to-market and sales teams our products’ capabilities and the value they provide, deliver training and enablement, ensure customer facing teams are able to effectively engage with customers, partners, and prospects.

What Makes You a Great Fit:

  • 4+ years of relevant experience (product marketing, solutions marketing, product management)
  • Experience with marketing and selling to a technical audience
  • A passion for open source, cloud native, and infrastructure technologies
  • Proven ability to take on complex projects and efficiently drive them from start to finish
  • Ability to clearly articulate the value of technical products to customers and sellers alike
  • Experience leading product or feature launches autonomously as well as part of a team
  • Experience working with AI tools like ChatGPT and Claude to automate messaging and workflows
  • Comfort working with a variety of internal and external stakeholders in complicated processes
  • Strong product and technical curiosity that translate to clear packaging, positioning, and messaging
  • Demonstrated quantitative analytical skills for analyzing campaign performance, evaluating lifecycle metrics, and making data-driven recommendations.
  • Exceptional writing and communication skills
  • A high “say-do” ratio in executing and delivering impact

Compensation & Rewards:

In Spain, the base compensation range for this role is EUR 82,988 - EUR 99,586. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer: Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.

#LI-Remote

For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our privacy policy.

  • Set and uphold engineering standards for quality, security and operability, including how teams evaluate and validate AI-assisted work.
  • Lead improvements across Grafana and R&D that increase engineering productivity and improve business outcomes.
  • Participate in the engineering management on-call rota, coordinate responses and drive improvements that reduce recurring disruption. Regularly use Grafana’s AI capabilities for observability, incident investigation and management, bringing that experience into product feedback and roadmap decisions.

jobs.description:
Business Development Lead (German-speaking)

Business Development Lead (German-speaking)
Full-time (40 hours per week), On-site (Berlin, Germany)

 

About Us
At The Global Talent Co., we provide opportunities to work with leading innovative technology companies worldwide, offering stable employment, competitive compensation, career growth, and access to a community of 25,000+ like-minded marketing professionals.

 

About the Company
You'll be joining a fast-scaling, founder-led B2B company. With a proven track record, real clients, and a growing international presence across Europe, the business is at an exciting inflection point — systematising operations through smart processes, technology, and AI to become a European market leader.

 

The Role
As Commercial Growth Lead you will own the commercial engine — from inbound and outbound sales to aftersales, CRM governance, and customer retention. This is a high-ownership role for someone ready to make meaningful progress from day one: building structure where it's needed, optimising what already works, and leading a growing team of sales consultants towards ambitious targets. The company moves fast and expects you to move with it.

You'll work directly with the founders — shaping commercial strategy and executing with real discipline. This role isn't for someone waiting to be told what to do. It's for someone who spots what needs fixing, fixes it, and tracks the results. If you want to grow fast and have the company invest in your growth, this is the environment for it.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Grow and develop the inbound sales team, outbound function, aftersales, and offline conversion channels

  • Own sales targets and metrics — build structured plans and hold the team accountable to results

  • Drive customer satisfaction and retention across key brand clients

  • Oversee the CRM system and ensure the full customer journey is tracked, managed, and optimised

  • Develop deep market and customer understanding to inform pricing, product, and commercial strategy

  • Manage client relationships professionally, including escalations and disputes

  • Identify and implement AI-native workflow improvements that increase team efficiency and output

  • Report performance clearly to founders and use data to drive commercial decisions

     

Ideal Candidate

  • Minimum 3 years of experience in sales, with demonstrated experience leading or developing a team

  • Based in Berlin or genuinely willing to relocate — this is a full-time on-site role

  • Native-level German speaker — this is a non-negotiable requirement

  • Professional working English, written and verbal

  • Strong sense of ownership — you hold yourself and your team accountable for outcomes, not just activities

  • Confident with CRM systems, pipeline management, and data-driven decision-making

  • Genuinely excited about AI-native tools and workflow automation — not just aware of them, actually using them

  • Ready to deliver visible commercial impact within the first 90 days

     

Nice to Have

  • Experience in a B2B environment with complex client relationships

  • Background in a founder-led or high-growth company where structure was being built, not inherited

  • Familiarity with AI-assisted sales workflows or CRM automation tools

     

Tools & Stack
CRM (HubSpot or Salesforce), AI workflow tools, Microsoft Office / Google Workspace

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer (Kotlin) - Cards
jobs.description:
Senior Backend Engineer (Kotlin) - Cards

SumUp builds simple, affordable financial tools that help small businesses get paid, manage their money, and grow. Beyond payments, we offer a number of financial products - including business banking, card products, lending, and invoicing — giving merchants everything they need to manage their payments and finances in one place.

The Cards squad owns the systems that power card issuing, and transaction processing for merchants across Europe, handling millions of transactions every day. We're scaling these systems to support new product capabilities and lay the foundations for a more global, resilient platform, and we're looking for a senior backend engineer who can take real ownership of this complex, high-throughput work while raising the technical bar for the rest of the squad.

It's a chance to shape distributed systems architecture at scale, mentor engineers around you, and build infrastructure that genuinely matters to small businesses.

🎥 Join us in our Sofia Team - get a feel for our Sofia office here.

What you'll do

  • Own and drive the end-to-end delivery of backend services within the Cards EU domain, including observability, testing, and production support
  • Lead architectural discussions and shape the technical roadmap by proposing solutions for complex, distributed systems challenges
  • Partner with engineers in adjacent squads and the product manager to shape and refine the squad backlog
  • Mentor engineers through code and design reviews, pragmatic technical trade offs, and knowledge sharing that raises the team's engineering standards
  • Participate in incident reviews and the on-call rotation, taking accountability for the reliability of the services the team builds
  • Apply and champion AI tooling to accelerate engineering workflows, and help raise the team's overall AI literacy

You'll be great for this role if…

  • Proven track record delivering production-ready backend services end to end, including testing, monitoring, and incident response, on a modern cloud-native stack.
  • Production experience with Kotlin and genuine curiosity about picking up additional languages such as Golang.
  • Solid understanding of distributed systems, API design, data modelling, and working with relational databases
  • Hands on experience in containerisation, orchestration, and CI/CD practices
  • Take ownership of ambiguous problems and turn them into clear, scalable, and maintainable solutions.
  • Comfort working across teams and communicating clearly in written and spoken English in a professional setting
  • Genuine curiosity about the product domain - comfortable applying a backend lens during feature refinement and thinking beyond the code to understand how your work shapes the user experience 

Why you should join SumUp

  • 🌍 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide, from our modern Sofia office. This involves an office-first setup
  • 🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced
  • 🚀 Enrolment onto our Virtual Stock Option programme: you will own a stake in SumUp's future success
  • 📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget of €2000 and 10 paid days of educational leave which can be used to attend conferences and/or advance your career through further education
  • 🏖 Generous time off: 25 days of paid leave, plus one extra day per year of service (up to 35), along with public holidays and special leave options
  • 🏥 Peace of mind: additional health insurance and life insurance
  • 💪 Stay active: on-site yoga and a co-sponsored Multisport card offering access to hundreds of sports facilities
  • 🍽 Meal support: benefit from a tax-free food voucher program plus flexibility via our Re:Benefits platform
  • 🚌 Easy commute: free shuttle buses connecting directly to Joliot-Curie metro station
  • 🌴 Break4me: 1-month sabbatical after 3 years of service
  • 🔗 Referral Bonus: earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team

About SumUp

Be empowered to do more that matters.

At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe by providing simple and affordable tools that allow them to thrive. Today, over 4 million businesses in 37 markets rely on SumUp as their financial partner to manage payments, finance and customer relationships.

Our commitment to small businesses is reflected in our diverse team of over 3,000 SumUppers from over 90 nationalities, united by global collaboration and an innovative mindset. Founding Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Founding Software Engineer

Odin is building the investment infrastructure for the future of private markets.
We believe capital is one of the most powerful tools for shaping the world - and more people should know how to put it to work. Our mission is to make it radically easier to raise and deploy capital, so that anyone, anywhere, can back the companies and ideas they believe in.

Our first product is a full-stack platform for launching and running private investment firms - think Shopify for VC and PE. We handle all the infrastructure: from legal structuring and investor onboarding to KYC/AML, payments, tax, reporting, and exits.

We’re already trusted by over 10,000 angels, VCs, and founders. We administer over $500m in assets, covering investments from pre-seed to series E. This includes household names like ElevenLabs, OpenAI, SpaceX, xAI, Anduril, etc. but also new companies creating everything from synthetic brains to small nuclear reactors.

Why we’re hiring

  • We're post-PMF and revenue generating, launching in the US ahead of a Series A. Early enough that you'll shape how engineering works here, late enough that you're not gambling on whether the product works.

  • You'll own significant parts of the product and ship the things customers feel most. It's a regulated platform moving money across multiple jurisdictions, so the work has to be right and it still has to be fast.

  • We also want the bar to move while you're here. Senior engineers set the standard through the quality of what they ship, how they review, and the problems they choose to fix rather than work around.

  • Alongside that, we're rethinking how we build with AI. We use the tools, but we know there's a step change available to teams who redesign their whole workflow around them rather than adding AI to how they already work. If you've already done that somewhere else, you'll have a lot of room here.

What we're looking for

  • You've built and run non-trivial production systems, and you've learned what works in which situations rather than defaulting to one approach.

  • Strong architectural judgement. Most of our code is now written by an LLM, which means you need to own the decisions around it: how the system is structured, what the patterns are, whether the thing being built is the right thing at all. Our stack is Go, and if you learn quickly, not having written it isn't a problem.

  • A serious AI practice. You can talk specifically about how AI has changed the way you build, what it's actually made faster, and what you've shared with the teams you've worked in.

  • Directness. You give feedback when something isn't good enough and take it just as well.

  • Good instincts about what's worth doing. You know when something needs to be built properly and when it doesn't, and you push for the work that makes everyone around you faster.

Probably not for you if

You think the impact of AI on engineering is overstated. You'd rather be handed a fully specified ticket than question the brief. Or the learning curve across finance, compliance and multiple jurisdictions sounds like a chore rather than the interesting part.

The people who do well here find that last bit genuinely interesting. Understanding how capital actually moves, and what the rules allow in each jurisdiction, is most of what makes this product hard to build and hard to copy.

Working at Odin

Two setups work for this role: London hybrid (three days a week in the office) or remote from elsewhere in the UK with quarterly trips to London.

You’ll take full ownership of your vertical, dive deep into its toughest challenges, and lead bold initiatives that unlock new levels of performance. You’ll design tech-enabled, scalable solutions that power Joko’s next stage of growth and efficiency.

From rethinking revenue funnels to automating internal tooling or reshaping cross-functional workflows, you’ll be a key driver of transformation across the company.

Content Operations

Product Operations

Marketing Operations

  • Structure and scale how we track, measure, and optimize marketing performance

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the role

As a Flight Control Intern, you explore how far an aircraft can be pushed beyond natural stability, and what performance that buys. Instability makes aircraft more agile, but only if the control system can keep them flying. You own your project end to end: you choose and build unstable airframes, identify their dynamics from flight data, design the control that stabilizes them, and measure the limits of what can be achieved. You work on agile, high-performance platforms in a fast-paced engineering team with an industrial, production-first mindset, flying frequently on a dedicated test range. You are a full member of the team, with visibility on how the company and its products evolve and a direct impact on what we ship.

Responsibilities
Select and justify unstable configurations to study, such as multirotor and VTOL (vertical take-off and landing), relaxed-stability fixed wings, and tailless, blended-wing or canard layouts.

  • Design and build the airframes yourself (foam, 3D printing, composites), integrate the avionics provided by the team, and repair after crashes.

  • Plan and run flight test campaigns with excitation maneuvers, and iterate quickly on a dedicated test range.

  • Identify the aircraft dynamics from flight data (system identification) and validate the models against analytical and simulated results.

  • Design and tune stabilizing controllers on PX4 or ArduPilot, then port them to Harmattan's in-house flight controller firmware.

  • Push the instability step by step, for example by moving the center of gravity aft or reducing control surfaces, and analyze stability margins.

  • Quantify the performance envelope, including the limits set by actuator bandwidth, sensor noise and latency, and the agility gained in return.

  • Build a reusable toolchain: a Python simulation workflow (for example JSBSim or Gazebo) validated on flight data, hardware-in-the-loop tests, flight test procedures and a data analysis pipeline.

  • Present concepts, results, and project status to the team and to wider audiences, and join team meetings to learn from other projects.

Candidate Requirements

  • Currently pursuing an MSc in Aerospace Engineering, Control, Robotics, or a related field.

  • Solid foundations in flight mechanics and control theory, ideally with experience in system identification or stability analysis.

  • Proficiency in Python. C/C++ and embedded firmware experience is a plus.

  • Hands-on building experience, such as RC aircraft, drones, or any fabrication project. Familiarity with PX4 or ArduPilot is a plus.

  • Comfort with flight testing, debugging in the field, and learning from the occasional crash.

  • Motivated, autonomous, and proactive, with the ability to own a project and communicate results clearly.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

The MLOps team at Gravis builds the data flow that turns raw recordings from our autonomous earthmoving machines (LiDAR point clouds, camera images, GNSS positions and hydraulic signals) into clean, searchable, training-ready datasets for our autonomy models.
 
As an intern, you will learn how data moves through Gravis today, explore data pipeline tools and try the most promising ones on real fleet data, and have the opportunity to help build a pipeline that runs in production on our GPU clusters and is used by our ML and robotics engineers every day, with direct mentorship from senior engineers.

Team Lead Customer Support (f/m/d)

UNSER PURPOSE BEI PLANCRAFT

Gemeinsam das Rückgrat des europäischen Handwerks aufbauen – mit moderner Software und smarten AI-Lösungen.
Wir entwickeln nicht einfach nur Software – wir haben die Mission, Handwerkerinnen und Handwerksbetrieben mehr Raum zu schaffen, indem wir sie mit einer praxisnahen SaaS-Lösung ausstatten, die so arbeitet wie sie: schnell, effizient und ohne unnötigen Admin-Aufwand. Unterstützt durch smarte AI-Funktionen genau dort, wo sie im Alltag wirklich helfen. Mit Tier 1 Investoren aus Europa und den USA wie Headline und Creandum sowie über 30.000 Handwerker:innen als Kundenbasis skalieren wir europaweit, um aus einzelnen, verstreuten Betrieben vernetzte und erfolgreiche Communities zu machen.
Wir glauben an zero admin, nicht zero personality – und wir entwickeln jede Funktion mit den Menschen im Blick, die die Sicherheitsschuhe tragen, nicht die Anzüge. Wir haben Bock, die Zukunft zu gestalten, zusammen als Team, und sind bodenständig in unserer Mission, die Macherinnen von morgen zu unterstützen.

DEINE MISSION BEI UNS

Als Team Lead Customer Support (f/m/d) bist du verantwortlich für die Führung und Weiterentwicklung unseres Customer Support Teams. Du baust einen skalierbaren, AI-gestützten und datengetriebenen Support auf, der unseren Kund:innen ein erstklassiges Serviceerlebnis bietet. Dabei verbindest du operatives Tagesgeschäft mit strategischer Weiterentwicklung, optimierst Prozesse und förderst dein Team gezielt in seiner fachlichen und persönlichen Entwicklung. Mit smarten Automatisierungen, klaren KPIs und einem starken Team schaffst du die Grundlage dafür, unseren Customer Support nachhaltig zu skalieren.

Deine Verantwortlichkeiten

  • Du führst, coachst und entwickelst unsere Customer Support Specialists weiter – mit regelmäßigem Feedback und gezielten Trainings begleitest du sie auf ihrem Weg vom Junior zum Mid-Level und Senior.

  • Du verantwortest das operative Tagesgeschäft im Support und stellst sicher, dass Tickets effizient zugewiesen, priorisiert und gemäß unseren SLAs und Qualitätsstandards bearbeitet werden.

  • Du bist erste Ansprechperson für Eskalationen und komplexe Kundenanfragen und übernimmst selbst anspruchsvolle oder dringende Supportfälle.

  • Du analysierst und optimierst relevante Support-KPIs wie Erreichbarkeit, Antwort- und Lösungszeiten, Ticket-Backlog und Kundenzufriedenheit.

  • Du optimierst die Einsatzplanung, Aufgabenverteilung und Supportprozesse, um die Kundenerreichbarkeit zu steigern.

  • Du treibst unseren AI-gestützten First-Level-Support voran – mit dem Ziel einen großen Teil der eingehenden Tickets automatisiert zu lösen, ohne Abstriche bei der Servicequalität zu machen.

  • Du erkennst Entwicklungspotenziale im Team und verbesserst die Performance durch gezieltes Coaching, Qualitätskontrollen und regelmäßige Feedbackgespräche.

  • Du entwickelst unsere Knowledge Base kontinuierlich weiter und stellst sicher, dass Hilfeartikel und Supportressourcen aktuell, verständlich und relevant bleiben.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Head of Customer Success zusammen, um die Supportstrategie weiterzuentwickeln, KPIs wöchentlich zu überprüfen und operative Verbesserungen umzusetzen.

  • Du arbeitest bereichsübergreifend mit RevOps, Customer Success und Product zusammen, um Kundenfeedback einzubringen, wiederkehrende Probleme zu lösen und weitere AI-Automatisierungspotenziale zu identifizieren.

DEIN PROFIL

Must-haves

  • Du bringst Erfahrung in der Führung eines Customer Support Teams mit, idealerweise als Team Lead oder in einer vergleichbaren Führungsrolle.

  • Du hast Erfahrung im People Management und Coaching und weißt, wie du Mitarbeitende gezielt förderst und in ihrer Karriereentwicklung begleitest.

  • Du kennst dich mit Customer Support Prozessen, SLA-Management, Performance-KPIs und Qualitätssicherung aus.

  • Du nutzt Daten und Reportings, um die Teamperformance zu analysieren, Verbesserungspotenziale zu erkennen und fundierte Entscheidungen zu treffen.

  • Du kannst auch bei hohem Ticketvolumen effektiv priorisieren und komplexe Kundenanliegen strukturiert lösen.

  • Du arbeitest hands-on und verbindest operative Mitarbeit im Support mit der Verantwortung für dein Team.

  • Du hast Erfahrung darin, Supportprozesse und Workflows zu optimieren und die operative Effizienz zu steigern.

  • Du überzeugst durch klare Kommunikation, analytisches Denken und eine lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch.

  • Du schätzt den persönlichen Austausch mit deinem Team und bist bereit, regelmäßig Zeit in unserem Hamburger Büro zu verbringen. Dabei bieten wir dir ein flexibles Setup, sodass du nicht zwingend in Hamburg wohnen musst. Wichtig ist uns, dass du für regelmäßige Onsite-Phasen vor Ort bist. Dein Onboarding findet in den ersten 3–4 Wochen in Hamburg statt.

  • Deutschkenntnisse auf C1/C2-Niveau sowie Englischkenntnisse auf mindestens B2-Niveau.

Nice-to-haves

  • Du hast bereits Customer Support Teams in einem schnell wachsenden SaaS-Unternehmen skaliert.

  • Du kennst dich mit AI-gestützten Supportlösungen und Automatisierungsworkflows aus.

  • Du hast Erfahrung mit Supportplattformen wie Intercom, Zendesk oder Freshdesk.

  • Du bringst Erfahrung im B2B-Kundensupport für Softwareprodukte mit.

  • Du kennst Analytics- und Datenvisualisierungstools wie Looker oder Power BI.

  • Du hast ein gutes Verständnis für den deutschen und österreichischen Kundenmarkt.

  • Du sprichst weitere Sprachen neben Deutsch und Englisch.

WARUM PLANCRAFT?

 

  • Team Spirit: Mit Leidenschaft, Engagement und echtem Bock setzen wir alles daran, unsere Mission gemeinsam zu verwirklichen. Team Spirit feiern wir regelmäßig: mit 3 großen Team Events im Jahr, 2 monatlichen lockeren Formaten in unserem HQ und einer starken Recognition Culture, in der wir kleine wie große Erfolge sichtbar machen und gemeinsam zelebrieren.

Silicon Operations Manager

Meet Arago and the Aragonians

Arago’s mission is to re-engineer the foundations of computing from first principles.

The explosive growth of AI is pushing the industry to rethink how processors are built. Arago is meeting that challenge with a proprietary technology that fuses optical and CMOS technologies to deliver an order-of-magnitude increase in performance.

Arago is the fastest, and currently the only, company to have built such a processor. It's backed by leading deep-tech investors and some of the most respected figures in semiconductors and computing, including the CEO of Arm, the founder of macOS who worked directly with Steve Jobs at Apple, an Nvidia Fellow, the Head of Optics at Google, and many other industry leaders.

Our work is guided by three clear values: do great things, move with high velocity, and operate as one unit. We work in a demanding environment where constant learning, ownership, and execution are expected, and where exceptional people have the opportunity to do their life’s work.

 

What you’ll do

Arago designs its own SoCs. As Silicon Operations Manager, you will own everything after design, from foundry handoff to volume production. You pick up the chip once front-end and physical design are done, and you are accountable for getting working parts in volume. That means managing the foundry, OSAT partners, and test house; co-designing the package; driving qualification and yield ramp; and owning cost, schedule, and supplier relationships.

This is not a coordinator role. You are the technical owner of the path from tapeout to shipped product.

Required Skills and Experience

  • 7+ years in semiconductor back-end / NPI, with at least one chip taken to production in a fabless context as the main contact with OSATs and foundries.

  • Direct experience managing OSATs and foundries (e.g. TSMC, GF, Samsung, Amkor, ASE).

  • Solid knowledge of advanced packaging: flip-chip, FCBGA, substrates, and package/die co-design.

  • ATE test and wafer sort experience, plus solid understanding of DFT handoff.

  • Knowledge of JEDEC qualification and reliability standards.

  • Engineering degree or PhD in microelectronics, materials, or electrical engineering.

  • Language: English at a proficient level.

Responsibilities

  • Own the tapeout-to-production flow: GDS handoff, masks, wafer starts, MPW vs. full-mask planning.

  • Select the package with OSATs and co-design it, flip-chip/BGA, substrate, bump and ball maps, thermal, SI/PI, in collaboration with the design team.

  • Drive wafer sort and final test: probe cards, ATE program bring-up, DFT pattern handoff.

  • Run qualification and reliability: JEDEC standards including HTOL, ESD, MSL, TC and others.

  • Lead yield analysis, failure analysis and corrective actions.

  • Manage suppliers, NRE and unit cost; contribute to supplier negotiations.

  • Plan the ramp to volume, manage supply and logistics, and maintain production documentation.

Nice to have

  • 2.5D/3D, chiplets, interposers (CoWoS, InFO).

  • Package design and simulation tools (Cadence APD/SiP, Ansys).

  • Statistical yield tools (JMP, Exensio/PDF).

  • Startup or scale-up experience; budget and contract ownership.

Pay and benefits

  • Competitive cash compensation, with final package based on location, experience, and the pay of team members in similar positions.

  • Meaningful stock option plan offered (included in the majority of full time offers).

  • Healthcare coverage (including family-friendly options), pension contributions, professional development support, and 25 days of PTO, in addition to public holidays.

  • Ownership of a key technical domain, with significant vertical and/or horizontal growth opportunities, based on performance and individual drive.

  • Partner with Global Product Knowledge to support product training on the French market

Who you are

  • You have 10+ years of relevant experience, with a proven track record of delivering GTM/product positioning strategies end-to-end, from go-to-market design to execution

jobs.title: Product Safety & Certification Engineer
jobs.description:
Product Safety & Certification Engineer

About EH Energy Engineering

EH Energy is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product delivers a significantly more compact fuel cell system with high power density and lower production costs. In response to the challenges of climate change and the global shift toward decentralized energy, EH Energy provides high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners.

To support our rapid growth and bring our systems to global markets, we are seeking a Certification Engineer. In this critical role, you will take full ownership of our product compliance roadmap, bridging the gap between innovative engineering and strict global regulations. You will lead hazard and risk assessments, define certification strategies across international markets (EU, North America, marine), and interface directly with notified bodies and classification societies to ensure our fuel cell systems are safe, fully compliant, and market-ready.

This role requires a full-time, on-site presence at our office in Nyon, Switzerland. We are unable to offer remote or hybrid arrangements, so candidates should be based locally or prepared to relocate.

 

Key responsibilities

Certification strategy and project management

  • Identify applicable directives, regulations, harmonised standards and class rules early in the development cycle and translate them into design requirements (EU, North America, marine)

  • Select and manage notified bodies, NRTLs, classification societies and test laboratories, own budgets, schedules and contracts for certification work

  • Plan and witness type tests, factory acceptance tests (FAT) and site acceptance tests (SAT)

Safety engineering and risk analysis

  • Lead risk assessments to ISO 12100 and hazard studies (HAZID, HAZOP to IEC 61882)

  • Lead design and process FMEA (IEC 60812) for stacks, balance of plant, containers and fuel processing

  • Run explosion-protection assessments: hazardous area classification (IEC 60079-10-1), ventilation and gas detection concepts, and equipment selection

  • Specify and verify safety functions to ISO 13849 (PL) and IEC 61508, including safety requirement specifications and validation reports

Compliance and technical documentation

  • Compile and maintain technical construction files, CE Declarations of Conformity, type-approval dossiers and certification reports

  • Write and review user, installation, operation and maintenance manuals, safety instructions and labelling

  • Maintain the standards register and assess the impact of new or revised standards

  • Manage certification change control: assess design changes for impact on existing certificates

Collaboration and continuous improvement

  • Act as the internal authority on certification scope: ensure in-service conformity of series production with certified designs, and support procurement and supply chain on material and packaging compliance (e.g. RoHS, packaging regulations).

  • Support design reviews and supplier qualification, including component certificates (ATEX, PED, electrical)

Standards and regulatory scope

The role covers, but is not limited to, the frameworks below. Working knowledge of most is expected; deep expertise in several is required

  • IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1:2021, ISO 16110-1 and Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230

     

Required qualifications

  • Master’s or bachelor’s degree in mechanical, electrical, chemical, process or safety engineering, or equivalent

  • 5+ years in product certification, compliance or safety engineering for complex electromechanical or process equipment (energy, gas, process, machinery or marine)

  • Direct experience with hydrogen or fuel cell systems and the IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1 or ISO 16110

  • Proven track record of taking products through CE marking and third-party certification with notified bodies or NRTLs

  • Hands-on experience leading FMEA, HAZOP and risk assessments, and documenting them to auditor standard

  • Solid knowledge of ATEX / IECEx, hazardous area classification and explosion-protection concepts

  • Experience specifying and validating safety functions to ISO 13849 and/or IEC 61508

  • Excellent technical writing: clear, structured, audit-ready technical files and manuals

  • Fluent English, written and spoken

     

Preferred qualifications and personal profile

Nice to have

  • Marine type approval with a classification society (DNV, LR, BV, ABS) or IGF Code projects

  • Experience with fuel processing, reformers or fire equipment, and with pressure equipment under PED

  • Certified functional safety qualification or ATEX/IECEx competence certification

  • Familiarity with North American codes (NEC, NFPA) and UL/CSA certification

Personal profile

  • Rigorous and structured, with a strong safety mindset and an eye for detail

  • Pragmatic: finds compliant solutions that keep development moving

  • Confident communicator with engineers, auditors, authorities and customers

  • Self-driven in a fast-growing, scale-up environment; comfortable owning topics end to end

     

Start date: Immediately

  • Erfahrung mit Qualitätsnormen und regulatorischen Anforderungen von Vorteil
