jobs.title: Growth Engineer
jobs.description:
Growth Engineer

TL;DR:
We’re looking for a full-stack engineer obsessed with Lovable’s growth engine - turning first touches into daily habits, and daily habits into a thriving ecosystem and real revenue. One sprint you’re shipping onboarding and activation flows; the next you’re crafting distribution rails and monetization features that help builders reach more users and keep them around. You think in React and APIs, but your first instinct is always: does this make users more successful, more often?

Coding skills + excellent taste + growth instincts + product obsession = you.

Why Lovable?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.

We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

What we’re looking for

  • 5+ years of experience building and growing user-facing products in high-performing teams, ideally including growth work, marketplaces/platforms, or communities.

  • Strong product sense and UX taste for multi-sided systems with creators, learners, and customers - you can see problems from multiple sides and design for all of them.

  • Comfortable using data, funnels, analytics, attribution, and A/B testing to shape what you build and how you iterate.

  • Skilled at designing, measuring, and iterating experiments, and thorough in setting up growth systems “right” from the start.

  • Experience collaborating across functions (design, marketing, partnerships, support, data) to launch and grow new product surfaces and ecosystems.

  • Enjoys designing reusable growth, ecosystem, and monetization tools that other builders can plug into, with a pragmatic and detail-oriented mindset.

  • Motivated by helping others succeed and by seeing impact through engagement, measurable results, and revenue - you care about the scoreboard as much as the code.

What you’ll do

In one sentence: You will build the growth, ecosystem, and monetization systems that make Lovable - and the apps built on it - sticky, discoverable, and revenue-generating.

  • Ship and iterate activation, monetization and retention experiences that create fast, repeatable value and turn first-time users into long-term fans.

  • Build distribution rails for user apps: SEO and performance, shareable moments, social previews, email and lifecycle journeys, and other growth hooks.

  • Ship marketplace and ecosystem features for publishing, discovering, and reusing apps, templates, components, and services - plus profiles, reviews, and matching between builders and customers.

  • Design and implement monetization and pricing flows: payments, subscriptions, access control, plans, paywalls, billing integration, and revenue-share models that work for creators, customers, and Lovable.

  • Build the analytics and experimentation foundations - events, funnels, attribution, and A/B tests - so the team can understand what works and double down on it.

  • Collaborate closely with design, marketing, partnerships, and support to launch and grow new surfaces across the product and ecosystem.

  • Keep the experience relentlessly Lovable while making growth the engine, not the afterthought.

Our tech stack

We're building with tools that both humans and AI love:

  • Frontend: React

  • Backend: Golang and Rust

  • Cloud: Cloudflare, GCP, AWS, many LLM providers

  • DevOps and tooling: GitHub Actions, Grafana, OTEL, infra-as-code (Terraform)

About your application

Please submit your application in English. It’s our company language, so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join.

We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested, please apply through our careers portal.

jobs.title: Ops Strategy Manager - DE
jobs.description:
Ops Strategy Manager - DE

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

Germany is one of iwoca's core markets, with its own Operations teams across Customer Success, Credit Analysis and Collections. The DE Operations Strategy team is the thought partner to those teams. We exist to understand Operations performance, find where Ops adds the most commercial value, and make the changes that get us there. We're a small team with a startup mindset: we challenge assumptions, prototype quickly, pilot in a lean way, and scale what works.

The role

As an Operations Strategy Manager, you'll own some of the most important projects in our German Operations, from defining the problem through to rollout, across the whole customer journey from application to recovery. Projects could include:

  • Better underwriting. Redesigning how our Credit Analysts work alongside our credit models, so that their judgement systematically improves model decisions rather than working around them.

  • AI and automation in Operations. Using AI to give our teams richer customer context and remove low-value work – for example, cutting the time Account Managers spend preparing for calls, or drafting the first version of routine customer communications.

  • Smarter task distribution. Rethinking how work is prioritised and split between people and automated processes – from when an Account Manager should call a customer to which customers need a personal conversation at all – so that our teams' time goes where human judgement adds the most value.

  • Stronger recoveries. Using our growing book of defaulted loans to work out which contact strategies, payment arrangements and recovery routes lead to the best outcomes – for iwoca and for the customer.

Whatever the project, you'll ground decisions in evidence: designing and running split tests, doing your own analysis, and working with our Data Scientists to get even more out of our data. You'll work with Operations, Product and Engineering to put changes live, share recommendations directly with Operations leadership and the German management team, and be part of iwoca's wider community of Analysts and Data Scientists.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Strategy experience. You've worked in a top-tier strategy consultancy or in a strategic role at a tech or finance company.

  • Analytical foundations. You have a strong analytical background, through academic qualifications (such as a STEM degree) and professional experience.

  • First-principles thinking. You break complex problems into their core parts, challenge assumptions, and recommend well-reasoned, innovative solutions.

  • Execution. You've taken recommendations from concept to execution, with hands-on experience implementing product or process improvements.

  • Communication. You distil complex information into clear, engaging messages for a range of stakeholders – from Data Scientists and Operations Managers to C-level.

  • AI leverage. You use modern tools, including AI, to improve the quality, speed and rigour of your work, while staying responsible for accuracy and outcomes.

Bonus:

  • German language. Our customers are in Germany, so German helps day to day – but it's definitely not a requirement.

  • Coding abilities. You have experience using Python or SQL – either directly or through coding tools like Claude Code. If you haven't coded before, we'd want you to be excited to learn on the job.

  • Operational excellence. You've driven measurable improvements in a fast-growing operation.

  • Experimentation. You've designed, run and interpreted controlled experiments, including A/B tests, to inform operational or product decisions.

The salary

We expect to pay from £75,000 - £90,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, we prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the development of our team members. We value thought and skill diversity, and encourage people to explore new areas of interest, adopt better tools – including AI – and apply sound judgement so our products and decisions improve over time.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A choice between a dedicated dental plan or a health cash plan that reimburses everyday medical expenses.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

jobs.title: Test Development Engineer
jobs.description:
Test Development Engineer

Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecraft for humanity.

Here at The Exploration Company, we are developing, producing, and operating Nyx, a modular and reusable space orbital vehicle that can eventually be refuelled in orbit, and which carries cargo – and potentially humans in the long run. We are also developing different types of propulsion systems to power our future vehicles and missions. As a talented Test Development Engineer, you will be part of the team that is responsible for the development of test facilities for our future propulsion systems.


Key Responsibilities / Tasks:

In your capacity as a Test Development Engineer, your role will be continuously evolving, but day to day your duties may include:

  • Synthesise test bench requirements from user and operator needs and plan required verification methods and tests.

  • Translate engine test objectives and stakeholder needs into facility-level functional and performance requirements.

  • Perform technical trade-offs to determine the best choice of hardware, software, equipment, component, location etc for various test facilities.

  • Perform risk assessment analyses for future tests and developing mitigation actions to ensure personnel and hardware safety.

  • Provide technical inputs to cost, schedule, procurement, commissioning, maintainability, and facility acceptance planning.

  • Prepare and maintain P&IDs of test facilities based on test bench requirements and selecting components.

  • Undertaking preliminary design of the ground support equipment with minimal oversight.

  • Undertake hazard assessments of the test facility design (FMEA and HAZOPs) to determine if any additional changes to the design are required.

  • Work with the current test bench team to coordinate end-to-end activities of the development of test facilities including design, reviews, manufacturing, installation, commissioning, test operations, ongoing upgrades and maintenance.

  • Work with procurement, AIT and design teams during the development of test facilities to find the right balance of technical solutions, cost and lead time.

  • Presenting findings to team members and participating in design reviews and project discussions.


What we would love to see from you:

  • Bachelor's, master's or PhD in aerospace engineering, mechanical engineering, or a related field (Master’s and above preferred).

  • 2–5 years of experience in propulsion, test facility development, experimental engineering, or a related field.

    • Practical experience in the design, development, commissioning, or operation of test facilities, preferably for rocket propulsion systems.

    • Experience in test facility design for cryogenic propulsion systems is highly desirable. Relevant experience with other cryogenic or high-pressure fluid systems will also be considered.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret technical data, challenge assumptions, and make evidence-based engineering recommendations.

  • Proven ability to work autonomously on assigned technical topics while contributing effectively to a multidisciplinary engineering team.

  • Excellent communication and leadership skills, with the ability to convey complex concepts to diverse audiences.

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?  

We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly. 
 
The Exploration Company is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Relocation assistance is provided for those willing to relocate including visa sponsorship where applicable.  


All offers are contingent upon the successful completion of a background check, which will be subject to the country, role, and project you applied for. By submitting your application, you acknowledge and agree that any offer of employment may be conditional upon successful condition of this check. The Exploration Company partners with Zinc Work Limited located in the UK (Zinc), a third-party provider, to ensure this process as efficient and transparent as possible.

If applicable, you will receive an email from Zinc upon acceptance of your offer with a link to a secure portal where you can provide the required information to Zinc.

jobs.title: Agentic Product Manager
jobs.description:
Agentic Product Manager

About us:

Founded by former Google search engineers with PhDs in AI from ETH Zurich, DeepJudge helps legal teams unlock and apply the knowledge inside their organizations through world-class enterprise search and AI infrastructure – enabling them to automate workflows, build knowledge-powered applications, and turn institutional knowledge into a lasting advantage.

Every organization can license the same AI models, but no two organizations share the same institutional knowledge. Decades of experience, work product, and precedent are often fragmented across systems, underused, and inaccessible. DeepJudge makes this expertise instantly available and actionable – helping legal teams find the right information faster, surface relevant knowledge, and apply it where it matters most.

Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading law firms and legal teams, including Holland & Knight, Gunderson Dettmer, Cozen O’Connor, ArentFox Schiff, CMS Switzerland, Schoenherr, and others.

Headquartered in Switzerland with a growing team across North America and Europe, DeepJudge is shaping the future of how professional knowledge is discovered and applied.

At DeepJudge, we move with urgency, think rigorously, and work closely with our clients to build products that solve meaningful problems. If you want to help define how AI transforms professional knowledge work, we’d love to hear from you.

About the role:

We’re looking for a hands-on and strategically minded Product Manager to take the reins of our assistant surfaces and agent harness at DeepJudge. You’ll play a critical role in shaping the present and future of our platform by driving immediate impact across our go-to-market priorities while also thinking deeply about where we go next.

This is an opportunity to lead product in a high-caliber environment where you're empowered to innovate, move fast, and deliver real value to legal professionals at some of the most sophisticated law firms and legal departments in the world. This is an on-site role based in Zurich. You will report to the Head of Product.

We’re not building another AI wrapper. We’re building a product with real depth, differentiated by data access, search engine expertise, and deep customer understanding. Chat is quickly becoming the interface of choice, and we’re now moving towards long-horizon agentic tasks – right at the cutting edge of what’s proven in the market. We’re looking for someone who thrives in ambiguity, is energized by the opportunity to create, and knows how to “cook from scratch” — not just follow the norm.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Own product strategy, roadmap and execution across our Agentic Surfaces and Harness, powering DeepJudge’s advanced AI reasoning features, with a strong focus on prioritization, user impact, and business value

  • Evolve our chat interface to make sure the user experience is the best fit for our target use cases

  • Prioritize feature requests across customers, vertical product areas and new strategic initiatives, balancing short-term go-to-market optimization with long-term discovery and strategic vision

  • Evolve our evaluation datasets and infrastructure to continuously improve our ability to take launch decisions with confidence

  • Assess the speed, quality and cost profile of model or harness changes and drive decision-making across tech and product leadership

  • Proactively identify new technologies and follow the latest agentic AI trends to drive efficiency and performance of complex, long-horizon tasks

  • Work directly with engineering leads to define and ship high-quality features fast

  • Collaborate with Design and Product Marketing to craft delightful and intuitive user experiences

  • Engage deeply with customers and prospects to gather insights, validate ideas, and translate feedback into roadmap priorities – combining direct feedback with scaled usage analysis to understand how our products are used, and sharing those learnings across the organization

  • Lead cross-functional initiatives that drive adoption, engagement, and measurable value for our users

  • Take ownership of product decision-making across our agentic product area

You're a great fit if you:

  • Have strong product instincts and 5+ years of experience in digital product management, with a track record of building and launching impactful B2B SaaS products

  • Have hands-on experience building and shipping agentic applications and RAG systems – going beyond basic chatbot or AI workflow features

  • Have a deep understanding of agent evaluation techniques and have built or evolved evaluation datasets and processes before

  • Are familiar with the latest agentic AI trends and concepts – and keep following them

  • Are comfortable leading in a dynamic, fast-paced environment — from writing specs to running discovery calls to shipping fast

  • Think holistically about user problems, systems, and long-term platform value

  • Are humble, curious, and opinionated in the right ways — you seek input but aren’t afraid to take a stand

  • Don’t just follow frameworks or "best practices" — you know when to break them

  • Are energized by having a lot of ownership and working closely with smart, mission-driven teammates

  • Are able to work on-site from our Zurich office

  • Bonus: You have legal domain familiarity, or experience in search and knowledge management, agentic search and data retrieval, or LegalTech – or you’ve worked in/with law firms, legal departments, or regulated industries

What you can look forward to:

  • A high-impact role in shaping a product and company with huge potential

  • The chance to work on the cutting edge of long-horizon agentic AI, applied to real-world legal work

  • A strong, technical, and collaborative team that’s serious about building great software

  • A culture that encourages experimentation, curiosity, and thoughtful decision-making

At DeepJudge, we believe great teams are built on diverse perspectives and experiences. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to fostering an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can thrive. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.description:
Design Engineer

About AMINI

AMINI advises, designs, and delivers across strategy, infrastructure, and AI. We work directly with clients on technology decisions, architecture, projects, and AI implementations - and we ship our own products alongside client work (andock.app, mrkr.app, it-provider.ch, and others).

We’re an ambitious team based in Zug and Zurich - this is your chance to build something remarkable together with a leading edge team.

The Role

We’re looking for an AI-Native Design Engineer who treats interfaces as a craft - the place where business intent, technical constraints, and usability meet.

You’ll own the design and frontend implementation of experiences across our own products and selected client projects. This is not a pure design role and not a pure engineering role. It’s for someone who moves fluidly between both and ships things that feel considered, polished, and inevitable. Design taste is obviously a must in this role.

You’ll work closely with architects, solution engineers, and client teams. You’ll have real ownership and a direct path from idea to production.

What You’ll Do

jobs.title: Flight Mechanics Engineer - System Identification
jobs.description:
Flight Mechanics Engineer - System Identification

About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the role

Every airframe Harmattan AI flies starts with a model. System identification turns flight data into the verified dynamics that guidance and control are designed, tuned and trained on. It is the foundation of an autopilot that adapts across multirotors, fixed wings, VTOLs and missiles.

As a Flight Mechanics Engineer - System Identification, working out of Zurich, you will own the path from flight test to identified model. You will design and run your own experiments, build a repeatable identification pipeline, and deliver models the G&C team can trust.

 
 

Responsibilities

  • Experiment Design & Flight Test: Plan and run your own identification tests, from excitation design to flight tests, including coordinating with the .

  • Model Identification: Identify rigid-body, aerodynamic, propulsion and actuator dynamics using frequency and time-domain methods, including closed-loop identification on vehicles flown under a controller.

  • Propulsion & Actuators: Characterize motors, ESCs, propellers and control surfaces, including bandwidth, delays, saturation, and thermal and battery effects.

  • Identification Pipeline: Build and maintain an automated, reproducible pipeline from flight logs to identified model. This covers ingestion, data-quality checks, estimation, validation and reporting.

  • Model Validation: Validate models against held-out flight data, quantify uncertainty, and make sure each model is fit for purpose: controller design, simulation, or training learned G&C.

  • New Airframes: Extend the capability from multirotors to control-surface multirotors, fixed wings, tail-sitters and missiles.

  • Simulation & G&C Support: Deliver models into simulation, SITL and HITL, and work closely with control, guidance and embedded engineers to close the loop between models and flight results.

  • Mentorship: Depending on seniority, support the team by mentoring junior engineers and interns.

 
 

Candidate Requirements

  • Educational Background: A strong academic record with a degree in aerospace, control, mechanical engineering or a related STEM field. A practical track record matters more than the specific degree.

  • System Identification: Proven experience identifying dynamic models of flying platforms from real data, in both the frequency and time domain, including the pitfalls of closed-loop data.

  • Flight Mechanics & Control: Solid grasp of rigid-body dynamics, aerodynamic forces and moments, non-dimensionalization, stability modes and propulsion models. Also enough control background to know what the model will be used for.

  • Flight Testing: Hands-on experience planning and running flight tests and working from raw, imperfect logs.

  • Software: Strong Python and scientific computing skills, with the discipline to build tools others can rerun.

 

Nice to have

  • Rigorous about data quality, uncertainty and validation; skeptical of models until they are proven.

  • Autonomous and hands-on, comfortable moving between bench, field and code.

  • Communicates clearly, able to present models and test results to engineers and senior stakeholders.

  • Thrives under pressure in a fast-paced environment with a no-task-is-too-small mentality.

  • Fixed-wing aerodynamic modeling; VTOL or tail-sitter dynamics; remote pilot certification; experience with real flight logs; structural or vibration modes; data-driven or learned dynamics models.

  • Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI’s mission of providing a defensive edge to allied nations through ethical, high-impact technology.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

jobs.title: Productmanager - Team Sellers
jobs.description:
Productmanager - Team Sellers

Onderaannemers ontvangen stapels offerteaanvragen, elk met honderden tekeningen, een bestek en een hoeveelhedenstaat. Veel uitzoekwerk dus, en lang niet elke aanvraag levert uiteindelijk werk op. Dat zien we terug in elk land waar we actief zijn, van Nederland tot Denemarken. Bij 12Build ben jij eigenaar van het product dat daar verandering in brengt.

We zoeken een AI-native productmanager voor Team Sellers, het team dat 12Build bouwt voor onderaannemers en leveranciers. Je hebt een goed gevoel voor product, voelt je thuis in data en werkt al dagelijks met AI-agents. Bovenal ben je graag bij klanten en werk je graag met mensen. Zo doen we productwerk bij 12Build.

Het team en de uitdaging
Team Sellers bestaat uit jou, een productdesigner, een lead developer en developers die samen met agents werken. Jij, de designer en de lead developer sturen het team samen aan als trio. Je bedient twee doelgroepen. Onderaannemers gebruiken 12Build om offerteaanvragen van hoofdaannemers te vinden, te beoordelen en erop te reageren. Leveranciers, de fabrikanten en groothandels in bouwmaterialen, gebruiken het om vroeg in projecten te komen en hun partners te bereiken. Leveranciers zijn een relatief nieuwe doelgroep voor ons, dus er valt nog veel te ontdekken.

Er is genoeg op te lossen. Onderaannemers zijn uren bezig met de vraag welke aanvragen het opstellen van een offerte waard zijn. De informatie die ze nodig hebben, zit verspreid over documenten, e-mails en telefoontjes met de hoofdaannemer. En ze willen zien wat het platform hun oplevert. AI verandert wat we voor onderaannemers en leveranciers kunnen bouwen, en jij bepaalt mee waar het het meeste verschil maakt.

Hoe we werken
12Build werkt sinds 2026 AI-first. Designers, developers en PM’s werken allemaal met agents, en we verbeteren die workflows continu om de weg van klantsignaal naar release korter te maken. Die manier van werken is nog lang niet af, en als PM heb je veel invloed op waar het naartoe gaat.

Een paar voorbeelden van waar we nu staan:

  • Onze bedrijfskennis staat in één gedeelde repository, de brain, waar mensen en agents allebei mee werken.

  • PM’s werken met Claude, gekoppeld aan tools als Amplitude, HubSpot, Linear en Slack.

  • Een wekelijkse signal radar verzamelt klantsignalen uit die bronnen en zet ze om in Linear-issues, met het bewijs erbij.



De PM bepaalt wat we bouwen en waarom. Agents nemen elke maand meer onderzoek, analyse en eerste versies over. De tijd die dat oplevert, gaat naar het werk dat alleen mensen kunnen doen: met klanten praten, relaties opbouwen en iedereen achter één richting krijgen. Samen met de PM’s van Team Buyers en Team Growth bepaal je welke workflow we als volgende verbeteren.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Je bouwt een heldere visie op waar het product voor onderaannemers en leveranciers de komende jaren naartoe gaat, en vertaalt die naar een strategie en roadmap. Die richting stem je af met de andere productteams, Commerce, Sales en Marketing, zodat het platform als geheel werkt.

  • Je bent een groot deel van je week bij onderaannemers en leveranciers en bouwt een netwerk op van klanten die met je meedenken.

  • Je managet je stakeholders. Je houdt het management en de commerciële teams op de hoogte, weegt verzoeken die botsen tegen elkaar af en legt helder uit waarom iets wel of niet op de roadmap staat.

  • Je bepaalt met je trio welke problemen we oplossen en in welke volgorde. Jij bent verantwoordelijk voor waarde en haalbaarheid: gaan klanten het gebruiken en ervoor betalen, en werkt het voor sales, marketing en customer success?

  • Je legt vooraf vast wanneer iets een succes is en meet dat daarna. Onze data-analisten ondersteunen je bij de diepere analyses. Zelf denk je in data: je leest een funnel of een retentiecurve en weet welke vraag je daarna stelt.

  • Samen met de designer werk je toe naar een heldere oplossing. De developers maken er issues van en bouwen het, en jij checkt of wat live gaat het probleem oplost waarmee je begon.

  • Je verbetert hoe het team met agents werkt. Je bouwt en onderhoudt skills, prompts en checks, en deelt wat werkt met de andere teams.

  • Je werkt met Product Marketing en Commerce aan positionering, packaging en lanceringen.


Over 12Build
Al bijna twintig jaar verbindt 12Build hoofdaannemers, onderaannemers en leveranciers. We zijn marktleider in Nederland en actief in België, Duitsland en Denemarken. Sinds januari 2026 zijn we onderdeel van de E1-groep, samen met EstimateOne en C-Link. Ongeveer honderd collega’s werken vanuit twee kantoren en vanuit huis, verspreid over Europa, met een gezonde dosis Drive, Openness en Happiness.

Sven’s tip for new 12Builders:

“Finding your own style and using it to inspire your colleagues is strongly encouraged!”


Werken bij 12Build, durf jij het aan? 


Wat breng je mee?

  • Minimaal vier jaar ervaring in B2B SaaS en een goed gevoel voor product. Dat kan als productmanager, of in een aanverwante rol van waaruit je de stap wilt maken. Eerdere ervaring met een marktplaats of een workflowproduct met veel documenten is een plus.

  • Je hebt eerder een productvisie en -strategie opgesteld en de mensen om je heen erin meegekregen.

  • Je kunt goed met mensen. Je bouwt snel vertrouwen op bij klanten en collega’s, luistert goed en brengt mensen met verschillende belangen samen achter één richting.

  • Technisch begrip. Je hebt nauw samengewerkt met developers, kent de gangbare termen en praat op niveau mee in een discussie met de lead developer.

  • Je denkt in data. Je voelt je thuis in productanalyse (Amplitude of vergelijkbaar), je kunt een experiment opzetten en je weet wanneer een getal te zwak is om een besluit op te baseren.

  • Praktijkervaring met agentic werken. Je gebruikt tools als Claude of Codex voor meer dan chatten, je hebt eigen workflows of skills gebouwd en je kunt ons er een laten zien. Je inspireert collega’s om anders te werken.

  • Je beoordeelt kritisch wat agents opleveren en staat achter wat onder jouw naam live gaat.

  • Je maakt je een nieuw domein snel eigen. Ervaring in de bouw helpt. Nieuwsgierigheid ernaar is een must.

  • Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands en Engels.


Wat bieden we?

  • Je kiest je eigen hardware: Windows, Mac of Linux.

  • Je werkt thuis en op kantoor. Voor de thuiswerkdagen krijg je een thuiswerkvergoeding.

  • Elke dag een gratis lunch op kantoor.

  • Een cultuur waar we echt in investeren, met teamdagen, uitjes, sprekers en workshops.

  • Een platte organisatie met korte lijnen.

Tot snel!

JUPUS baut die erste KI, die bis zu 80 % der Arbeit in Anwaltskanzleien selbstständig erledigt.

In nur drei Jahren ist JUPUS mit über 80 Mitarbeitenden in Köln und Berlin sowie einem international aufgestellten Tech- und Product-Team zu einem der am schnellsten wachsenden Legal-Tech-Unternehmen Europas geworden. Über 2.000 Anwältinnen und Anwälte arbeiten bereits mit JUPUS.

Und wir stehen erst am Anfang.

Deshalb suchen wir Account Executives, die nicht einfach nur Software verkaufen wollen, sondern Lust haben, einen neuen Markt mit aufzubauen, Verantwortung für ihren eigenen Erfolg zu übernehmen und gemeinsam mit uns eine ganze Branche zu verändern.

 

Was dich bei JUPUS erwartet:

Ein Produkt mit echtem Pain: Du verkaufst keine Nice-to-have-Software, sondern eine Lösung für konkrete Herausforderungen im Arbeitsalltag von Kanzleien.

  • Full-Cycle Sales mit Ownership: Du verantwortest deine Pipeline und deine Deals – von der ersten Opportunity bis zum Closing.

  • AI + perfektes Markt-Timing: Du arbeitest in einem Markt, der gerade fundamental durch neue Technologie verändert wird.

  • Kurze Wege: Du arbeitest eng mit Sales Leadership, Foundern sowie Product & Tech zusammen.

  • Hohe Standards ohne Ellenbogenkultur: Wir wollen gewinnen – als Team.

  • Schnelle Entwicklung: Wer performt und Verantwortung übernimmt, bekommt bei JUPUS die Möglichkeit, schnell den nächsten Schritt zu gehen.

Was du bei uns machst:

  • Du baust aktiv deine eigene Pipeline auf – über Outbound, Inbound und neue Wege, die du selbst mitentwickelst.

  • Du führst Discovery- und Demo-Gespräche mit Kanzleien und verstehst schnell, wo ihre größten Herausforderungen liegen.

  • Du übersetzt diese Herausforderungen in einen klaren Business Case für JUPUS.

  • Du beherrschst Einwandbehandlung, Follow-ups und Verhandlung und weißt, wie aus Interesse ein Abschluss wird.

Wer bei JUPUS erfolgreich wird:

Du musst nicht aus der Rechtsbranche kommen.

Viel wichtiger ist uns, wie du Vertrieb verstehst.

Du passt gut zu uns, wenn du:

  • gerne verkaufst und Energie daraus ziehst, Deals voranzubringen

  • selbst Chancen schaffst, statt darauf zu warten, dass sie dir jemand gibt

  • nach einem schwierigen Gespräch genauso konsequent weitermachst wie nach einem gewonnenen Deal

  • stark kommunizierst und komplexe Themen schnell auf den Punkt bringen kannst

  • Verantwortung für deine Pipeline und deine Ergebnisse übernimmst

  • direktes Feedback schätzt und dich kontinuierlich verbessern willst

  • Geschwindigkeit und Veränderung als Chance begreifst

  • ambitioniert bist, ohne dafür ein großes Ego zu brauchen

Was du idealerweise mitbringst:

  • Mindestens ein Jahr Erfahrung im B2B Sales – idealerweise in SaaS, Tech oder einem vergleichbaren High-Growth-Umfeld

  • Erfahrung im Full-Cycle Sales oder einen starken Track Record im Vertrieb und den klaren Wunsch, vollständige Deal-Verantwortung zu übernehmen

  • Sicherheit in Discovery, Einwandbehandlung und Closing

  • Eine ausgeprägte Outbound-Mentalität und Freude daran, aktiv neue Opportunities zu schaffen

  • Struktur und Konsequenz im Pipeline- und CRM-Management

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

  • Erfahrung mit HubSpot, Salesforce oder vergleichbaren CRM-Systemen ist ein Plus

Warum JUPUS gerade jetzt?

Weil Timing im Vertrieb einen Unterschied macht.

KI verändert gerade ganze Industrien – und der Rechtsmarkt steht dabei noch ganz am Anfang.

JUPUS hat ein Produkt, das bereits von über 2.000 Anwältinnen und Anwälten genutzt wird, einen riesigen adressierbaren Markt und die Ambition, eine der prägenden Plattformen dieser Transformation zu bauen.

Für dich bedeutet das: Du kommst nicht in eine fertige Sales-Organisation, in der du nur ein bestehendes Playbook ausführst.

Du bekommst die Möglichkeit, selbst zu verkaufen, sichtbar zu performen, Strukturen mitzuprägen und mit dem Unternehmen zu wachsen.

 

Was wir dir bieten:

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description:
Forward Deployed Engineer

We are building the first AI-native platform for automated product compliance in MedTech. REMATIQ turn hundreds of page of complex regulations (like MDR and FDA guidance) into structured, actionable requirements that plug directly into our customers’ development and quality processes. The result: life‑saving medical devices reach patients faster and safer.

About the job

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you build software with and for our customers. Existing customers ask for more than the standard product does. They want further use cases, integrations with their own systems and workflows specific to their organisation. You sit with the customer's team, scope the problem and build the solution end to end. It runs at the customer as custom software or becomes a feature of the REMATIQ web app.

This is a software engineering role with customer contact, not a consulting role. You work closely with our AI Deployment Strategists, Product and the platform team.

We believe in the value of in-person collaboration and work in a hybrid setup, with the team coming together in our office in the heart of Berlin-Mitte typically four days per week.

How you'll contribute

  • Scope with the customer: Sit with their project team and subject-matter experts, understand the workflow and its constraints, and cut the problem into something that can ship in weeks.

  • Build and ship end to end: Design, develop and deploy the solution, including backend services, integrations, AI workflows and the interface it needs.

  • Run what you shipped: Operate it in production, fix what breaks, and be the customer's technical contact for it.

  • Build integrations: Connect REMATIQ to the systems customers already use in their development and quality processes.

  • Move custom work into the product: Build features in the web app and work with the platform team to turn one customer's solution into a product capability.

  • Find the next use case: Spot further use cases while you work with the customer and scope them together with Delivery.

Our stack

We work in a modern TypeScript‑first monorepo:

  • Core: Node.js 20+, TypeScript 5+, pnpm workspaces, Turborepo.

  • Frontend: React (Vite), Tailwind CSS, and design system.

  • Backend & workflows: Express-based services, with DBOS for durable workflows.

  • Data & storage: PostgreSQL with pgvector, Prisma ORM, Azure Blob Storage.

  • AI & observability: Azure OpenAI, Langfuse, Sentry, plus logging/tracing with tools like Winston and OpenTelemetry.

  • Dev experience: AI‑assisted workflows with Cursor and Claude Code, integrated into our TypeScript‑first monorepo and review process.

What you'll bring

We are looking for a software engineer who ships production software and is equally at home in a customer's meeting room.

You may be a strong fit if you have:

  • Relevant background: 3+ years as a software engineer shipping production software, ideally including forward deployed, solutions engineering or other customer-facing engineering work.

  • Product management or team lead experience: Some experience as a product manager or team lead, where you owned scope, priorities and requirements for what is being built, is a strong plus.

  • Strong TypeScript and Node.js backend experience: You build and operate production services and can contribute to React frontends where needed.

  • Solid database fundamentals: PostgreSQL (ideally), including data modelling, migrations and performance.

  • Integration experience: You have connected a product to enterprise systems through APIs, SSO or data exchange, and have worked within a customer's IT and security constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs: You have put LLM-driven features into production and know how to make them predictable and reviewable.

  • Strong customer presence: You scope a problem with non-technical stakeholders, explain technical trade-offs clearly, and manage expectations without a project manager next to you.

  • AI-native working style: You use Claude Code or Cursor every day to move faster without compromising reliability.

  • High ownership: You take an ambiguous customer problem to production with limited guidance.

  • Willingness to travel: You work on site at customers when the project needs it.

  • Fluency in English (mandatory). German is a strong plus.

We'll be especially excited if you

  • Have worked as a forward deployed or customer-embedded engineer

  • Have built software for a regulated industry such as MedTech or pharma.

  • Have been a founder or a very early engineer at a startup.

    Why this is a great opportunity

  • Impact in a high-stakes domain – Work on compliance workflows in one of the most regulated industries, where correctness and traceability matter and the outcomes are real.

  • Bring GenAI into production – Build the systems that make LLM-driven features predictable, auditable, and reliable in safety-critical MedTech environments.

  • Real ownership – Own major parts of our platform and drive architectural decisions across backend services, workflows, and data.

  • AI‑agent‑first development – Build in an environment where tools like Cursor and Claude Code are first‑class citizens, helping you explore designs, refactor, and ship faster while you stay in control of quality and reliability.

  • Strong peers – Work with people who care deeply about craft and outcomes, in a high-ownership culture that includes teammates with founder experience.

  • Work with leading MedTech companies – Build products used by teams at BBraun, Novartis & Bayer.

jobs.title: Lead Software Planning & Delivery (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Lead Software Planning & Delivery (m/w/d)

Bei Adlares machen wir Methanemissionen aus der Luft sichtbar – hochpräzise, zertifiziert und entscheidend für den Schutz kritischer Infrastruktur und den Klimaschutz. Mit unserem laserbasierten Messsystem CHARM® setzen wir den Industriestandard für die luftgestützte Gasfernüberwachung – und entwickeln aktuell die nächste, plattformunabhängige Systemgeneration (CHARM®3) sowie modernisierte Daten- und Auswerteprozesse im laufenden Betrieb.

Damit diese Neuentwicklung verlässlich gelingt, suchen wir eine Person mit hohen kommunikativen Fähigkeiten. Du stellst sicher, dass wir unsere Softwareentwicklung verbindlich planen und zum Ziel führen. Du definierst gemeinsam mit dem Produktmanagement die Ziele, übersetzt sie in einen realistischen Plan und trägst die Verantwortung für die Umsetzung. So bist du die zentrale Ansprechperson im Planungsprozess.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Ziele & Anforderungen: Gemeinsam mit dem Produktmanagement, dem Leiter IT und dem PO definierst du die Ziele der Softwareentwicklung. Du holst Anforderungen bei Operations, Laser- und Hardwareentwicklern und Nutzenden ein, erkennst Lücken und Widersprüche und übersetzt Deine Erkenntnisse in klare, umsetzbare Arbeitspakete für die Softwareentwicklung.

  • Planung & Kapazitäten: Du zerlegst Vorhaben in Epics und Tasks, planst Kapazitäten realistisch – inklusive Puffer für Betrieb und Tagesgeschäft – und machst Abhängigkeiten zu Hardware, Physik und Systemintegration frühzeitig sichtbar.

  • Umsetzungsverantwortung: Du sorgst dafür, dass Zusagen eingehalten werden: Du leitest das Daily, machst Fortschritt und Risiken transparent und steuerst nach, wenn etwas aus dem Plan läuft.

  • Entscheidungen herbeiführen: Offene Fragen bleiben bei dir nicht liegen. Du bereitest Entscheidungen vor, führst sie im Team oder mit dem Produktmanagement herbei, hältst sie fest und verfolgst ihre Umsetzung.

  • Architektur im Team: Architekturentscheidungen trifft das Team gemeinsam mit der IT-Leitung. Du moderierst diese Runden, bringst die Perspektive von Aufwand, Risiko und Planbarkeit ein und überführst die Ergebnisse in den Plan – auch bei der Frage, was wir am Bestand weiterführen und was wir schrittweise ablösen.

  • Mitentwickeln: Rund 20–30 % deiner Zeit arbeitest du selbst im Code, in Reviews oder an Prototypen. So kannst du Machbarkeit und Aufwand fundiert einschätzen.


  • Planungserfahrung: Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Planung und Steuerung von Softwareentwicklung mit agilen und strukturierten Methoden – idealerweise in einem Umfeld, in dem Software, Hardware und Messtechnik zusammenkommen.

  • Verbindlichkeit: Du schaffst Klarheit und Verbindlichkeit.

  • Teamgeist: Unser multidisziplinäres Team aus Physikern, Software- und IT Entwicklern, Konstrukteuren und Datenanalysten bringt 25 Jahre Erfahrung in Entwicklung und Betrieb von LIDAR Systemen mit. Du bindest alle Stakeholder in den Zielfindungsprozess ein.

  • Analytisches Gespür: Du ziehst aus Gesprächen mit sehr unterschiedlichen Beteiligten das fachlich Relevante heraus und erkennst Lücken und Missverständnisse früh.

  • Entscheidungsstärke: Du führst Entscheidungen aktiv herbei, auch wenn noch nicht alle Informationen vorliegen, und hältst nach, dass sie umgesetzt werden.

  • Technisches Fundament: Fundierte Entwicklungspraxis mit Python, sicherer Umgang mit Prinzipien guter Softwareentwicklung und Verständnis für C++.

  • Wünschenswert: Erfahrung mit der Ablösung gewachsener Systeme (z. B. LabVIEW), mit Datenbanken, Messdaten und Signalverarbeitung sowie mit KI-gestützter Entwicklung. Dazu Neugier auf Spektroskopie, Laserphysik und Optik.

Was dich erwartet

jobs.title: Software Engineer (Product) - London
jobs.description:
Software Engineer (Product) - London

About Us

Teton is redefining the role of healthcare workers through cutting-edge AI technology and a great product experience. As populations get older and staff shortages grow, healthcare systems are under pressure. Our mission is to decrease the cost of healthcare while improving the quality of care.

Our product enables care teams to intervene, prevent and operate more efficiently. Our ambient sensors in resident rooms capture activity, sleep, respiration, gait and more. These signals are used both to react fast to risk events, like falls, and for long-term health analysis that care teams can act on.

Teton is scaling fast, operating in the Nordics, UK, DACH and US. We raised a $20M Series A. Expect travel to the US to meet users and team members.

We focus relentlessly on product excellence and user experience, deploying solutions at speed that make a tangible difference for carers. We are an aspiring meritocracy biased towards action, always striving to raise the bar. If you are driven by impact, speed and leveling up, this might be the place for you.

If you are looking for a 9-17 job, perform best with structure and struggle dealing with unknowns, this is not for you. We believe close collaboration between a hard-working, high-agency team enables the fastest and most efficient iteration cycles, helping us build an impactful product that healthcare professionals truly love to use.

The Job

We're looking for a talented and driven Product Engineer to own customer-facing features from the first conversation with a care team to the feature running in production. Care workers rely on our product during every shift and care managers use it to follow up on their residents, on mobile and on the web. This isn't a ticket-taking role. You'll talk to users, cut scope, build across the whole stack, and check afterwards whether what you shipped actually made a shift easier. Your goal is to shrink the time from a customer request to a deployed solution, without cutting corners on reliability or on the privacy of residents' health data.

In this role, you will focus on:

  • Feature Development: Own features end-to-end, from design discussions through implementation to production rollout across multiple markets and languages, on the web app, the mobile app and the APIs behind them.

  • Customer Insight: Talk to care staff and our customer success team every week, visit care facilities, and turn what you hear into clearly scoped product changes. Come with ideas, sketch the solution, and push it forward.

  • Fast Iteration: Break large designs and features into small shippable pieces. Get MVPs in front of users quickly, measure how they're used, and iterate or kill them.

  • Backend & APIs: Design and build the APIs, data models and services your features need. You will not just consume APIs, you will help shape, improve and fix the systems behind them.

  • Quality, Privacy & Safety: Ship with care for health data: sensible access control, auditability and privacy by default. Build test coverage and use staged rollouts so new features never get in the way of the alerts care teams depend on.

Qualifications

  • Strong TypeScript skills: this is the language for everything we build.

  • Solid production experience with React on the web and/or React Native.

  • Comfortable working across the stack: you've built backend APIs and worked with relational databases (e.g. Postgres), not just UI.

  • Great product taste and a keen eye for UX. You work well with designers and can make sensible design decisions yourself when needed.

  • Comfortable talking directly with non-technical users and turning messy feedback into concrete decisions.

  • Previous startup experience and/or shipping a product where you owned the outcome, from idea to adoption.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work both independently and in a team.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with React Native and Expo in production.

  • AWS or equivalent cloud platform experience.

  • Familiarity with TanStack, real-time systems or push notifications.

  • Experience with health data or other regulated, privacy-sensitive domains (e.g. GDPR).

  • Experience shipping products across multiple markets and languages.

What We Offer

  • Participation in our warrant program (stock options).

  • A small team where your decisions directly shape the product.

  • Work on software that healthcare workers depend on every day, the impact is tangible and immediate.

Join Our Team

We're looking for individuals who share our vision and value ownership and entrepreneurship over a conventional job.

At Teton, you'll have the chance to make a real impact with your work.

If you're ready for more than just a job, come aboard and be part of our mission to transform healthcare.

jobs.description:
AI Engineer (Manipulation) H/F

At Marso, as an AI Engineer focused on manipulation, you will develop the models that let the Marso robot pick, handle and place real-world loads reliably in customer warehouses. You will own the full lifecycle of manipulation models from data collection and training to on-robot evaluation and production deployment.

Responsibilities

  • Develop, train and evaluate learning-based manipulation models (pick and place, palletization) that run on the Marso robot.

  • Explore and apply approaches such as imitation learning, reinforcement learning and vision-language-action models.

  • Build the data loop for manipulation: teleoperation or demonstration collection, curation, labeling and dataset extraction from field logs.

  • Integrate models with perception, motion planning and control, working with the Intelligent Robotics and Embedded Software teams.

  • Make sure models stay reliable on the robot and in the field: standardized evaluation, failure analysis and robustness to new loads and environments.

  • Optimize models for embedded deployment (latency, quantization, hardware constraints).

  • Use simulation and real-world tests together to speed up iteration and close the sim-to-real gap.

  • Build internal tools to visualize, replay and debug manipulation behavior and model performance.

Profile

  • 4 to 6 years of experience in AI/ML engineering applied to robotics, including hands-on work on robot manipulation.

  • Strong command of Python and deep learning frameworks (PyTorch or equivalent).

  • Practical experience with at least one of: imitation learning, reinforcement learning or vision-language-action models for manipulation.

  • Experience deploying models on real robots, including under hardware constraints.

  • Solid understanding of manipulation fundamentals: kinematics, grasping, motion planning and control.

  • Nice to have: experience with ROS/ROS2, C++, physics simulators, teleoperation setups, force/torque sensing or logistics applications such as palletization or depalletization.

We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team and encourage all qualified candidates to apply, regardless of background.

Chez Marso, en tant qu'AI Engineer spécialisé en manipulation, vous développerez les modèles qui permettent au robot Marso de saisir, manipuler et déposer de manière fiable des charges réelles dans les entrepôts de nos clients. Vous serez owner de tout le cycle de vie des modèles de manipulation, de la data collection et du training jusqu'à l'évaluation on-robot et au déploiement en production.

Responsabilités

  • Développer, entraîner et évaluer des modèles de manipulation learning-based (pick and place, palettisation) qui tournent sur le robot Marso.

  • Explorer et appliquer des approches comme l'imitation learning, le reinforcement learning et les modèles vision-language-action.

  • Construire la data loop de la manipulation : collecte par téléopération ou démonstration, curation, labeling et extraction de datasets à partir des logs terrain.

  • Intégrer les modèles avec la perception, le motion planning et le contrôle, en collaboration avec les équipes Intelligent Robotics et Embedded Software.

  • Garantir la fiabilité des modèles sur le robot et sur le terrain : évaluation standardisée, analyse des échecs et robustesse face à de nouvelles charges et de nouveaux environnements.

  • Optimiser les modèles pour le déploiement embarqué (latence, quantization, contraintes hardware).

  • Combiner simulation et tests en conditions réelles pour accélérer les itérations et réduire le sim-to-real gap.

  • Développer des outils internes pour visualiser, rejouer et débugger le comportement de manipulation et les performances des modèles.

Profil

  • 4 à 6 ans d'expérience en AI/ML engineering appliqué à la robotique, dont une expérience hands-on en manipulation robotique.

  • Excellente maîtrise de Python et des frameworks de deep learning (PyTorch ou équivalent).

  • Expérience pratique d'au moins une de ces approches pour la manipulation : imitation learning, reinforcement learning ou modèles vision-language-action.

  • Expérience du déploiement de modèles sur de vrais robots, y compris sous contraintes hardware.

  • Solide compréhension des fondamentaux de la manipulation : cinématique, grasping, motion planning et contrôle.

  • Nice to have : expérience avec ROS/ROS2, C++, simulateurs physiques, setups de téléopération, capteurs d'effort/couple (force/torque) ou applications logistiques comme la palettisation ou la dépalettisation.

Nous sommes engagés dans la construction d’une équipe diverse et inclusive. Toutes les candidatures qualifiées sont les bienvenues et nous accordons une attention particulière aux compétences, à l’impact et à la capacité à contribuer au projet.

jobs.title: Lead Architect – Digital Assets & Tokenization
jobs.description:
Lead Architect – Digital Assets & Tokenization

Location: Paris, France (4 days onsite per week)

Employment Type: Permanent, Full-time

Salary: €100,000 – €120,000 gross/year

About the Opportunity

We are partnering with a leading European financial market infrastructure group to build a new Digital Assets division, focused on tokenisation and Distributed Ledger Technology (DLT).

The mission is to develop next-generation financial infrastructure, launch innovative digital asset products for institutional and retail clients, and bridge traditional finance (TradFi) with decentralised finance (DeFi).

This is a unique founding-style leadership opportunity within an established, highly regulated financial institution. You will have the opportunity to shape the technical vision, own the architecture, and build foundational technology from the ground up.

The Mission

You will lead the architecture of the organisation's first tokenised financial products, covering two major initiatives:

  • Tokenised Securities Platform: Building an issuance, trading and settlement platform for equities, ETFs and bonds, featuring 24/7 trading, fractional ownership and on-chain Delivery-versus-Payment (DvP) settlement.
  • Tokenised Collateral Management Platform: Enabling real-time repo transactions, CCP margin eligibility and DeFi distribution of government bonds through regulated lending environments.

Your responsibility is to translate these strategic initiatives into secure, scalable and auditable technical architectures.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end architecture for digital asset solutions, integrating DLT with traditional financial market infrastructure, including trading, clearing, settlement, custody and CSD.
  • Design cross-chain architectures across permissioned networks (Hyperledger Besu, Canton Network) and public blockchains (Ethereum/L2).
  • Define on-chain compliance frameworks, including ERC-3643/T-REX token standards, KYC-whitelisted wallets, AML screening and transaction reporting.
  • Architect institutional custody and key management solutions using MPC technologies such as Fireblocks and Taurus.
  • Establish engineering standards covering code quality, architecture reviews, testing and secure-by-design development.
  • Lead threat modelling and security architecture for high-value financial systems.
  • Drive build-versus-buy decisions across blockchain infrastructure, custody and audit solutions.
  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Legal, Regulatory, Clearing and CSD stakeholders.
  • Remain hands-on with critical technical components and high-risk incidents.
  • Build and develop the engineering team as the platform transitions from development to production.

Requirements

  • 7+ years of experience in Solution Architecture, including at least 3 years working on DLT or blockchain projects.
  • Strong expertise in distributed systems and blockchain architecture.
  • Hands-on experience with EVM and permissioned blockchain networks such as Canton or Hyperledger Besu.
  • Knowledge of regulated security token standards, particularly ERC-3643/T-REX or equivalent.
  • Strong understanding of smart contract security, cross-chain risks and on-chain compliance.
  • Experience designing secure, highly available financial systems operating 24/7.
  • Working knowledge of capital markets infrastructure, including DvP, CSD, CCP and settlement processes.
  • Strong leadership skills with a player-coach mindset.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to work with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field.

AI Engineering Skills (Required)

  • Experience defining AI-augmented software development workflows using coding assistants, smart contract scaffolding and AI-generated test suites.
  • Ability to establish governance and security guardrails for AI-assisted code, including code reviews, secret management and licence/provenance checks.
  • Experience evaluating AI development tools and identifying practical productivity improvements.
  • Understanding of AI-powered product capabilities such as anomaly detection and operational triage, including associated risk controls.

Why Join?

  • Take ownership of the architecture for a major digital asset infrastructure initiative.
  • Build innovative tokenisation products at the intersection of TradFi and DeFi.
  • Work within an established European financial institution while enjoying the autonomy of a zero-to-one project.
  • Influence strategic technology decisions and shape the future engineering team.

Important: Candidates must be willing to work onsite in Paris, France, 4 days per week.

Salary: €100K–€120K gross annually.

Ontwerp en programmeer jij graag de nieuwste deegverwerkingsmachines van AMF Bakery Systems? Step dan in als Senior Controls Engineer! Heb je ervaring als software, controls of mechatronica engineer in machinebouw, ben je vertrouwd met programmeren in structured text en ben je bekend met Siemens besturingstechniek? Hecht je aan betrokken en slimme collega's waarmee je samen 'state of the art' voedselproductielijnen ontwerpt, programmeert en bouwt? Super, dan zijn we op zoek naar jou!

jobs.title: Digital Channel Manager (Kiosk)
jobs.description:
Digital Channel Manager (Kiosk)

Wil jij werken voor een fantastisch merk waar je direct impact kunt maken? Ben jij een digital marketing professional met een passie voor food en retail, en voel jij je thuis in een internationale omgeving? Dan is dit jouw kans.

Wat is jouw bijdrage aan het succes van KFC?
Jij bent verantwoordelijk voor het commerciële succes en de continue optimalisatie van het kiosk-kanaal van KFC Nederland. Met behulp van data-analyse, klantinzichten en nauwe samenwerking met verschillende teams zorg je voor meer gebruik van de kiosken, hogere omzet, betere conversie en een hogere gemiddelde besteding per gast.

Jouw volgende uitdaging begint hier

Als Digital Channel Manager (Kiosk) maak je deel uit van het Digital Team van KFC en speel je een belangrijke rol in onze digitale toekomst. Jij bent de drijvende kracht achter de commerciële prestaties en voortdurende optimalisatie van onze self-service kiosken in de restaurants.

Je pakt nieuwe zaken snel op, bent nieuwsgierig van aard en weet klant- en prestatiegegevens moeiteloos te vertalen naar heldere acties en verbeteringen.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Je bent eigenaar van één van KFC's belangrijkste digitale verkoopkanalen en hét aanspreekpunt voor alles rondom de kiosken. Je monitort en verbetert het gebruik, de omzet, conversie en de gemiddelde besteding per gast.

  • Je creëert een eenvoudige, snelle en intuïtieve klantreis, terwijl je tegelijkertijd zorgt voor gebruiksgemak voor onze restaurantteams.

  • Je stelt business requirements op, coördineert testtrajecten en ondersteunt de implementatie van verbeteringen aan de kiosken in samenwerking met het regionale productteam, IT, Operations en technologiepartners.

  • Je signaleert kansen om prestaties te verbeteren door dashboards te monitoren en nauw samen te werken met Commercial Finance. Inzichten vertaal je naar concrete acties.

  • Je verhoogt de conversie door middel van A/B-testen, analyses van klantgedrag en continue optimalisatie van de kiosk-ervaring en productpresentatie.

  • Je zorgt ervoor dat campagnes, producten en waardeproposities effectief worden gepresenteerd en correct worden gelanceerd op de kiosken. Daarbij optimaliseer je de menustructuur, productzichtbaarheid en upsell- en cross-sellmogelijkheden.

  • Je houdt platformproblemen in de gaten en werkt samen met IT en technologiepartners om deze op te lossen.

  • Je werkt intensief samen met Operations om het gebruik van de kiosken en de uitvoering in de restaurants te verbeteren. Daarnaast werk je nauw samen met collega's van Digital, Brand, Innovation, IT, Commercial en externe partners.

Over KFC Nederland

Kentucky Fried Chicken, de Amerikaanse restaurantketen gespecialiseerd in fried chicken, is sinds 1972 actief in Nederland. Inmiddels telt Nederland 96 KFC-restaurants. Dagelijks bereiden onze chefs verse kip- en vegetarische gerechten volgens het originele recept uit 1939 van oprichter Colonel Harland Sanders. Naast de focus op onze producten en de verdere groei van ons restaurantnetwerk, investeren we volop in de ontwikkeling van onze medewerkers.


Wat breng jij mee?

  • Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding in Marketing, Bedrijfskunde, Digital Commerce of een vergelijkbare richting is een pré, aangevuld met minimaal 3 tot 5 jaar ervaring in het beheren of optimaliseren van een digitaal klantkanaal.

  • Sterke analytische vaardigheden en ervaring met het monitoren van dashboards, het vertalen van data naar inzichten en acties, en het uitvoeren van A/B-testen.

  • Ervaring met het verbeteren van klantreizen, digitale interfaces en online merchandising.

  • Sterke projectmanagement- en stakeholdermanagementvaardigheden, met het vermogen om mensen te beïnvloeden zonder hiërarchische verantwoordelijkheid.

  • Een gestructureerde, proactieve en hands-on werkstijl, gecombineerd met een pragmatische en samenwerkingsgerichte aanpak.

  • Nieuwsgierigheid en de drive om continu te testen, leren en verbeteren.

  • Ervaring binnen restaurants, retail of QSR (Quick Service Restaurants) is een pré.

  • Uitstekende beheersing van zowel de Nederlandse als Engelse taal, mondeling en schriftelijk.

Voldoe je niet aan alle eisen? Geen probleem!

Onderzoek laat zien dat mensen vaak pas solliciteren wanneer zij aan vrijwel alle functie-eisen voldoen. Bij Collins Foods kijken we niet alleen naar ervaring, maar ook naar potentieel en ambitie.

Word jij enthousiast van deze rol? Dan horen we graag van je. Misschien ben jij precies het talent dat wij zoeken.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Bij ons krijg je de kans om echt impact te maken binnen een internationale, dynamische en groeiende organisatie. Je komt terecht in een hecht team waar initiatief, ondernemerschap en creativiteit worden gewaardeerd én verwacht.

Daarnaast kun je rekenen op:

Data & Product Engineer (Dutch speaking)

Our mission

Wij vertalen data naar betere zorg. Met onze inzichten maken we de gezondheidszorg betaalbaarder en verbeteren we de ervaring van patiënten en artsen.

Your impact and responsibilities

Als Data & Product Engineer in het Financial Analytics Delivery & Service team draag je bij aan:

  • Het ondersteunen van klanten bij het aanleveren van data, via een export en/of script vanuit hun systeem.

  • Zelfstandig valideren en analyseren van data om de kwaliteitsstandaarden te garanderen. Resultaten van validaties nauwkeurig rapporteren aan klanten en data issues oplossen.

  • Het coördineren van het proces van data-aanlevering en -validatie, samen met andere betrokken collega’s.

  • Onderhouden van centrale en klantspecifieke data definities en standaarden.

  • Ondersteunen van data governance initiatieven, inclusief het monitoren van de prestaties van onze dataprocessen en ondersteuning bij data audits.

  • Identificeren en oplossen van problemen in data pipelines in samenwerking met Data Product & Ontwikkeling teams.

  • Deelname aan projecten zoals vernieuwing van data pipelines en het bouwen van een centraal Data Platform voor dataverwerking en -validatie door klanten

Your team

Je maakt deel uit van het Financial Analytics Service team, dat momenteel bestaat uit 40 mensen met diverse achtergronden in de gezondheidszorg en data-analyse. Het team is verantwoordelijk voor het implementeren en onderhouden van onze oplossingen en benchmarks, die zowel medische specialisten als de planning- en controleteams in ziekenhuizen ondersteunen. Onze oplossingen helpen ziekenhuizen en medische specialisten bij maandelijkse rapportages over prognoses, het aanpakken van capaciteitsvraagstukken, portefeuillebeslissingen, het verbeteren van patiëntenzorgpaden en andere belangrijke strategische keuzes.

Je wordt onderdeel van het Data Management team, verantwoordelijk voor het beheren van alle datastromen die nodig zijn om onze financiële SaaS-producten aan klanten te leveren, met focus op zorgproductie (DBC) data, HR en financiële data van zorginstellingen.


Your profile

We geloven dat de volgende vaardigheden en kwalificaties bijdragen aan jouw succes in deze rol:

  • Relevante Werkervaring: je hebt 2-4 jaar aantoonbare werkervaring met data. Ervaring binnen de technologie- of gezondheidszorgsector is een pré.

  • Enthousiast over geavanceerde data-analyse en het oplossen van big data vraagstukken in de gezondheidszorg. En daarnaast over ontwikkelingen in data en technologie, en bereid deze toe te passen in je werk.

  • Uitstekende analytische vaardigheden met oog voor volledigheid en kwaliteit van data.

  • Jij hebt een gestructureerde, pragmatische en resultaatgerichte aanpak. Daarnaast ben je proactief in het oppakken van nieuwe taken en het zoeken naar kansen om bij te dragen.

  • Bereidheid om te leren en aan te passen aan innovatieve technologieën, tools en processen.

  • Bereidheid om verantwoordelijkheden binnen projecten op te nemen en een betrouwbare teamgenoot te zijn.

  • Masterdiploma in een kwantitatieve, financiële, technische of andere relevante richting.

  • Taalvaardigheden: Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands en Engels.

Zelfs als je niet aan 100% van de criteria voldoet, moedigen we je aan om te solliciteren. We waarderen bereidheid om te leren boven alles.

Why LOGEX?

De gezondheidszorg is tegenwoordig meer op maat gemaakt en effectiever dan ooit tevoren, maar deze verbeteringen gaan gepaard met hogere kosten en een grotere complexiteit. De financiële last op de economie is aanzienlijk, terwijl de vele keuzemogelijkheden voor artsen en patiënten onzekerheid creëren en onaanvaardbare variaties in klinische uitkomsten veroorzaken.

Bij LOGEX hebben we één superkracht: data-analyse. Wij kiezen ervoor deze superkracht in te zetten om de huidige problemen in de gezondheidszorg aan te pakken door gegevens te vertalen naar betere zorg.

  • Een uitstekend beloningspakket (salaris, vakantiegeld, NS Business card, telefoon- en internetvergoeding)

  • 25 vakantiedagen (op fulltime basis) om nieuwe energie op te doen, met de mogelijkheid om extra vakantiedagen te kopen

  • Een informele werkomgeving met gedreven collega’s

  • De mogelijkheid tot hybride werken

  • Een laptop en alles wat je nodig hebt om thuis een comfortabele en ergonomische werkplek in te richten

  • Persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling via onze LOGEX Academy

  • Toegang tot onze partner op het gebied van mentale gezondheid; OpenUp

  • Regelmatig borrels na het werk en nog veel meer evenementen

Contact us!

jobs.description:
Senior Associate, Fund Administration (Accounting)

About Juniper Square

Private markets are one of the largest, most complex, and most underserved corners of global finance. Our mission at Juniper Square is to unlock their full potential. We’re the Operations Partner trusted by 2,300+ GPs, unifying technology, data, and fund administration services into a single platform that helps GPs move faster, make better decisions, and scale with precision. With $300B+ under administration and 700,000+ LPs on platform, we’ve built the scale to match our ambition. And with JunieAI, our purpose-built AI platform, we’re reimagining how private markets operate, embedding intelligence across every workflow. Founder-led since 2014, backed by $350M+ in funding, and now 1,000+ employees strong, we’re building a company designed to shape the future of private markets for decades to come.

Our culture is built for people who want to do ambitious, meaningful work alongside exceptionally talented teammates. We think like owners, move with urgency, and take pride in solving hard problems that truly matter to our customers and the future of private markets. We believe the best ideas come from open debate, deep collaboration, and diverse perspectives, which is why we believe transparency is the default and feedback makes us stronger. If you’re energized by high standards, rapid growth, and the opportunity to help define a category at a pivotal moment, come join us!

Juniper Square offers employees a variety of ways to work, ranging from a fully remote experience to working full-time in one of our physical offices. We invest heavily in digital-first operations, allowing our teams to collaborate effectively across 27 U.S. states, 2 Canadian Provinces, India, Luxembourg, and England. We also have physical offices in San Francisco, New York City, Mumbai and Bangalore for employees who prefer to work in an office some or all of the time.

About your role

We are hiring a few Senior Associates to join our team. This is an exciting opportunity to join a fast paced start-up environment to help build out Juniper Square’s Fund Administration service offering. Juniper Square is on a mission to transform the Fund Administration offering to Private Markets. We are more than a Fund Administrator, we are a Modern Fund Administrator. As a Senior Fund Accountant you will partner with the customer, other members of the fund accounting team, and Investor Services and Fund Administration Onboarding teams to deliver fund accounting and reporting services to Juniper Square’s Private Market customers in the Real Estate, Private Equity, and Venture Capital space. You will have a significant opportunity to shape the trajectory of our service offering and in so doing help to deliver a best-in-class experience to our customers. We are a team of values based self-starters with a curious mindset and the motivation to use technology to our advantage so that we are continually iterating and improving on the status quo. This is an opportunity to couple prior education and experience and to learn from some of the best talent in Private Markets.

What you’ll do

  • Support major decisions regarding team buildout and operational policies and procedures

  • Define and support the implementation of fund administration workflows, applying best practices and process efficiencies

  • Interface directly with clients to deliver an outstanding client experience

  • Serve as a technical accounting expert and key advisor on significant business/accounting decisions for the team

  • Perform accounting, analytical, & financial reporting duties; ensure client and investor reporting is prepared and completed timely and accurately

  • Review waterfall calculations and capital calls and distributions in accordance with clients’ Limited Partnership Agreements

  • Prepare and review asset- and fund-level performance metrics (IRRs, TVPI, etc.)

  • Assist in preparing, compiling, and verifying external client and regulatory reporting

  • Prepare financial information for stockholders/investor reports

  • Assist with annual audits, including preparation of the initial draft of the annual audit report and related schedules and disclosures; assist with PBC list (Prepared By Client) and tax returns

  • Research and assist in interpreting the impact of recent accounting developments

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of fund accounting or audit experience with exposure to Private Equity, Venture Capital, Private Credit and/or Real Estate funds

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or related field required.

  • Investran experience preferred.

  • Exposure to complex fund structures, waterfall calculations, performance metrics (IRRs), distributions and capital calls calculations

  • Experience with annual reporting (audited financial statements)

  • Passion for technology and a desire to use technology to improve business operations

  • Experience scoping out system requirements and implementing new systems

  • Strategic thinker with the ability to master both the details and the big picture

  • Ability to handle many projects at once without losing track of the details

  • Comfortable with ambiguity, excellent work ethic and likes to take ownership of your work

At Juniper Square, we believe building a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture makes us a better company. If you think this job sounds like a fit, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all the qualifications.

Compensation

Compensation for this position includes a base salary, equity, and a variety of benefits. The U.S. base salary range for this role is $85,000 - $98,000. The Canadian base salary range for this role is $80,000 - $100,000. Actual base salaries will be based on candidate-specific factors, including experience, skillset, and location, and local minimum pay requirements as applicable. We are actively hiring for this role in Canada, and offer competitive local pay and benefits. Your recruiter can provide further details.

Benefits include:

  • Health, dental, and vision care for you and your family

  • Life insurance and disability coverage

  • Mental wellness coverage

  • Fertility and growing family support

  • Flex Time Off in addition to company-paid holidays

  • Paid family leave, medical leave, and bereavement leave policies

  • 401k retirement savings plan

  • Healthcare FSA and commuter benefits programs

  • Allowance to customize your work and technology setup at home

  • Annual professional development stipend
