jobs.title: Senior Fundraiser*in – Stiftungen & Unternehmensförderung
jobs.description:
Senior Fundraiser*in – Stiftungen & Unternehmensförderung

Du gewinnst Förderpartner. Wir bringen Finanzbildung an Deutschlands Schulen.

Du bist erfahren im Fundraising und weißt, wie man Stiftungen und Unternehmen als Förderpartner gewinnt? Du hast bereits erfolgreich Fördermittel für eine gemeinnützige Organisation eingeworben und möchtest deine Erfahrung nutzen, um noch mehr gesellschaftliche Wirkung zu erzielen?

Dann suchen wir genau dich!

Mit unserem Bildungsprojekt Zukunftstag – Dein Crashkurs fürs Leben vermitteln wir jungen Menschen an Schulen wichtige Alltagskompetenzen rund um Finanzen, Steuern, Wohnen und Versicherungen.

Damit wir noch mehr Jugendliche erreichen können, suchen wir eine erfahrene Fundraising-Persönlichkeit, die eigenständig neue Förderpartner gewinnt und unser Fördernetzwerk deutschlandweit ausbaut.

Wichtig: Wir suchen ausdrücklich jemanden mit praktischer Erfahrung in der aktiven Fördermittelakquise. Du solltest bereits erfolgreich Stiftungen oder Unternehmen als Förderpartner für eine gemeinnützige Organisation gewonnen haben.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Aktive Fördermittelakquise: Du identifizierst und kontaktierst gezielt Stiftungen, Unternehmen und weitere potenzielle Förderpartner, insbesondere auf regionaler und lokaler Ebene.

  • Gewinnung neuer Förderpartner: Du überzeugst potenzielle Förderer von unserer Bildungsmission und gewinnst sie für die Finanzierung konkreter Zukunftstage.

  • Eigenverantwortliches Fundraising: Du begleitest den gesamten Akquiseprozess von der Recherche und Erstansprache über persönliche Gespräche bis zur erfolgreichen Förderzusage.

  • Aufbau langfristiger Förderbeziehungen: Du entwickelst bestehende Förderpartnerschaften weiter und gewinnst Förderer für eine dauerhafte Zusammenarbeit.

  • Entwicklung überzeugender Förderangebote: Du erstellst individuelle Förderanfragen, Kooperationskonzepte und Förderanträge.

  • Systematischer Ausbau unseres Fördernetzwerks: Du entwickelst eine kontinuierliche Akquise-Pipeline und arbeitest zielgerichtet daran, unser Fördervolumen nachhaltig zu steigern.

Das bringst du mit

Diese Voraussetzungen sind uns besonders wichtig:

  • Mehrjährige praktische Berufserfahrung im Fundraising einer NGO, Stiftung oder anderen gemeinnützigen Organisation.

  • Nachweisbare Erfolge in der aktiven Gewinnung von Fördermitteln, insbesondere durch die Ansprache von Stiftungen und Unternehmen.

  • Erfahrung in der eigenständigen Identifikation, Ansprache und Gewinnung neuer Förderpartner.

  • Sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und ein überzeugendes, professionelles Auftreten gegenüber potenziellen Förderern.

  • Freude an der aktiven Akquise und die Bereitschaft, regelmäßig auf neue potenzielle Förderpartner zuzugehen.

  • Eine selbstständige, strukturierte und ergebnisorientierte Arbeitsweise.

  • Identifikation mit unserer Mission und unseren Werten: Entschlossenheit, Respekt, Verantwortung und Kooperation.

Du passt besonders gut zu uns, wenn du nicht nur Förderanträge verwaltet, sondern selbst aktiv neue Förderpartner gewonnen hast.

Das bieten wir dir

  • Echte gesellschaftliche Wirkung: Deine Fundraising-Erfolge ermöglichen unmittelbar neue Zukunftstage und damit Finanzbildung für Tausende Jugendliche.

  • Attraktive Vergütung: Je nach Erfahrung und Erfolg sind 45.000 bis 100.000 € Jahresgehalt möglich.

  • Eigenverantwortung: Du übernimmst eine zentrale Rolle beim Ausbau unseres Fundraisings und gestaltest unsere weitere Entwicklung aktiv mit.

  • Flexibles Arbeiten: Modernes Büro in Frankfurt am Main und Homeoffice-Möglichkeiten.

  • Dynamisches Team: Motivierte Kolleginnen und Kollegen, kurze Entscheidungswege und flache Hierarchien.

  • Überzeugendes Förderprodukt: Mit dem Zukunftstag bietest du potenziellen Förderpartnern eine konkrete und wirkungsvolle Möglichkeit, Jugendliche in ihrer Region zu unterstützen.

Über uns

Mit dem Zukunftstag – Dein Crashkurs fürs Leben bringen wir essenzielles Finanz- und Wirtschaftswissen an Deutschlands Schulen und schließen damit eine wichtige Lücke im Lehrplan.

Seit 2019 haben wir uns zu einer der am schnellsten wachsenden gemeinnützigen Bildungsinitiativen Deutschlands entwickelt. Bereits mehr als 200.000 Schülerinnen und Schüler haben an unseren Zukunftstagen teilgenommen.

Unser Ziel ist es, dass möglichst viele Jugendliche unabhängig von ihrer Herkunft Zugang zu lebenspraktischer Finanzbildung erhalten.

Interessiert?

Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung!

Bitte sende uns deinen Lebenslauf und ein kurzes Anschreiben.

Besonders interessiert uns dabei: Welche Förderpartner hast du in deiner bisherigen Tätigkeit selbst gewonnen und welche Fundraising-Erfolge konntest du erzielen?

Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen! 🚀

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Customer Success Manager (m/w/d)

Merlin bringt KI in die öffentliche Verwaltung. Mit unserer Telefon-KI, unserem Chatbot und unserem KI-Assistenten entlasten wir Rathäuser, Landratsämter und Behörden. So haben die Mitarbeitenden wieder mehr Zeit für das, was wirklich zählt, und Bürgerinnen bekommen schneller Hilfe. Nach nur 1 Jahr am Markt arbeiten bereits über 120 Kommunen in ganz Deutschland mit Merlin. Wir werden unterstützt durch erfahrene Investoren, GovTech Gründerinnen und ehemalige Spitzenpolitiker*innen.

Als Customer Success Manager (m/w/d) begleitest du unsere Kundinnen von der Vertragsphase über das Onboarding bis in den Alltag und bleibst dauerhaft ihre feste Ansprechperson. Dabei geht es um mehr als zufriedene Kundinnen: Du sorgst dafür, dass Merlin in den Verwaltungen wirklich genutzt wird. Du findest Wege, wie mehr Mitarbeitende und Ämter davon profitieren, und erkennst, wo wir noch mehr helfen können. Als erste Person im Customer Success legst du außerdem den Grundstein dafür, wie Merlin seine Kund*innen in Zukunft betreut.

Das sagt dir dein zukünftiger Manager:

Wenn es unseren Kundinnen gut geht, geht es auch uns gut. Sie sind das Wichtigste, was wir haben, und genau so behandeln wir sie auch. Mit dieser Haltung haben wir uns in kurzer Zeit einen Namen gemacht: In der kommunalen Welt kennt man Merlin inzwischen als Anbieter, der sich wirklich um seine Kundinnen kümmert. Mit dir möchte ich ein professionelles Customer-Success-Team aufbauen, das dafür sorgt, dass es so bleibt.

Tobias, Gründer & Geschäftsführer

🪴 Das wird dein Job

  • Dein eigenes Kundenportfolio: Schon ab der Vertragsphase übernimmst du die Verantwortung für deine Kund*innen und bist ab dann ihre persönliche Ansprechperson. Du begleitest sie von Tag 1 und baust in regelmäßigen Terminen langfristige Beziehungen zu ihnen auf.
  • Du sorgst dafür, dass Kund*innen bleiben: Im regelmäßigen Austausch merkst du früh, wenn etwas hakt, und steuerst gegen, bevor es zum Problem wird. Dein Ziel sind Kund*innen, die gern verlängern und uns weiterempfehlen.
  • Du erkennst, wo Merlin noch mehr helfen kann: Ob weitere Ämter, mehr Nutzer*innen oder ein weiteres Produkt, du entdeckst Potenziale und bringst Up- und Crosssells gemeinsam mit unserem Vertrieb voran.
  • Bei dir laufen die Fäden zusammen: Du bist die Schnittstelle zwischen deinen Kund*innen und unseren Teams aus Produkt, Vertrieb und Marketing. Du koordinierst, was gebraucht wird und bringst damit Merlin als Ganzes weiter.
  • Customer Success aufbauen: Du legst das Fundament für diesen Bereich: Playbook, Onboarding-Standards und Kennzahlen wie Nutzung und Verlängerungsquote. Mit unserer Kundenzahl wird auch das Team stetig wachsen, und du prägst, wie es aussieht und arbeitet.

🤗 Damit passt du zu uns

  • Du hast mindestens 2 Jahre Berufserfahrung mit viel Kundenkontakt, zum Beispiel im Customer Success, im Account Management, in der Beratung, im Projektmanagement oder in der öffentlichen Verwaltung.
  • Du kümmerst dich gern: Du bist offen und herzlich, Menschen vertrauen dir schnell, und es macht dir Freude, für andere da zu sein. Deine Kommunikationsfähigkeiten sind außergewöhnlich.
  • Du bringst technisches Verständnis mit: Du hast bereits mit erklärungsbedürftiger Software gearbeitet und kannst technische Fragen von Kund*innen verständlich beantworten. Neue Produkte verstehst du schnell bis ins Detail und denkst kreativ darüber nach, wie Verwaltungen noch mehr aus Merlin herausholen.
  • Du hast ein Gespür fürs Kaufmännische: Du erkennst Chancen und weißt, was eine gute Kundenbeziehung wert ist, ganz ohne Verkäufer-Ego.
  • Du bist strukturiert und bleibst dran: Auch bei vielen Kund*innen und Themen behältst du den Überblick und hältst, was du zusagst. Gute Abläufe aufzubauen macht dir Spaß.
  • Du gestaltest deine Arbeit mit KI: Du nutzt KI nicht nur ab und zu, sondern hast schon eigene Workflows oder Agenten gebaut und wiederkehrende Abläufe automatisiert.

💜 Warum du zu Merlin solltest

  • Arbeit mit Sinn: Mit GovTech tun wir unserem Land etwas Gutes. Jede Kommune, die du begleitest, wird ein Stück einfacher, für die Menschen, die dort arbeiten, und für alle, die auf sie angewiesen sind.
  • Du gestaltest von Anfang an: Du baust Customer Success bei Merlin auf und prägst, wohin sich der Bereich entwickelt, mit echter Verantwortung und berichtest direkt an unseren Geschäftsführer.
  • Du entwickelst dich schneller als anderswo: Du bekommst regelmäßig ehrliches Feedback und übernimmst früh echte Verantwortung. In einem ehrgeizigen Team, das Spaß an der Arbeit hat, wächst du fachlich und persönlich über dich hinaus.
  • Transparente Vergütung: 50.000–80.000 € je nach Erfahrung. Der Großteil ist fix, dazu kommt ein Bonus, der daran hängt, dass unsere Kund*innen bleiben und mit uns wachsen.
  • Hybrid in München: Unser Büro liegt im WERK1 im Werksviertel am Ostbahnhof, einem lebendigen Tech- und Startup-Hub. Einen Teil der Woche kannst du von zuhause arbeiten.
  • Corporate Benefits: Regelmäßige Team-Events, Wellpass und Offsites.

Viele großartige Menschen bewerben sich nur, wenn sie jeden einzelnen Punkt erfüllen. Das musst du nicht. Wenn dich die Rolle anspricht, wollen wir dich kennenlernen. Ein Lebenslauf oder dein LinkedIn-Profil reicht, ein Anschreiben brauchst du nicht.

jobs.title: Onboarding Manager:in - Trainer:in für digitale Pflegedokumentation (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Onboarding Manager:in - Trainer:in für digitale Pflegedokumentation (m/w/d)

🎤 Warum voize? Weil wir mehr als nur ein Job sind!

Bei voize glauben wir: Das Wertvollste, was wir Menschen in der Pflege geben können, ist Zeit. Zeit für Zuwendung, für Gespräche, fürs Dasein. Heute geht genau diese Zeit in Verwaltungsarbeit und komplexen Systemen verloren.

Unsere Vision ist es, das zu ändern: mit KI-Begleitern, die digitale Abläufe im Hintergrund übernehmen. Wir ersetzen keine Menschen durch Technik - wir verstärken ihre Wirkung.

Hinter unserer Mission steht eine Series-A-Finanzierung über 50 Mio. US-Dollar unter Führung von Balderton Capital, gemeinsam mit HV Capital, Y Combinator und weiteren führenden VCs. Über 2.000 Einrichtungen vertrauen heute auf voize, mehr als 200.000 Nutzer:innen entlastet unser KI-Begleiter im Alltag.

Und jetzt suchen wir dich, damit du mit uns auf diese Mission gehst!

💡 Deine Mission - Pflegekräfte begeistern und Digitalisierung im Pflegealltag gestalten

Als Onboarding Manager:in - Trainer:in für digitale Pflegedokumentation sorgst du dafür, dass Pflegekräfte unseren KI-Begleiter sicher im Alltag nutzen. Du schulst Gruppen von 10 bis 15 Pflegekräften direkt bei unseren Kund:innen nach der Teach-Try-Apply-Methode und bringst deine Pflegeerfahrung ein, damit aus Dokumentationszeit wieder Zeit für Zuwendung wird.

🚀 Dein Arbeitsalltag - Keine zwei Tage sind gleich

  • Schulungen vor Ort leiten: Du gestaltest und führst eigenverantwortlich Schulungen nach der Teach-Try-Apply-Methode (TTA: Erklären, Ausprobieren, Anwenden) durch und begleitest Pflegekräfte dabei, voize direkt in ihrem Arbeitsalltag anzuwenden.

  • Online schulen: Je nach Bedarf schulst du per Videocall in einem eigenen Format, das nicht dem TTA-Ablauf folgt.

  • Digitalisierung begleiten: Du unterstützt Pflegekräfte bei neuen digitalen Arbeitsweisen und begleitest sie durch Veränderungen, damit der KI-Begleiter im Alltag wirklich ankommt.

  • Pflegeexpertise einbringen: Du erkennst Herausforderungen und Bedürfnisse in unterschiedlichen Einrichtungen und gibst sie gemeinsam mit Support und Customer Success direkt an unsere Produktteams weiter.

  • Schulungen weiterentwickeln: Du verbesserst Materialien und Abläufe laufend anhand von Feedback und Stolpersteinen im Onboarding.

🤝 Dein Profil - Das bringst du mit

  • Pflegeausbildung oder praktische Erfahrung in der Pflege (stationäre Langzeitpflege, Krankenhaus oder ambulant) - du kennst Pflegedokumentation und Alltagsroutinen aus eigener Erfahrung.

  • Erfahrung darin, Kolleg:innen anzuleiten, z. B. als Praxisanleiter:in, Mentor:in oder Digital Champion. Praxisnahe Schulungsformate, in denen Teilnehmende selbst üben, sind ein Plus.

  • Glaubwürdigkeit und Kommunikationsstärke, um Gruppen von 10 bis 15 Pflegekräften auch unter Zeitdruck zu begeistern und zu motivieren.

  • Begeisterung für Technologie, die die Pflege leichter macht, und Geduld, Kolleg:innen durch Veränderungen zu begleiten.

  • Fließend Deutsch (C2) und die Bereitschaft, 2 bis 3 Mal pro Woche für TTA-Schulungen vor Ort zu reisen.

🌱 Gemeinsam wachsen – Das erwartet dich bei voize

  • Eine neue berufliche Perspektive: Entwickle dich außerhalb der klassischen Pflegelaufbahn weiter, ohne der Pflege den Rücken zu kehren.

  • Keine Schicht-, Nacht- oder Wochenenddienste: Gestalte deinen Alltag außerhalb des klassischen Schichtsystems.

  • Strukturierte Einarbeitung: Erfahrene Trainer:innen begleiten dich bei deinem Einstieg.

  • Eigenverantwortung und Gestaltungsspielraum: Du bringst eigene Ideen ein und gestaltest Schulungen und Prozesse aktiv mit.

  • Offene Unternehmenskultur: Regelmäßige Team-Events, ob du aus unserem Berliner Office oder remote aus Deutschland arbeitest.

  • Moderne Arbeitsausstattung für dein mobiles Arbeiten.

  • Beteiligung am Unternehmenserfolg: Mit Stock Options wirst du Teil unseres Erfolgs.

  • Attraktive Benefits: 30 Urlaubstage plus dein Geburtstag frei, Deutschlandticket, Urban Sports Club, regelmäßige Company-Offsites sowie Zugang zu Blinkist und Audible.

  • Flexibles Arbeiten: Flexible Arbeitszeiten im Rahmen deiner Kundentermine und ein gutes Hybrid-Setup.

✨ Bereit für ein Gespräch? Jetzt bewerben!

jobs.title: Senior Solutions Engineer (Remote Europe)
jobs.description:
Senior Solutions Engineer (Remote Europe)

The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

About the role

As a Solutions Engineer, you will be the primary technical partner for our Enterprise sales engagements. You’ll work closely with Account Executives to guide prospects through technical discovery, product evaluations, and proofs of concept — helping them validate that n8n can operate securely, reliably, and at scale in their environment.

This is a customer-facing, hands-on role focused on complex Enterprise use cases. You will spend your time working directly with technical stakeholders, leading technical conversations, and ensuring Enterprise customers clearly understand how n8n fits into their systems and processes.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Lead Enterprise technical discovery, deep-dive calls, and tailored demos, showing how n8n fits into complex customer environments while addressing security, scalability, and reliability requirements

  • Partner closely with Account Executives to assess technical fit, shape deal strategy, and handle technical objections, delivering demos grounded in real Enterprise workflows and use cases

  • Own Enterprise POCs end-to-end, from scoping success criteria to hands-on technical guidance throughout the evaluation

  • Help customers validate n8n in real-world conditions and capture POC learnings to improve qualification, conversion, and handoff to Solution Architecture/Customer Success

  • Build strong relationships with IT, Security, Platform, and Engineering stakeholders, acting as the primary technical contact during Enterprise evaluations

  • Clearly explain n8n’s approach to security, deployment, governance, and scale, helping customers plan adoption beyond their first use case

  • Collaborate with Sales to improve Enterprise technical discovery, demos, and POC frameworks

  • Provide structured feedback from Enterprise customers to Product and Engineering, and contribute to enablement materials that strengthen Enterprise sales motions

Must-have

💼 Sales Engineering Experience: You have 6+ years of experience in a technical pre-sales or Sales Engineering role, ideally within B2B SaaS, with direct exposure to enterprise customers

🗣 Excellent Communication Skills: You can clearly articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences and confidently engage with enterprise stakeholders

🌐 Commercial Acumen: You understand sales processes and can creatively translate customer requirements into scalable technical solutions

🤝 Relationship Building: You excel at building and maintaining relationships with clients, particularly within infrastructure teams on deployment requirements

🔧 Strong Technical Proficiency: You bring hands-on experience with:

  • API integrations, OAuth, and authentication/authorization concepts

  • JavaScript and/or Python for scripting, integrations, or demos

  • Containerization and orchestration concepts (Docker, Kubernetes)

  • CI/CD and DevOps practices, including integrating applications into CI/CD pipelines

  • Networking fundamentals, security best practices, and observability concepts

☁️ Cloud & Infrastructure Awareness: You have a solid understanding of at least one major cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and common cloud services used in modern SaaS architectures

🚀 Startup Experience: You thrive in fast-paced, high-ownership startup environments and enjoy wearing multiple hats

✈️ Travel-Ready: You’re open to occasional travel and onboarding sessions with the team in EMEA as needed

Nice-to-have

jobs.title: Content Production Manager
jobs.description:
Content Production Manager

About Progress Partners

Progress Partners is a fast-growing technology company building and scaling next-generation SaaS and mobile platforms. We blend creativity with data-driven execution to ship high-impact products, including AI-powered tools, productivity platforms, and workflow software, used by millions of people in more than 160 countries.

Our global team of experts in software development, product design, growth, and analytics collaborates across time zones to deliver category-defining innovations. We work end-to-end across the product lifecycle: design, build, launch, and scale.

If you’re passionate about building transformative products, Progress Partners is a place to make a lasting impact.

About the Role

Hi, I’m Oleksandra, Head of Localization and Content at Progress Partners, and I’m hiring a Content Production Manager to join my team. We build consumer products ranging from utility tools to wellbeing and learning experiences, and many of them rely on rich in-app content, such as lessons, quizzes, stories, videos, and other formats, produced through a mix of AI workflows, in-house content specialists, and a network of freelancers. We’re now scaling that output across several products at once, and we need someone to own the engine full-time. You’ll run content production end to end, combining editorial judgment with strong project management to deliver high volumes of quality content on tight timelines. You’ll coordinate the work of our in-house content specialists and directly manage our freelance network, without direct reports initially.

Progress Partners builds consumer web and mobile products used around the world, from utility tools to wellbeing and learning experiences, in up to 36 languages. The Content & Localization team aims to own every word users read across our products and funnels, in every market.

We are building this team from the ground up. You'll join early, shape how we work, and see your impact directly in product and revenue metrics.

  • AI-first. We use AI to produce and localize content at scale, and humans to set the standards, judge quality and decide.

  • Craftsmanship. We hire true subject-matter experts who take pride in their craft and bring the depth and judgment AI can't replace.

  • Fast and pragmatic. We launch quickly, balance quality with speed through a risk-based approach, and improve as we learn.

  • Async and remote. We work across time zones and write things down.

  • Data-informed. We tie content and localization decisions to measurable outcomes.

This role reports to the Head of Localization & Content.

What You’ll Do

  • Plan and manage content production across products, from brief to publication.

  • Coordinate AI-assisted content pipelines, including generation, review and import into our CMS.

  • Brief, manage and review freelancers: writers, video producers, editors, instructional designers and subject-matter experts.

  • Run video production, including AI-generated video and captions.

  • Plan and track production timelines and capacity, and keep production within budget.

  • Make sure content goes through quality review, originality checks and localization on time.

  • Monitor content performance and engagement, and feed insights into what we produce next.

  • Keep production systems topic-agnostic and reusable, so we can launch new verticals quickly.

What We’re Looking For

  • 4–6 years in content production or editorial management for digital products, ideally in-app or educational content for learning or consumer apps

  • Experience managing freelancers and remote experts at scale

  • Hands-on content creation skills: you can write, edit and produce content yourself, not only coordinate it

  • Strong editorial skills and a high bar for content quality

  • Hands-on experience with AI content and video tools

  • Excellent organization, with experience running several projects at once

  • Comfort with metrics and content performance analysis

  • Strong written communication and the ability to work autonomously in a remote, async environment.

  • Comfort with ownership, transparency, and a results-driven mindset.

Nice to Have

  • Experience producing bite-sized learning content, such as courses, lessons or quizzes.

  • Instructional design experience, such as structuring lessons, learning paths or assessments.

  • Experience with CMS-based content workflows.

  • Experience producing content for multiple languages.

In Your First 90 Days

  • Take over content production for an upcoming product launch and deliver it on schedule

  • Improve our production workflow and tracking, and roll them out across products

  • Build a reliable pool of freelancers for video and other formats

  • Define content quality and originality checks for production

How We Work

We’re fully remote and distributed across time zones. We default to async, communicate in writing, and trust people to deliver outcomes, not log hours. Decisions are transparent, ownership is clear, and your work is visible from day one.


Interview Process

We've designed our interview process to be transparent, respectful of your time, and a genuine two-way conversation; we want to get to know you, and we want you to get to know us. You'll always know what stage you're at, what to expect next, and roughly how long things will take.

  • Initial screen with our Talent Acquisition Team - 30 min

  • Take-home assessment - 3 days

  • Final panel with Head of Localization and Content - 60 min

What We Offer

We believe great work starts with taking care of our people, and we want everyone on our team to have the support and resources they need to thrive, both professionally and personally. Here's what you can expect when you join our team:

  • Remote-first: live and work wherever you're happiest and most productive.

  • Flexible hours: we measure outcomes, not time spent at a desk.

  • Unlimited PTO: take the time you need to rest, recharge, and do your best work.

  • Learning & development budget: courses, books, conferences, certifications, whatever helps you grow.

  • Home office & wellness allowance: a dedicated budget to set up your workspace and support your health.

  • Meet-up budget: funds to get together with teammates in person and spend time face to face.

  • A small, senior, collaborative team where your work is visible and your decisions matter.

  • The chance to build products used by millions of people across 160+ countries.

Equal Opportunity

Progress Partners is an equal opportunity employer, and we’re serious about building a diverse, inclusive team. We welcome applications from people of all genders, gender identities and expressions, sexual orientations, ages, ethnicities, nationalities, religions, disabilities, neurotypes, family situations, socioeconomic backgrounds, and life experiences.

  • Support Senior Risk Managers and Project Controls Leads in delivering high-quality risk management services to our clients.

Essential

  • Proven experience in a project risk management role within major construction, infrastructure, engineering or another complex capital project environment.

  • Strong understanding of project risk management methodologies and quantitative risk analysis.

  • Practical experience undertaking or supporting Quantitative Schedule Risk Analysis (QSRA).

  • Practical experience undertaking or supporting Quantitative Cost Risk Analysis (QCRA).

  • Experience developing, maintaining and interrogating project risk registers and risk models.

  • Strong understanding of the relationship between risk, cost, schedule, contingency and project forecasting.

  • Experience facilitating risk workshops with project and technical stakeholders.

  • Experience assessing probability, impact, uncertainty and risk exposure and translating this into meaningful project insight.

  • Strong analytical and numerical skills, with the ability to interpret complex project data and identify trends and areas of concern.

  • Good understanding of project controls and how risk interacts with planning, cost, commercial and change management.

  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to challenge assumptions and constructively influence project teams.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex quantitative analysis clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • A proactive approach to identifying emerging risks and opportunities and improving project performance.

  • Experience working in a complex, multi-stakeholder project environment.

Desirable

  • Experience developing or reviewing Monte Carlo risk models.

  • Experience using quantitative risk analysis tools such as Safran, Primavera Risk Analysis, @RISK, ARM or similar.

  • Experience producing and interpreting P-values, confidence levels, S-curves, tornado diagrams and risk distributions.

GNC Engineer - Reinforcement Learning

About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Harmattan AI is pushing the boundaries of autonomous flight, where guidance and control requires intelligence. As a GNC Engineer - Reinforcement Learning, you will build AI models for autonomous guidance and control. You will push the frontier of performance and integrate learning based methods into real autonomous systems.

 

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • RL training pipeline: Plan, simulate and train reinforcement learning models for guidance and control, including obstacle avoidance, interceptor dynamics, perception and target aware planning.

  • Model deployment and testing: Verify across simulation, SITL, and HITL, including Monte Carlo campaigns, then flight test and improve.

  • Performance Studies: Create tests to validate model robustness and performance. Including adversarial models.

  • Mentorship: Depending on seniority, support the team by mentoring junior engineers.

 

CANDIDATE REQUIREMENTS

  • Educational Background: A Masters or PhD in Reinforcement Learning, Robotics, Automation and Control, or a closely related field, with a strong focus on sequential decision-making and autonomous systems.

  • Deployment: Hands on experience building and deploying reinforcement learning agents.

  • Deeply familiar with machine learning and reinforcement learning techniques.

  • Hands on experience with MuJoCo, Pytorch, C++

  • Systems-minded and pragmatic about failure modes and imperfect inputs, disciplined about simulation and validation.

  • Communicates clearly, able to present guidance and test results to engineers and senior stakeholders.

  • Thrives under pressure in a fast-paced environment with a no-task-is-too-small mentality.

  • Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI's mission of providing a defensive edge to allied nations through ethical, high-impact technology.

  • Bonus: Experience applying reinforcement learning techniques to drones or aircraft.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

Senior Financial Controller | UHT

Omschrijving

Wij zijn op zoek naar een Senior Financial Controller voor Uitvoeringsorganisatie Herstel Toeslagen (UHT) in Utrecht. Binnen de afdeling Control & Risk UHT ga je aan de slag in het team Business Control. De afdeling bestaat uit circa 65 medewerkers, verdeeld over drie teams. Business Control bestaat uit circa 25 tot 30 medewerkers, verdeeld over vijf clusterteams.

Als Senior Financial Controller ben je inhoudelijk deskundige op het gebied van financiële rapportages, analyses en Planning & Control. Vanuit Business Control werk je voor één of enkele clusters binnen UHT en fungeer je voornamelijk op tactisch niveau als sparringpartner voor de business.   • Bijdragen aan het opstellen en beheren van VT-aanvragen en uitvoering geven aan het financieel beheer van het cluster.

  • Inventariseren, afstemmen en implementeren van verbeteringen in bestaande rapportages.


Wat vragen wij?

Eisen:

jobs.title: Senior Business Development Representative - Netherlands
jobs.description:
Senior Business Development Representative - Netherlands

Build with us

Businesses deserve better from finance. Less friction, more freedom. Since 2004, Mollie has been on a mission to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe.

Today, more than 250,000 companies trust our all-in-one platform to get paid, manage money and grow on their terms. Simple, scalable and built with real businesses in mind.

We're one of Europe's fastest-growing fintechs, with 950+ Mollies across 14+ locations. Our people make this growth possible. We move fast, build with purpose and care deeply about our customers. Whether you're solving problems, building market-leading products or exploring how AI can make work smarter, you'll have the freedom to create and the trust to deliver.

If you're ready to grow, shape the future of fintech and join an ambitious, high-performing team, this is the place for you.

Your impact

As a Senior Business Development Representative, you'll play a key role in accelerating Mollie's growth in the Netherlands, building relationships with larger SMB merchants and helping them find the right payment solutions for their businesses.

You'll take full commercial ownership of your pipeline, combining inbound and outbound sales and managing more complex opportunities with businesses with annual revenue of up to €12M.

Joining an established, high-performing Dutch sales team, you'll bring your commercial expertise, market understanding and independent approach to winning new business, while continuing to grow your expertise in payments and fintech.

What you'll ship

  • Generate new business through a roughly 50/50 mix of inbound and outbound sales activities.

  • Independently own the full sales cycle, managing larger and more complex commercial opportunities.

  • Lead consultative sales conversations, understand merchant needs and position the right payment solutions.

  • Consistently achieve quarterly sales targets and drive net revenue growth in the Netherlands.

  • Navigate complex negotiations and stakeholder relationships to convert opportunities into live merchants.

  • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure successful merchant onboarding, implementation and go-live.

  • Maintain accurate sales forecasts, manage a healthy pipeline and actively share your commercial knowledge with the team.

What you will bring

  • Ideally 3+ years of B2B technology sales experience, or at least 2 years of highly relevant experience in payments or fintech.

  • A proven track record of achieving sales targets and independently generating new business through outbound prospecting, including cold calling.

  • Strong full-cycle sales experience, with the ability to independently manage larger customers and more complex deals.

  • Well-developed consultative selling, negotiation and stakeholder management skills.

  • Strong market understanding, commercial judgement, pipeline management and forecasting skills.

  • Native-level Dutch.

  • Curiosity about technology and the practical application of AI in sales.

  • A hungry, humble and smart mindset. You're ambitious, hands-on, self-aware and confident in taking ownership, while remaining open to feedback and continuous learning.

Experience in fintech, payments or the payment service provider (PSP) ecosystem is a strong advantage, but not a requirement.

Grow your way

At Mollie, growth is personal. We believe everyone should have the chance to develop their skills, explore new challenges and shape their career on their own terms.

You'll get regular feedback and performance reviews to support your development, with fair and transparent salary reviews along the way. Many Mollies move into new roles or take on new projects to stretch themselves, and we actively hire from within to help you take the next step.

No matter if you're aiming for promotion, exploring a different career path or building new skills, you'll be supported with the tools, trust and opportunities to grow your way.

 

Unlock your full potential and join us to eliminate financial bureaucracy

If you're excited by the idea of building what's next, for yourself and for thousands of businesses across Europe, we'd love to hear from you. Apply with your CV (in English) using the form below.

Want a peek behind the scenes? Check out what life at Mollie is really like.

 

AI at Mollie

We believe in Always Be Shipping, and AI brings that philosophy to life across every team, every role, every day

AI is core to how we build. It helps us move faster, simplify work and make smarter decisions, creating real impact for the businesses we serve. We're looking for people who are excited to use AI to shape the future of finance with us.

jobs.title: QA Engineer (EN)
jobs.description:
QA Engineer (EN)

About the role

At YoungOnes, you make sure our platform delivers on its promise: stable, reliable and free of surprises for the people who use it every day. As a QA Engineer you don't work at the end of the chain, but right in the middle of our development teams. You think along before any code is written, test smartly where it matters, and act as the bridge between development, product and the rest of the company when it comes to quality. You report to the Teamlead Frontend and work daily with the frontend, mobile and backend teams.

What you'll do

  • Think along from the start. You join refinements and help teams see the risks and impact of a feature before they start building;

  • Choose the right test approach. Together with the team, you decide per feature what to test automatically, what to test manually, and why;

  • Build and maintain automated tests. You set up tests for key platform functionality and keep them reliable;

  • Manual and exploratory testing. You go through the app yourself, look for edge cases and find what a script misses;

  • Central point of contact for bugs. Bug reports from across the company come to you. You reproduce them, gather all the information a developer needs to get started, and get them ready in Jira with the right priority;

  • Advise on releases. You map out risks and give clear advice on the quality of a release;

  • Provide insight. You collect test data and show how our software quality is doing;

  • Keep the balance. You help teams weigh fixing bugs against building new features.

What you bring

  • A bachelor's level of working and thinking, preferably in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field;

  • At least 2 years of work experience, including at least 1 year as a QA Engineer, Software Tester or Test Automation Engineer;

  • Experience setting up and carrying out a test approach and test plans;

  • Experience with test automation and test frameworks;

  • You're comfortable working with AI tools and use them purposefully: to test faster and better, and to set up automated tests;

  • Experience working in an Agile/Scrum team and with a bug tracking system, preferably Jira.

  • You work independently, make decisions in your own work and give advice, whether asked or not;

  • You're critical and analytical, take initiative and work well with developers, product and business.

Nice to have

  • Knowledge of TypeScript/JavaScript and you're comfortable working with code;

  • You look beyond "does it work?": also at accessibility, speed, security and multilingual support.

  • Experience with tests that run automatically on every code change, and you know how to deal with unreliable tests;

  • You enjoy sharing knowledge and helping colleagues test better;

  • Experience testing mobile apps.

We're looking for someone who sees quality as something the whole team owns. You don't just perfect your own testing work; you ask yourself what needs to change structurally so the whole team tests better. Our own values guide the way: Own it, Say it, Make it.

What we offer

  • A gross salary between €3,400 and €4,800 based on full-time employment;

  • 25 vacation days, 6.5 ADV days and 1 additional holiday per calendar year, based on a 40-hour workweek;

  • 8% vacation pay, a pension plan, and (if you live more than 10 km from the office) a travel allowance;

  • We prioritize mental well-being in collaboration with our partner OpenUp;

  • Great perks such as: a yearly fitness budget, a freshly prepared healthy lunch every day, snacks, bi-weekly afternoon drinks, XL borrels every three months and much more;

Als projectmanager krijg je veel verantwoordelijkheid, help je klanten en samen met je projectteam zet je mooie resultaten neer. Je kunt deels thuiswerken, deels op ons kantoor in Woerden en bij verschillende klanten in Nederland. Bij ons draait het om klantgericht werken én werkplezier. Daarom is er volop ruimte voor ontspanning en plezier. Denk aan een levend tafelvoetbaltoernooi, pubquiz en een bier- & wijnproeverij. Ons actieve Fun-team zorgt elke maand weer voor iets leuks.

En als je reislust nog niet is gestild met 25 vakantiedagen en een workation, dan kun je zelfs tot 20 extra verlofdagen bijkopen. Genoeg redenen om verder te lezen en te ontdekken of deze functie iets voor jou is, toch?


Een voorbeeld van je werkdag

Opstarten: Aan het begin van je werkdag heb je een dagstart met zowel collega’s als projectteamleden van de klant. Hierin bespreken jullie de voortgang, resultaten en eventuele hulpvragen.

Na de dagstart: Allereerst neem je nog wat tijd met een van de consultants naar aanleiding van de dagstart. Je coacht en begeleidt de consultant en helpt deze met een hulpvraag. Vervolgens ga je aan de slag met het opstellen van de voortgangsrapportage. Hiermee zorg je voor proactieve en transparante rapportage over het project aan de klant. De stuurgroep met de klant is volgende week, vandaag spreek je samen met de delivery manager deze stuurgroep voor. Wat zijn de belangrijkste punten voor de klant en voor CCS en hoe vliegen we die aan.

Na de lunch: Je checkt nog een paar tickets qua voortgang op het planboard, waarbij je de samenhang met de planning checkt. Vervolgens ga je naar de werksessie met het CCS projectmanagement guild. Hier werken jullie aan tickets om de CCS Prince2Agile projectmethodiek verder te verbeteren. Hierna heb je nog een afspraak met je collega van sales voor afstemming over een mogelijk vervolgproject bij de klant.

Wie jij bent

De ideale kandidaat beschikt over daadkracht, doorzettingsvermogen, enthousiasme en drive om projecten succesvol te leiden en verbeteringen door te voeren om te komen tot nog efficiëntere en klantgerichte projecten. Jij herkent jezelf in de volgende punten:

· Je haalt energie uit het opstellen en bewaken van planningen, analyseren van gegevens en opstellen van duidelijke, gestructureerde rapportages en presentaties;

· Je hebt minimaal een afgeronde bachelor, bij voorkeur richting bedrijfskunde, bedrijfseconomie en/of informatica.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Naast de genoemde leuke functie binnen een groeiend en innovatief bedrijf bieden wij:

· Workation: Je kunt tot 30 dagen aaneengesloten per jaar vanuit het buitenland werken;

· Leuke teamactiviteiten: Leer je collega’s beter kennen door deel te nemen aan maandelijkse evenementen georganiseerd door ons energieke Fun-team, zoals een pubquiz, Zomer BBQ, wine & beer tastings en movie night;

Waarom CCS?

Omdat wij geloven dat werk meer is dan een baan. Het is een plek waar je jezelf kunt zijn, impact kunt maken en kunt groeien. About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.


The Role

We are looking for a Talent Acquisition Specialist to support hiring across multiple functions and regions as BJAK continues to scale globally.

This is a hands-on recruitment role for someone who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment, managing multiple hiring priorities, and partnering closely with stakeholders to deliver hiring outcomes. You will have exposure to a wide range of functions including Operations, Finance, Marketing, Creative, HR, Product, Engineering, and other business-critical teams.


What You’ll Do

  • Manage end-to-end recruitment processes for assigned roles across multiple functions and locations.

  • Partner closely with hiring managers to understand hiring needs, candidate profiles, and business priorities.

  • Source, screen, assess, and engage candidates through various channels including LinkedIn Recruiter, referrals, job boards, and direct outreach.

  • Build and maintain strong talent pipelines for both active and future hiring needs.

  • Conduct talent mapping and market research to support hiring strategies.

  • Coordinate and manage interview processes while ensuring a positive candidate experience.

  • Maintain accurate candidate records and recruitment activities within the Applicant Tracking System (ATS).

  • Provide regular hiring updates and pipeline insights to hiring managers and stakeholders.

  • Support recruitment process improvements, hiring initiatives, and employer branding activities where required.

  • Collaborate with recruiters, coordinators, and business leaders to achieve hiring goals across the organization.


The Right Fit Has

  • 2–5 years of experience in Talent Acquisition, Recruitment, Executive Search, Staffing, or a related field.

  • Proven experience managing multiple vacancies simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.

  • Strong sourcing capabilities across LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, referrals, networking, and direct outreach.

  • Experience recruiting across multiple functions such as Operations, Finance, Marketing, Creative, HR, Product, Engineering, or other corporate functions.

  • Strong candidate assessment and interviewing skills.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.

  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail and execution.

  • Comfortable operating in an environment with evolving priorities and ambitious hiring goals.

  • Demonstrates ownership, resilience, adaptability, and a proactive mindset.

  • Experience in technology companies, startups, recruitment agencies, or high-growth organizations is highly preferred.

  • Fluency in English is required. Additional language capabilities such as Mandarin, Bahasa Indonesia, Thai, or Japanese are an advantage.


What Success Looks Like

  • Delivers strong candidate pipelines across multiple functions and markets.

  • Consistently achieves hiring targets while maintaining quality and candidate experience.

  • Builds trusted relationships with hiring managers and stakeholders.

  • Demonstrates strong ownership and accountability throughout the recruitment process.

  • Contributes to improving recruitment efficiency, hiring quality, and overall team performance.


Why Join BJAK

  • Above-market remuneration.

  • Fast-track career growth and development opportunities.

  • Exposure to international hiring across multiple markets and functions.

  • Opportunity to work directly with experienced recruiters and business leaders.

  • High ownership, autonomy, and responsibility from day one.

  • Flat organization where ideas and execution matter more than titles.

  • Meaningful work that directly contributes to the growth and success of the business.

Location

This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.

jobs.title: Staff Security Engineer
jobs.description:
Staff Security Engineer

The role

Our InfoSec team is looking for a Staff Security Engineer to lead how we defend Paddle in a rapidly changing threat landscape. AI is changing both sides of security. Attackers are using it to scale social engineering, find weaknesses faster and automate intrusion, while our own adoption of AI tools and agents creates new risks to manage. This is a hands-on, high-impact role for an experienced security generalist who wants to build our defences against these threats, and to use automation and AI to make our detection and response faster and more effective. You’ll be a senior technical leader across InfoSec and IT, working across both our Enterprise IT and Product environments, and helping our global team of Paddlers operate securely without slowing them down.

What you’ll do

  • Lead our incident response capability, from playbooks and readiness exercises to acting as senior technical lead during security incidents.

  • Improve our security operations, strengthening detection coverage, alert quality and triage, and turning manual operational work into engineered, repeatable processes.

  • Build and evolve our defences against AI-enabled threats, including AI-driven phishing, impersonation and deepfakes, and accelerated vulnerability exploitation.

  • Design complete social journeys. Work through how someone discovers a person, decides to follow them, shares an idea or trade, receives a response, and returns. Connect these interactions into an experience users understand without explanation.

  • Make the interaction details work. Shape navigation, information hierarchy, copy, defaults, gestures, and feedback. Specify what happens when a feed is empty, a post fails, content loads slowly, or someone changes their mind.

  • Prototype before committing to a build. Turn ideas into interactive prototypes that communicate the intended behavior. Explore alternatives, test the uncertain parts, and give engineering clear flows, states, and acceptance criteria.

  • Use psychology to improve participation. Understand why people hesitate to post, seek recognition, follow strangers, or respond to others. Translate those motivations into decisions about audience visibility, prompts, reputation, feedback, and the effort required to contribute.

  • Observe users and fix what gets in their way. Run usability sessions, watch people complete tasks, and combine those observations with funnel data. Identify where people misunderstand the product, lose confidence, or abandon an action.

  • Design for first use and repeated use. Make the experience useful before someone has connections. Keep sharing lightweight during an active trading session, with clear control over what becomes public. Test the twentieth interaction as carefully as the first.

  • Connect design decisions to measurable outcomes. For each significant change, define the expected behavior and how to test it. Track task completion, abandonment, first follows, first contributions, responses, and subsequent retention. Work with data science to evaluate experiments and effects on both contributors and their audiences.

  • Take the experience through launch. Choose a focused initial scope, resolve trade-offs with engineering, review the implementation against the intended design, and use post-launch evidence to decide what to improve next.

jobs.title: Director of Brand Strategy
jobs.description:
Director of Brand Strategy

Not all heroes wear capes — but plenty of them use toilet paper

Want to challenge yourself at a purpose-led scale up AND make a difference in the world? Come join the revolootion!

Funny name, serious business

We are a leading eco-friendly household essentials business and we donate 50% of our profits to help everyone gain access to clean water and a toilet. As of June 2026, we’ve contributed over $20 million AUD to this mission. Basically, we’re really good at making it easy to do good.

We operate scaling businesses the UK, US, Australia and Canada. Our amazing team is based in Australia, the UK, the Philippines, China, and the US. Our 250+ people aim to make the biggest possible impact for people and the planet. Over the next 5-10 years, we’re hoping to increase our annual donation tenfold to get us closer to our dream of everyone in the world having access to clean water and sanitation services.

A bit about the role

The team have been busy building an ownable and distinctive brand platform. This role is about what comes next - the second album. You’ll partner with our Chief Creative & Brand Officer to set the brand strategy for the coming year and the brand horizon for the next three to five, built on a real understanding of how our customers’ lives are changing rather than a deck full of numbers.

You’ll also be the person who turns messy inputs into a problem worth solving. Requests reach our creative team from markets and teams across the business, each with different goals and levels of detail. It can take our creative team hours to shape them into clear briefs before they can start. You’ll define what great briefing looks like here, help the business work out which work is genuinely worth making and give creative teams a sharp starting point every time.

It’s a role with real room to shape things. We’re a business that has grown quickly and now spans four markets, and the joins between global brand thinking and local market plans are still being drawn. You get to draw a lot of them.

This role is fully remote but must be based in our Australian Hub.

If you worked here this past month here are some things you might have been involved in

  • Sprinting on our brand positioning with the Chief Creative & Brand Officer - and telling us which bits of it don’t hold up yet.
  • Sitting with our Consumer Insights lead to work out how our customers’ lives at home are likely to change over the next three to five years, and what that means for the brand.
  • Taking a brief for one of our biggest campaigns and rewriting it into something a creative team can run at.
  • Meeting brand leads and general managers across Australia, the UK, the US and Canada to find out what’s in their plans, and where a single brand approach would make everyone’s life easier.
  • Shaping a set of small, bold experiments to test what “a brand that punches above its weight” really means for us.
  • Acting as a thought partner on our social and content strategy so it pulls in the same direction as the long-term brand strategy.

Let’s talk about you

You get a kick out of making messy things simple.

You’ve been handed the ten-page document with no question in it, and you enjoyed finding the question. The craft you’re proudest of is probably a short, sharp brief rather than a long, clever deck – because you know the brief is where great work either becomes possible or quietly doesn’t. Most people who thrive here have come from an agency planning background, though we’re not precious about it if you’ve built this muscle somewhere else.

You think in years, not weeks.

At least half your time in this role should be spent on what’s coming, not on fixing what’s already landed. You’re genuinely curious about customers and culture, you can point to brand bets you made a few years ago and say honestly which ones played out, and you can hold a three to five year view and this quarter’s campaign in your head at the same time.

You’re deeply collaborative, and you’ll still tell us we’re wrong.

You listen properly, you build relationships across time zones without being asked to, and you notice when a market has gone quiet. You’re also the person who says “hang on, how does this connect to the five-year plan?” when the room is getting carried away. That healthy tension is the job, not a side effect of it – and you can bring the commercial argument that makes the challenge land.

You give a crap. Do you want your work to make the world a better place? Do you want to work with other people who feel the same way? What a coincidence — us too!

Why should you work with us?

First off, as a certified B Corp™, we work to make a difference every day while maintaining the high standards of social and environmental impact. We’re in very good company with other exceptional B Corps around the world.

We also believe that helping to make the world a better place should be rewarded accordingly – that’s why we offer competitive, market informed salaries, meaningful support towards healthcare for our team around the world, generous paid leave, tailored learning and development opportunities, and free toilet paper (yes, you read that right).

Our engagement surveys (thanks Culture Amp!) tell us that our team is really proud (over 90%) to work for Who Gives A Crap and, well, we couldn’t be more proud of that.

Have you made it this far?

If you’re still reading, we think there’s a strong chance you might be our kind of person. Here’s the thing, though — research suggests that 60% of women and underrepresented folks might have already talked themselves out of applying. Even if you don’t check every box above, we want to encourage you to introduce yourself. We believe a diversity of perspectives and experiences makes a team stronger — and the stronger our team, the closer we are to delivering toilets and clean water for all.

Applications will close on Friday 11th December.

Full-Time Australia

Business Development Representative

What do we do?

Paddle offers digital product companies a completely different approach to their payment infrastructure. Instead of assembling and maintaining a complex stack of payments-related apps and services, we’re a Merchant of Record for our customers. That means we take away 100% of the pain of payment fragmentation. It’s faster, safer, cheaper, and, above all, way better.

We’re backed by investors including KKR, FTV Capital, Kindred, Notion, and 83North and serve over 10,000 software sellers in 245 territories globally.

The Role:

We are looking for a smart, ambitious, and autonomous Business Development Representative to help fuel our next stage of hyper-growth. This is an exciting time for you to join the team: our customer base is expanding globally, our product is evolving fast, and our sales engine is scaling like never before.

As a BDR in our Business Development team, you will be the first point of contact for all of Paddle’s sales efforts. You’ll create demand, spark meaningful conversations, and build early relationships that turn into qualified pipeline to arm your counterparts on the Account Executive team. Your core tasks will involve researching, prospecting, prioritizing accounts, educating prospects, and converting interest into high-quality meetings.

This role places you at the centre of a high-performing GTM function. We take career development seriously. Once you consistently hit quota and master the craft, you’ll have a clear pathway to grow into an Account Executive role at Paddle.

What you'll do:

  • Quickly develop a deep understanding of Paddle’s Ideal Customer Profile, core use cases, and value propositions to target the best-fit companies for us.

  • Own and properly manage a healthy territory of high-fit accounts.

  • Proactively generate conversations and effectively showcase Paddle’s set of products across all channels: LinkedIn, cold calling, email, video, and region-specific channels (WhatsApp, WeChat, etc.).

  • Convert these meaningful engagements into qualified opportunities for our Account Executive team.

  • Partner with our marketing department to collaborate on in-person and virtual events to generate demand.

  • Use modern tools, including AI-powered workflows, to work smarter, personalise outreach, and improve performance.

  • Manage and prioritise your time to consistently meet and exceed your targets.

  • Bring a winner’s mindset and high-performance attitude to the team every day.

We'd love to hear from you if you are:

  • Experience in a previous Sales / Business Development role as part of a SaaS or B2B company, and are always happy to proactively engage new customers through email and phone.

  • Coachable, accountable, and consistent in your efforts to develop knowledge and results.

  • Believe in a consultative and human sales approach and understand that every conversation is different.

  • Are performance-driven, competitive, and energised by hitting and surpassing targets.

  • See the benefits of Paddle’s set of products - we strongly believe that our products are helping other Tech companies grow, and we want to work with people who are passionate about Paddle and can articulate its value.

  • Can stay organised in a dynamic, fast-changing environment and thrive in moments of ambiguity.

  • Can follow a framework, while baking in your own flavour and creativity.

  • Are excited to get outside your comfort zone, experiment, and continuously improve your craft.

  • Are confident communicating across multiple channels and formats: phone, email, video, social.

  • Enthusiastic and ambitious, with a desire to build a career in sales.

Everyone is welcome at Paddle

At Paddle, we’re committed to removing invisible barriers, both for our customers and within our own teams. We recognise and celebrate that every Paddler is unique and we welcome every individual perspective. As an inclusive employer, we don’t care if, or where, you studied, what you look like or where you’re from. We’re more interested in your craft, curiosity, passion for learning and what you’ll add to our culture. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t match every part of the job ad, especially if you’re part of an underrepresented group.

Please let us know if there’s anything we can do to better support you through the application process and in the workplace. We will do everything we can to support any accommodations needed. We’re committed to building a diverse team where everyone feels safe to be their authentic self. Let’s grow together.

Why you’ll love working at Paddle

We’re a diverse, growing group of Paddlers who pride ourselves on our transparent, collaborative and respectful culture.

We live and breathe our values, which are:

  • Paddle Together - “None of us, is as smart as all of us”

  • Paddle Simply - “Simple can be harder than complex: you have to get your thinking clean to make it simple”

  • Paddle for others - “We can realise our wildest dreams, so long as we help enough other people to realise theirs”

We offer a full suite of benefits, including attractive salaries, stock options, unlimited holidays, enhanced parental leave, retirement plans, private healthcare and well-being initiatives.

We invest in learning and will help you with your personal development via constant exposure to new challenges, an annual learning fund, and regular internal and external training.

Connecting at Paddle

We’re a ‘digital-first’ company, which means our Paddlers always have the freedom to choose where, when and how they work within our hub locations.

We recognize that where our Paddlers do their best work is unique to them and we provide trust and autonomy for everyone to work in a way which fits them best. We also value the power of connection and have invested in global hubs which help local communities flourish and bring us together for focused collaboration.

Our Paddle hubs:

  • In Europe: UK (London headquarters), Portugal (Lisbon hub), Netherlands and Ireland (Dublin hub)

  • In North America: Austin, TX (USA) and Toronto (Canada)

Our hub philosophy creates an engaging experience for all Paddlers, wherever, whenever and however we choose to work.

To support this, we focus hiring within our hubs and will always openly share the available locations for each open position on our job description.

Full-Time UK

We have an exciting opportunity for an experienced Senior / Lead Risk Manager to join one of our clients' major infrastructure programmes, taking a leading role in the management of risk across large-scale, strategically important construction and energy projects.

Working within a complex project delivery environment, you will take ownership of project risk management, working closely with Project Management, Project Controls, Commercial and wider delivery teams to ensure risks are effectively identified, assessed, mitigated and communicated.

The projects form part of a significant investment in the UK's energy infrastructure, supporting network resilience, energy security and the transition towards a cleaner energy future. With individual project values exceeding £500m, this is an excellent opportunity to contribute to some of the UK's most significant infrastructure developments.

  • Build strong working relationships with Project Directors, Project Managers, engineering teams, contractors, delivery partners and wider project stakeholders.

  • Provide guidance and support to non-risk professionals, helping to develop risk awareness, ownership and capability across the project.

  • Support the integration of contractor and delivery partner risk information, ensuring a consistent approach to risk management.

  • Provide accurate and well-evidenced risk information to support regulatory submissions and wider programme requirements.

  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of risk management processes, tools and ways of working across the wider programme.

🔹 We’re looking for:

Essential

  • Demonstrable experience in project risk management within a major project or programme delivery environment.

  • Experience working on large-scale, complex construction or infrastructure projects.

  • Strong experience developing, maintaining and managing project risk registers.

  • Experience leading risk identification workshops, interviews and stakeholder discussions.

  • A strong understanding of qualitative and quantitative risk management methodologies and techniques.

  • Experience undertaking or supporting QCRA, QSRA and risk modelling.

  • An understanding of how risk management integrates with wider project controls disciplines, particularly Planning, Cost and Change.

  • Experience developing and monitoring risk mitigation strategies and treatment actions.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex project information and identify potential areas of risk.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to challenge assumptions and engage with senior stakeholders.

  • The ability to translate complex risk information into clear, meaningful reporting and recommendations.

  • A proactive approach to improving risk management processes and developing risk management capability within project teams.

  • Degree qualification in a relevant discipline, or equivalent professional experience within project risk or project controls.

Desirable

  • Experience working within the energy, utilities or major infrastructure sectors.

  • Experience working within a regulated environment.

  • Recognised risk management or project controls qualification, such as Association for Project Management (APM), Institute of Risk Management (IRM) or Management of Risk (MoR).

  • Experience using quantitative risk analysis tools such as Safran Risk, @RISK, Primavera Risk Analysis or similar.

  • Experience using project risk management systems such as ARM or Predict.

  • Previous experience in another project controls discipline, such as Planning, Cost or Change Management.

  • Experience working with NEC contracts or within collaborative delivery models.

  • Experience working within Joint Ventures or partnership delivery arrangements.

🔹 At CMR

We have a strong culture driven by our 9 Core Principles. We look to build a community of people that share our values and ambitions.

We're proud that 96% of our team say CMR is a "Great Place to Work" — a reflection of our supportive culture, focus on people, and drive to do things differently.

👉 Learn more about us here: https://cmr.london/who-we-are/

📍 Requirements and Location

  • Full right to work in the UK.

  • Nationwide opportunity with a flexible base location.

  • Project and stakeholder engagement requirements will be dependent on the needs of the programme.

📦 Salary & Benefits

  • Salary: Competitive, dependent on experience.

  • Benefits package to be confirmed with the client.

➡️ Next Steps

To express your interest in this opportunity, please submit a copy of your CV for consideration.

As we receive many applications to our opportunities, please include a short summary outlining your relevant experience, why you are interested in the role and what you could bring to the project team.

We look forward to hearing from you!

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin or disability or any other protected characteristics. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.

Discord’s mission is to give people the power to create space to find belonging in their lives. Every day, millions of people trust Discord to be a place where they can talk, spend time together, and build community. Keeping that space safe starts with teams like ours.

Discord’s Violent Actors Team, part of the broader Threat Operations organization within Trust & Safety, identifies and disrupts violent and extremist actors and networks. As Threat Investigations Team Lead, you will manage and develop a team of investigators and analysts responsible for detecting, investigating, and disrupting ongoing and emerging threats.

You will be a player-coach: setting a high bar for investigative quality while staying close enough to the work to guide complex cases and incident response. You will help early-career investigators build their tradecraft, turn investigative findings into actionable intelligence, and collaborate with internal and external partners during high-risk incidents. You will report to the team’s Senior Manager.

  • Manage, coach, and develop a small team of investigators and analysts, setting clear expectations and providing timely, actionable feedback.
  • Own the team’s investigative quality, workload prioritization, queue health, and performance.
  • Serve as the first point of escalation for complex, ambiguous, or high-risk investigations, helping the team make sound and well-documented decisions.
  • Act as a player-coach: guide deep-dive network investigations, build the team’s tradecraft across case development, network analysis, proactive detection, and intelligence production, and help the team identify new detection and disruption opportunities.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate complex and sensitive subjects for non-expert audiences.

  • Experience presenting complex threat findings to senior leaders or external audiences.

Account Manager - UK/I

About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia.   • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

About the role

This is a builder's role, where you'll own both the technical depth and commercial outcomes for some of ElevenLabs' most exciting customers across the UK & Ireland region, sitting at the intersection of product, engineering, and revenue.

You'll get ahead of the problem. You'll run onboarding, enablement, and growth across ElevenLabs' full platform, core speech models, creative tools, and Agents. You'll advise customers on production deployment, not just theory, digging into usage and performance data to catch friction early and keep adoption moving.

Senior Service Delivery Manager

Who We Are

Vultr is on a mission to make high-performance cloud infrastructure easy to use, affordable, and locally accessible for enterprises and AI innovators around the world. With 33 global cloud data center locations, Vultr is trusted by hundreds of thousands of active customers across 185 countries for its flexible, scalable, global Cloud Compute, Cloud GPU, Bare Metal, and Cloud Storage solutions. In December 2024 Vultr announced an equity financing at a $3.5 billion valuation.   • 401(k) plan that matches 100% up to 4%, with immediate vesting

  • Professional Development Reimbursement of $2,500 each year

  • Gym membership reimbursement up to $50 per month

Vultr is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Service Delivery Manager to lead delivery for our most strategic customers. You will be a customer-facing program manager for large, complex AI infrastructure programs that run for many months and involve many teams across Vultr, as well as partners and suppliers. You will be the customer's primary point of contact for delivery, represent their priorities inside Vultr, and make sure what we commit to deliver is what they receive. The engineering and operations teams own and run their work; you connect it into a single delivery view for the customer and keep it moving. You will also lead cross-functional initiatives that improve how Vultr operates.

The ideal candidate is a seasoned program leader with a record of delivering large infrastructure programs for demanding enterprise customers, who earns the trust of executives and engineers alike. This is a highly visible role in a high-growth technology company, which will require sound judgment under pressure, candid communication when plans change, and the ability to lead teams you don't manage. You'll work on some of the largest AI infrastructure programs Vultr has ever taken on, in close partnership with senior leadership. Service Delivery is a new function at Vultr, so you will also help shape how it works. This is your opportunity to join our fast growing team and leave your mark on Vultr and the future of Cloud Infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end delivery for one to two concurrent strategic customer programs, from the late stages of the sale through go-live and stable operation.

  • Own the customer relationship for delivery as primary contact and accountable owner, running executive governance such as steering committees, regular delivery reviews and escalations.

  • Partner with sales and account management before contract signature to confirm that what we commit to is deliverable, then make sure every commitment is tracked and met.

  • Coordinate the work of multiple engineering, infrastructure and operations teams, each with its own program managers, without taking over their plans: understand the dependencies between them, spot risks early and drive resolution.

  • Advocate for the customer inside Vultr, making sure their priorities shape decisions and challenging delays that can be avoided.

  • Communicate schedule changes to customers early and honestly, and lead difficult conversations about dates and scope with customer executives.

  • Manage each customer's path, from sales to delivery to ongoing support, leading formal customer acceptance once the service is live, ensuring nothing promised to the customer is lost along the way.

  • Lead cross-functional internal initiatives that improve how Vultr serves its customers, from planning through to a measurable outcome.

  • Coach Service Delivery Managers and build the methods, templates and standards the team uses.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of program or project management experience, including at least 5 years managing customer-facing delivery of large, complex technology programs in cloud, data center, HPC, AI or telecommunications.

  • Proven ability to lead through influence across engineering, operations and commercial teams you don't manage.

  • Executive presence, including experience running steering committees and holding difficult conversations with senior customer stakeholders.

  • Solid grasp of infrastructure delivery (data centers, networking, servers and GPUs, storage), enough to ask engineers the right questions and judge the answers.

  • Sound judgment under pressure, with a habit of raising risks early and bringing options rather than waiting for problems to escalate.

  • Experience moving customers from project delivery into ongoing operations and support.

  • Clear, concise written and verbal communication, from detailed working sessions to executive summaries.

  • Proficiency with Smartsheet, Jira, Confluence and Salesforce, or similar program management, collaboration and CRM tools.

  • Ability to travel up to 25% to customer sites and data centers.

  • Flexibility to work extended hours, including some weekends, around major customer launches and across customer time zones.

  • Preferred: PMP, PgMP or equivalent certification; experience building a new delivery function or practice.

Compensation

$150,000 - $160,000

Final compensation will vary depending on years of experience, background/skill set, location, and applicable laws.

Inclusion & Privacy

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and experiences, and we prohibit discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable laws. Vultr will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in accordance with applicable laws and will not conduct a background check until after an offer of employment has been extended and accepted.

We also take your privacy seriously. We handle personal information responsibly and follow applicable laws, including U.S. privacy rules and Indiaâs Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023. Your data is used only for legitimate business purposes and is protected with proper security measures.

Where allowed by law, applicants may request details about the data we collect, access or delete their information, withdraw consent for its use, and opt out of nonessential communications. For more details, please see our Privacy Policy.
